title: Snowy Tale
summary: After eating the Amiudake soup, Hiriluk feels much stronger. But while he was eating the medicine, a reaction happened in his lab. That was the reaction he was researching since so long ago. In joy after this miracle, he departs, suddenly telling Chopper to rest. He heads toward Dr. Kureha's house and begs her to complete two things, pretending he has not enough time to fulfill them: to continue his research on the Sakura powder and to teach Chopper medical knowledge so that he can become a good doctor. Kureha is angered by the favors and the request for them to be completed for free. She kicks Hiriluk out. In town, people are desperate. The Isshi-20 are sick and there are no more doctors left to help them, the reasons for Hiriluk to hurry back to town. He is determined to cure the sick doctors and rushes toward the castle, despite the fact he is blocked by Wapol's soldiers. Meanwhile, Kureha is worried because she does not understand why Hiriluk is in such hurry while he has still 2 weeks to live. When she rushes into his house, she encounters Chopper, who claims that the doctor is much better thanks to his mushroom soup. The old woman is in shock, as the mushroom is poisonous and Hiriluk has only one hour left before he dies. Chopper does not understand and he shows the pirate sign that Hiriluk told him was a symbol of a magic cure next to the mushroom picture he found in a book. Kureha tells the distraught reindeer that the skull in the book means poison and there is no cure for all diseases. She further explains that good intentions are not enough to help people and he can do nothing without learning medical knowledge and the skills to use them. Chopper then starts wailing uncontrollably because of his foolishness as Kureha pities him. Hiriluk has reached the castle so that he could die there.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Chopper discovers that the Amiudake mushroom he gave Hiriluk as medicine is in fact deadly poisonous, and that the skull symbol he mistook for a pirate flag (symbol of a magic cure) was a poison warning — meaning he unknowingly fatally poisoned Hiriluk.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The scraper listed 'Amiudake' and 'Isshi-100' — Amiudake is the poisonous mushroom (not a character), and the group referenced in the summary is the Isshi-20 (20 doctors), not Isshi-100. Adjusted characters_present accordingly. Wapol's soldiers are briefly mentioned blocking Hiriluk but Wapol himself is not explicitly described as appearing in person — included tentatively. Hiriluk's death is imminent and announced within the chapter but not yet shown on-panel, hence character_death_offscreen=true. The chapter is set in Drum Kingdom, which is on the Grand Line.

title: Inherited Will
summary: Dr. Hiriluk falls into Wapol's trap. He delivers a speech about death and commits suicide. Chopper arrives and attacks Wapol in anger, but Dalton intercedes. Dalton defies Wapol by letting Chopper escape, as he was inspired by the creature's determination. Chopper asks Kureha to train him to become a doctor and states that his dream is to cure all diseases. The flashback ends, showing Luffy finishing his punch to Wapol in the face he had started from Chapter 141.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le flashback de Chopper se termine dans ce chapitre avec la mort de Hiriluk (suicide, donc mort en flashback). Le combat de Luffy contre Wapol est la conclusion d'un punch commencé au chapitre 141, ce qui en fait une résolution de combat. Chopper attaque Wapol en flashback mais est stoppé par Dalton — il est donc combat_participant limité. La mort de Hiriluk est un suicide dans le passé narratif du flashback. 'Chapter 141' détecté par le scraper est une référence éditoriale, pas un personnage.

title: Battle to Defend the Kingdom
summary: Wapol and his two lieutenants try to take back their castle but Chopper has decided that no one will enter what had become Hiriluk's grave.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très court et ne détaille pas précisément les actions de chaque personnage. Chopper est le personnage central qui défend le château (tombeau de Hiriluk) contre Wapol et ses deux lieutenants Chess et Kuromarimo. L'arc se déroule à Drum Island qui fait partie de Grand Line et non East Blue — correction: sea_region devrait être Grand Line mais le chapitre est catalogué dans East Blue Saga. Conformément au résumé fourni, sea_region conservé tel quel.

title: Downright Lie
summary: In Bighorn, the Isshi-20 decide to betray Wapol, whom they have followed by fear and rescue Dalton. Usopp tells Vivi that they should not worry about Luffy and Sanji as they can take care of themselves. When Dalton decides to fight against his former king, whereas he is barely able to stand up, Usopp, who was afraid of climbing the mountain a few seconds before, proposes to carry Dalton on his back as he is invigorated by their warrior's spirit. Meanwhile in front of the castle, Wapol demonstrates the extent of his Baku Baku no Mi powers by transforming into a living canon house. Indeed, he has the ability to transform into everything he has eaten and admit to eating canons and explosives to create his current structure. He even eats Chess and Kuromarimo and fuses them into a new adversary, Chessmarimo. To demonstrate his desire to take back his castle, Wapol shoots at the symbol of his adversaries: Dr. Hiriluk's flag. Chopper is furious and run towards Wapol, however, by respect to his friend's wishes, he does not attack him. However, Wapol does not hesitate and shoots the naive reindeer. Meanwhile, Luffy has reached the castle roof in order to restore the pirate flag on top of the castle spire.

title: Unbreakable
summary: Usopp sees Dalton's determination and volunteers to carry him to the castle. However, Zoro interrupts and takes Dalton off his back due to Usopp being too weak. The villagers inform them of a ropeway to the castle and claim they can fix it in 30 minutes. Meanwhile at the castle, Luffy holds up Dr. Hiriluk's flag and deems it unbreakable. Wapol, in frustration, shoots Luffy and the flag. When the smoke clears, Luffy is still holding the flag. Chopper stares in awe. Sanji becomes impatient and attempts to attack Wapol, only to be stopped by Dr. Kureha. Then, Chopper unleashes a surprise attack on Wapol, only to be intercepted by Chessmarimo. Luffy launches himself to the ground and the REAL battle begins!

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Usopp est mentionné dans le résumé mais absent de la liste initiale du scraper — ajouté manuellement. title: RUMBLE!!
summary: Chopper is determined to defend the honor of the pirate flag. To defeat Chessmarimo, he uses a Rumble Ball, a drug which will increase his power for 3 minutes. Chessmarimo mocks Chopper as he watches the reindeer's 3 Zoan's transformations. He laughs that none of the modes are enough to defeat him. However, he is surprised when Chopper is able to avoid is attacks, thanks to two additional transformations. Chopper informs him that the Rumble Ball allows him to have four supplementary combinations beside the standard three, making a total of seven transformations. title: Strategy to Escape the Sand Kingdom
summary: Igaram walks in the room to find the Straw Hat Pirates had already left. He asks Vivi why, and she simply replies that they are pirates. Jango and Fullbody are seen dancing after capturing an enemy ship. Hina is talking to a marine about getting ready to capture the Straw Hat Pirates. However, the marine reports that their ship is missing. Luffy, and his crew are now riding in the desert, on the Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops. Nami is concerned, and the crew asks her if it is about Vivi. However, Nami replies that she forgot to ask Vivi for their payment. Igaram is worried about the Straw Hat Pirates, due to their new bounties. But Vivi reassures Igaram, saying that it's useless as the pirates would only celebrate at becoming even more infamous. Vivi is revealed to have a speech the next day. Vivi thinks of before the Straw Hat Pirates left. Someone brought in a Den Den Mushi, and the pirates find out that the caller was Mr. 2. Mr. 2 told them that he took their ship away, and everyone was outraged at losing their ship. However, Mr. 2 told them that he's their friend and then hung up. The Straw Hats discussed about what to do, but in the end, they decided to trust Mr. 2. Vivi is torn between continuing to travel with her friends, or to stay and remains as the princess of Arabasta. Nami gives her 12 hours to decide what Vivi should do. Now, the Straw Hat Pirates has reached where Mr. 2 is. The crew distrusts him, as he is one of the Baroque Works agents. However, Mr. 2 tells them that the Baroque Works is over, and he saved the crew's ship from the Marines. Luffy, Chopper, and Usopp celebrates that Mr. 2 is still their friends. A marine reports to Hina that they had found the Straw Hat Pirates and she instructs them to prepare for battle.

summary: After escaping the Marine ships thanks to Mr. 2, the Straw Hat Pirates are waiting for Vivi at the meeting point. The princess is ready to start her speech for her ceremony. When she starts speaking, she remembers her encounter with a ship that was able to give her hope when she was about to lose faith. When they hear her, the Straw Hats believe that they will not be able to see her again before the Marines catch them and are about to depart. But suddenly, Vivi and Karoo appear in front of them with a handheld speaker. The princess in Alubarna is actually Igaram being disguised. However, Vivi has come to say goodbye, as her duty and her love for her country are too important for her to join the crew. But when asked if they would still be friends in the future, the pirates are unable to answer her because of the nearby Marines, who show silently the mark of their eternal friendship.

Other people in the bar gossip about how they cannot believe such a child has such a large bounty on his head. Luffy comments about how he has met a lot of huge people today, while Bellamy sits beside him and tells the storekeeper to get him an expensive drink and something Luffy likes. Sarquiss and the others barge into the store and kill people so they could sit where they were. The others try not to pay attention. Bellamy tells Luffy to drink up and Luffy says "oh, he's a good guy!" and drinks. Nami and Zoro yell at Luffy to watch out, but it is too late and Bellamy smashes Luffy's head into the counter. Bellamy's crew laugh and the onlookers are shocked. Zoro puts a sword up to Bellamy's neck, furious. Nami tells Zoro to stop since they have not gained any information in the town yet. Luffy gets up and tells Bellamy to get ready. The others cheer on since they like to see fights. Bellamy laughs and says this is a test, not a fight. Nami tells Luffy to wait, and asks the storekeeper about the sky island, to everyone's shock. The Straw Hats are confused. After an awkward moment of silence, the whole bar bursts in laughter. When Nami says that the log pose is actually pointing to the sky, everyone laughs crazily and say that Log Poses tend to go nuts all the time, embarrassing Nami. Bellamy cackles and talks about how people who have dreams are stupid. He says that he was going to test Luffy and put him in his crew of the "New Age" but Luffy is too much of an idiot to join. He talks about how people who have dreams are weaklings, and hits Luffy with a bottle. Then, other people start throwing things at Luffy, Zoro, and Nami as well, saying that their existence makes their rum taste bad and to get lost. Sarquiss tells Bellamy that the store wants to see a "show", which Bellamy agrees to. Nami tells Luffy and Zoro that they can forget about their promise, so they can beat up Bellamy, but Luffy tells Zoro to never buy this fight.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Roshio est mentionné comme ayant été vaincu par Bellamy avant le chapitre — mort possible hors-champ mais non confirmée (marqué offscreen par précaution). Skypiea dans la liste du scraper est un lieu, pas un personnage, ignoré en tant que tel. Le Devil Fruit de Bellamy est évoqué par des témoins mais non utilisé dans ce chapitre. Le bounty de 30 000 000 de Luffy est mentionné. Luffy refuse catégoriquement le combat (décision majeure), contrairement à l'instinct du groupe. Le chapitre titre 'Do Not Dream' reflète le discours de Bellamy contre les rêveurs.

title: People's Dreams
summary: Luffy and Zoro refuse to fight back against the Bellamy Pirates. As they leave the bar, they run into a man who congratulates them for believing in their dreams, but they simply walk away. Meanwhile, Usopp and Sanji notice the arrival of a familiar ship.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre est centré sur le refus de Luffy et Zoro de contre-attaquer les Bellamy Pirates après avoir été humiliés/battus. Un personnage mystérieux (très probablement Marshall D. Teach / Barbe Noire) les félicite de croire en leurs rêves. Usopp et Sanji repèrent un navire familier qui arrive — cliffhanger de type 'arrival'. 'Sky Island' dans la liste du scraper est un concept/lieu mentionné, pas un personnage. Barbe Noire est identifié comme présent d'après le résumé (l'homme qui les félicite). Robin et Chopper sont absents du résumé. Nami est listée comme présente par le scraper mais son rôle dans ce chapitre est marginal. Il n'y a pas de combat effectif dans ce chapitre malgré les traces visibles des violences antérieures des Bellamy Pirates. La tension est liée à la dignité et aux convictions des personnages.

title: Shoujou, the Salvage King of the Seafloor
summary: Robin has found someone that may know of Skypiea. Bellamy hears about the gold and wants to find out more.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Robin finds someone (Shoujou/Mont Blanc Cricket's group) who may have knowledge about Skypiea, advancing the crew's quest to reach the sky island.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très court et peu détaillé. Shoujou est introduit comme 'le Roi du Sauvetage des fonds marins', probablement un associé de Mont Blanc Cricket cherchant des indices sur Skypiea. Bellamy apprend l'existence de l'or mentionné par le groupe de Cricket. Aucun combat décrit. Les présences physiques de tous les Straw Hats ne sont pas confirmées explicitement mais déduits du contexte de l'arc Jaya. La présence de Bellamy est mentionnée mais en contexte secondaire (il entend parler de l'or). Confidence réduit en raison du résumé minimaliste.

title: Noland the Liar
summary: The Straw Hat Pirates arrive at Mont Blanc Cricket's house, discovering he's a descendant of Mont Blanc Noland. After a scuffle with Cricket, Chopper realizes that he has the bends, a condition he likely obtained from repeated diving.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Mont Blanc Cricket est révélé être un descendant de Mont Blanc Noland, le fameux 'menteur' de North Blue, et souffre de la maladie des caissons due à des plongées répétées.
locations: Jaya - maison de Mont Blanc Cricket
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est bref. La bagarre avec Cricket est évoquée mais peu détaillée (scuffle). Bellamy, Sarquiss, Masira et Shoujou sont listés par le scraper mais leur présence physique dans ce chapitre spécifique est incertaine — ils sont possiblement mentionnés ou présents en marge. Mont Blanc Noland apparaît en flashback/référence narrative, pas physiquement. Le titre 'Noland the Liar' suggère un flashback ou une référence à l'histoire de Noland.

title: Mont Blanc Cricket, the Last Boss of the Saruyama Allied Force
summary: The Saruyama Alliance decides to help the Straw Hat Pirates reach Sky Island.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très succinct — il indique seulement que la Saruyama Alliance décide d'aider les Mugiwara à atteindre Sky Island. Le chapitre est centré sur Mont Blanc Cricket (présenté comme le chef/boss de l'alliance). Noland est probablement mentionné comme ancêtre de Cricket, mais aucun flashback explicite n'est confirmé. Sanji est absent du scraper et du résumé (il est alors sous-marin à Jaya, mais son statut dans ce chapitre précis est incertain — non comptabilisé). Robin est également absente de la liste détectée. Le tagging repose sur le contexte canonique de l'arc Jaya pour combler les lacunes du résumé minimal, d'où un confidence_score modéré.

title: Let's Eat
summary: Mont Blanc Cricket recapitulates how to reach the legendary sky islands, recalling past memories of giants emanating their shadowy presence near Jaya. As Cricket recounts his theories to the Straw Hat Pirates, he directs their attention towards the millennium cumulonimbus, from which the Knock Up Stream is said to blast out. However, with this comes stipulations of exact timing and the need for a South Bird. The Straw Hats must capture one of these birds before dawn while grappling with the ominous potentiality of crashing downward into the sea's bottomless depths.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Cricket explains how to reach Sky Island via the Knock Up Stream, including the need to capture a South Bird and the precise timing required — confirming the existence of Skypiea as reachable destination.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est dense en exposition et en lore. Zoro et Robin ne sont pas mentionnés dans le résumé malgré leur présence probable à bord — ils ont été exclus de characters_present par prudence. Le titre 'Let's Eat' suggère une scène de repas possible mais elle n'est pas décrite explicitement dans le résumé fourni. Bellamy et Mont Blanc Noland sont référencés comme personnages détectés par le scraper mais ne semblent pas physiquement présents dans ce chapitre (Bellamy absent, Noland mentionné dans le contexte historique de Cricket). Le flashback de Cricket sur les géants près de Jaya est une mémoire/théorie plutôt qu'un flashback narratif complet.

title: Pursue the South Bird!!
summary: Following the description of Noland's log, the Straw Hat Pirates hunt for a South Bird, which is apparently able to always face south, even in the magnetic fields of the Grand Line. Back at Cricket's house, the Bellamy Pirates arrives, searching for gold.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Le South Bird est capable de toujours s'orienter vers le sud même dans les champs magnétiques perturbés du Grand Line, ce qui en fait un outil essentiel pour naviguer vers le Knock Up Stream.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très bref. Le flashback de Noland est mentionné indirectement via 'le journal de Noland'. L'arrivée des Bellamy Pirates chez Cricket constitue le cliffhanger de fin de chapitre. Aucun combat n'a encore lieu mais la menace est imminente. Masira est listé dans les personnages détectés mais sa présence physique dans ce chapitre précis reste incertaine selon le résumé disponible.

title: Bellamy the Hyena
summary: While the Straw Hat Pirates frantically try to catch a South Bird, Bellamy attacks the Saruyama Alliance.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très bref. La double action parallèle (Straw Hats cherchant un South Bird / Bellamy attaquant la Saruyama Alliance) est confirmée. L'utilisation du Bane Bane no Mi par Bellamy est cohérente avec ce chapitre. Les détails précis sur les techniques, l'état de santé des victimes et la conclusion du combat ne sont pas confirmés par le résumé seul. Sarquiss est listé comme présent car il accompagne habituellement Bellamy. Confidence modérée en raison de la brièveté du résumé.

title: The Hundred Million Man
summary: A local drunkard is taking a leak in the ocean, before noticing a new bunch of bounties coming in. Looking through the wanted posters, he finds two that he immediately recognizes: Luffy and Zoro, who were publicly humiliated only this afternoon before at their mention of Sky Island. However, when he sees how high Luffy's bounty is, he is struck with horror, as it is not 30,000,000 anymore, but 100,000,000! Meanwhile, with Nami's warning about Sky Island's deadline ringing in his ears, and the memories of Cricket flashing through his mind, Luffy dashes towards Mock Town to get Cricket's gold back. In Mock Town, the Bellamy Pirates are celebrating their find, as well as mocking the Saruyama Alliance, until the drunkard rushes in. When he spots Bellamy, he warns him that he needs to get out of town at once before he is killed. When Bellamy asks who would dare to threat him, the drunkard tells the entire bar of the bounties. This is enough to strike them with terror, as both of them have bounties higher than Bellamy's 55,000,000 bounty. However, this only makes Bellamy laugh. Then, he berates the entire bar, as he believes that the posters are forgeries made by them in order to scare them. This causes the bar to calm down, until the enraged call of Luffy shocks them again. Bellamy walks out to see who is calling, until he sees Luffy on a building. When Luffy tells him that Bellamy is to return the stolen gold, Bellamy uses his Bane Bane powers to get up on the roof as well. He tells him that since he stole the gold, it's rightfully his, but Luffy tells him that he's stealing it back. Bellamy continues to mock Luffy, as the drunkard is more and more distressed, but Sarquiss tells him to knock it off, starting to doubt that even Luffy's 30,000,000 bounty was real. Bellamy wonders how Luffy is supposed to fight, or if he's just going to stand around like their last encounter. When Luffy tells him that the last time was different, Bellamy starts off the brawl by using his powers to jump off the building and crack the tower in two. Bellamy lands on another building, and readies his Spring Snipe to do Luffy in. He hits the top of the tower, which sends Luffy crashing down on the ground. As Luffy gets up, Bellamy uses his ultimate move, Spring Hopper, which people comments was exactly the same move he used against Roshio. As Bellamy continues to bounce around, he continues to mock Luffy, as well as mocking all the dreamers as well. This enrages Luffy, recalling when Bellamy asked him if he knew how to throw a punch, while cracking his knuckles. As Bellamy moves in for the kill, Luffy punches him with extreme force, knocking him out with only one punch and leaving an imprint of his fist on Bellamy's cheek.

taxonomy.revelation_description: La prime de Luffy est révélée avoir grimpé à 100 000 000 de Berry, dix fois plus que Bellamy ne l'estimait possible.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Nami et Zoro sont mentionnés (Nami via son avertissement, Zoro via son affiche de prime) mais ne semblent pas physiquement présents à Mock Town dans ce chapitre ; ils sont inclus avec présence limitée. Cricket apparaît en flashback dans les pensées de Luffy. La nouvelle technique 'Spring Hopper' est nommée dans le chapitre bien qu'elle ait été utilisée aussi contre Roshio dans un passé mentionné. La prime de Luffy à 100 000 000 est la révélation majeure du chapitre, titre compris. Sarquiss est présent physiquement dans la scène de bar. Jobo est le ivrogne anonyme qui découvre les affiches.

title: The World's Greatest Power
summary: While Luffy retrieves Cricket's gold, Buggy continues his quest for gold and encounters Ace. At the same time, an important meeting takes place at Mary Geoise, the capital of the World Government.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Une réunion importante se tient à Mary Geoise impliquant les Cinq Doyens et des Shichibukai, révélant l'organisation et la puissance du Gouvernement Mondial ainsi que l'existence des Sept Grands Corsaires comme pilier de cet ordre mondial.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très court et peu détaillé. La présence physique de Luffy est inférée par le fait qu'il récupère l'or de Cricket. Buggy et Ace se rencontrent mais aucun combat n'est décrit. La réunion à Mary Geoise implique vraisemblablement les Cinq Doyens et plusieurs Shichibukai (Doflamingo, Kuma, et potentiellement Crocodile encore en poste à cette époque), mais leur présence exacte n'est pas confirmée par le résumé. Nami, Zoro, et autres Mugiwara sont probablement présents sur Jaya mais non mentionnés explicitement. Plusieurs personnages listés par le scraper (Shanks, Edward Newgate, Roger, Alvida, Mohji, Cabaji, Bellamy, Sarquiss, Richie) semblent être des erreurs de scraping ou des mentions tangentielles sans apparition physique dans ce chapitre.

title: Please Remember
summary: A meeting with the remaining Warlords is called by Fleet Admiral Sengoku to discuss Crocodile's replacement. However, only three come to the meeting; Bartholomew Kuma, Donquixote Doflamingo and Dracule Mihawk. As they begin, a mysterious man reveals himself with a proposition. Meanwhile, somewhere on the Grand Line, the great pirate Red-Haired Shanks prepares to meet with Whitebeard.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Laffitte, représentant des Blackbeard Pirates, propose Marshall D. Teach comme candidat au poste vacant de Shichibukai lors de la réunion des Sept Corsaires. Shanks se prépare à rencontrer Barbe Blanche.
locations: Grand Line (navire de Shanks / territoire de Barbe Blanche)
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre est une scène de politique mondiale sans combat. Laffitte apparaît pour la première fois, représentant les Blackbeard Pirates et proposant Teach comme Shichibukai — révélation majeure pour le lore. Le 'will_of_d_mentioned' est coché car Marshall D. Teach est nommé. Sarquiss est listé par le scraper mais n'est pas présent dans ce chapitre (il appartient à l'arc Jaya précédent). Marco, Benn Beckman et Rockstar semblent présents dans la scène avec Shanks/Barbe Blanche selon le contexte. La localisation exacte de la scène avec Shanks est incertaine.

title: Knock Up Stream
summary: Luffy is finally back. During his fight, the Going Merry has been transformed into a chicken-like boat. After saying thanks and farewell to Cricket, they depart to the Knock Up Stream area. After several hours of calm, a millennium cumulonimbus is finally approaching. With the help of their diving crew, Masira and Shoujou are able to locate the stream. They then tell the Straw Hat Pirates to go toward a giant whirlpool that just has been created. The Going Merry has to reach the center of the whirlpool. Now it is too late to go back.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le combat mentionné en début de chapitre ('During his fight') est une référence hors-champ à un combat précédent (probablement contre Bellamy), non montré dans ce chapitre. Ce chapitre est essentiellement une scène de transition/préparation vers Skypiea via le Knock Up Stream. Le Going Merry a été modifié pour ressembler à un poulet, probablement pour traverser le courant montant. Le scraper listait des personnages inexistants dans ce chapitre (Marshall D. Teach, Blackbeard Pirates, Sea King, Shandora, Skypiea, Saruyama Alliance en tant que personnage) — ces entités n'apparaissent pas physiquement dans le résumé fourni. Masira et Shoujou sont présents comme membres de la Saruyama Alliance. Le retour de Luffy après son combat justifie character_return=true.

title: The Ship Sails to the Sky
summary: The Going Merry is swallowed by the whirlpool. While Usopp and Nami are terrified, Luffy is excited by this new adventure. Suddenly, when they have reached his center, the whirlpool disappears. This allows the Straw Hat Pirates to notice a raft that has came toward them. It belongs to Blackbeard Pirates, who have come to catch Luffy and Zoro now that they have high bounties. Unfortunately for them, the calm was just a short pause before the Knock Up Stream starts. The Merry is propelled toward the sky by this enormous pillar of water while Blackbeard's raft is simply smashed into pieces. After enjoying the sensation of their ship sailing the stream, Sanji notices that their situation is far from safe as the boat is starting to lose balance and is about to fall down. That is until their navigator masters the situation. Nami tells them to set down the sail. Indeed, the stream is also creating a huge wind that will help them to fly to the sky.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le scraper liste des personnages comme Masira, Shoujou, Mont Blanc Cricket et Mock Town qui ne semblent pas présents dans ce chapitre spécifique selon le résumé fourni — ils sont liés à l'arc mais absents ici. Marshall D. Teach est présent avec ses pirates (Blackbeard Pirates) mais aucun combat direct n'a lieu : leur radeau est détruit par le Knock Up Stream, sans affrontement. Robin n'est pas mentionnée dans le résumé bien qu'elle soit membre de l'équipage à ce stade — non taggée par précaution. Le chapitre titre 'East Blue Saga' mais l'action se déroule sur le Grand Line (arc Skypiea en cours).

title: High in the Sky
summary: After crossing through the millenium cumulonimbus, the Straw Hat Pirates land on a white landscape: a sea made of clouds. Usopp tries to swim into this strange sea, however, it is not without danger, and without Robin and Luffy rescuing him, he would have died from falling to the ground or be eaten by the strange monsters that attacked the Going Merry. Meanwhile, Chopper spots a pirate ship, that is suddenly destroyed by a mysterious assailant who is now targeting the Going Merry. The Straw Hat Pirates are unable to stop him, but they are saved by a strange mercenary, Knight of the Sky.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Les Straw Hat Pirates arrivent sur Skypiea, une île dans les cieux composée de nuages, avec des monstres marins et un mystérieux Knight of the Sky (Gan Fall).
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le scraper incluait des entités non pertinentes comme 'Blackbeard Pirates', 'Jesus Burgess', 'Marshall D. Teach', 'Imperial Cumulus', 'Knock Up Stream', 'Hana Hana no Mi' (fruit et non personnage), 'Grand Line' et 'Going Merry' (navire) qui ne sont pas des personnages. Ces entités ont été retirées de characters_detailed. Wyper est l'assaillant mystérieux qui détruit le navire pirate et attaque le Going Merry - son identité est confirmée dans ce chapitre de Skypiea. Gan Fall est le 'Knight of the Sky' qui sauve les Straw Hats. La présence physique de Zoro et Sanji dans ce chapitre est supposée mais non explicitement confirmée par le résumé - ils font partie de l'équipage présent collectivement. L'arc est Skypiea (pas East Blue Saga comme indiqué par le scraper).

title: Heaven's Gate
summary: The Sky Knight Gan Fall (Ganfor) welcomes the Straw Hat Pirates to the White Sea and leaves them with a whistle to call him if they need his assistance. The crew continue their exploration of the White Sea and discover Heaven's Gate which leads them to the White-White Sea.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très succinct. Gan Fall (Sky Knight / Ganfor) accueille les Chapeaux de Paille dans la White Sea et leur remet un sifflet. L'équipage découvre ensuite Heaven's Gate menant à la White-White Sea. Le chapitre correspond à l'arc Skypiea (début). La liste des membres des Straw Hats présents est estimée à ceux connus à cette période (Luffy, Zoro, Nami, Usopp, Sanji, Chopper, Robin — 7 membres), Franky n'ayant pas encore rejoint. Straw_hats_count corrigé à 7. Gan Fall est présenté comme un personnage déjà introduit précédemment (chapitre précédent), donc new_character_introduced=false. L'arc Skypiea est déjà en cours.

title: Angel Beach
summary: The Straw Hat Pirates enter the White-White Sea and Skypiea through Heaven's Gate. The crew then land on Angel Beach, where they meet some of its inhabitants and are introduced to the flora and fauna of the sky islands.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Chapitre d'introduction à l'arc Skypiea. Conis et Su (son nuage-renard) sont introduits, ainsi que Pagaya. Mont Blanc Noland est mentionné dans le lore mais n'apparaît pas physiquement dans ce chapitre. Les dials sont introduits comme élément de worldbuilding. Arc classé Grand Line car Skypiea est dans le Grand Line. L'arc Skypiea commence ici, bien que le résumé le classe dans 'East Blue Saga' par erreur — il appartient à l'arc Skypiea (Grand Line). Confidence modérée car le résumé est bref et les détails fins (Usopp ment-il ? Luffy mange-t-il ?) ne sont pas confirmés.

title: Dial Energy
summary: The exploration of Angel Beach continues and explanations are given on how the cloud islands and seas are formed. The sky island technology further demonstrate their usefulness and necessity for life in the clouds. Nami, quite taken with the waver, decides to test it and as result ends up in forbidden territory.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Explications sur la formation des îles et mers de nuages, et sur la technologie des dials indispensable à la vie en haute altitude
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est succinct. Chopper n'est pas mentionné explicitement mais est probablement présent parmi l'équipage sur Angel Beach. L'arc est Skypiea (Sky Island Saga), non East Blue Saga comme indiqué par le scraper. Nami entre en territoire interdit en testant le waver, ce qui constitue le cliffhanger/mystère de fin de chapitre. Les dials et le waver sont des technologies skypiéennes, pas des personnages à proprement parler.

title: Heaven's Judgment
summary: Nami, on the outskirts of Upper Yard, is a witness to the priests' competition and God's might. While back at Angel Beach, the rest of the crew warrant some unwanted attention from the White Berets.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très bref et peu détaillé. Le chapitre semble être une scène d'exposition/transition montrant Nami observer la compétition des prêtres sur Upper Yard, et l'équipage à Angel Beach confronté aux White Berets (Bérets Blancs, la garde de Dieu). Aucun combat explicite n'est mentionné, seulement une menace latente. Enel est mentionné implicitement via 'God's might'. Le scraper mentionne 'Goro Goro no Mi' et 'Going Merry' comme personnages — ce sont des éléments non-personnages retirés de la liste finale. 'Zabo' est un personnage mineur de Skypiea inclus dans la liste du scraper. La note 'East Blue Saga' dans l'arc semble incorrecte — ce chapitre appartient clairement à l'arc Skypiea (Sky Island Saga). Confiance modérée due au manque de détails du résumé.

title: Class-2 Criminals
summary: The White Berets attempt to arrest the Straw Hats as trespassers, but their efforts are in vain because the Straw Hats beat them. Because of their resisting, the leader of the White Berets McKinley warns that now the Straw Hat Pirates' criminal status have risen and will instead have to face the judgment of the Priests of Skypiea.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre se déroule dans l'arc Skypiea (Sky Island Saga, pas East Blue Saga). Les White Berets sont une milice locale de Skypiea, pas des Marines. McKinley est le chef des White Berets. Le statut criminel des Straw Hats est élevé après leur résistance, les exposant au jugement des Prêtres — cela constitue un cliffhanger de type revelation/menace. Chopper n'est pas mentionné dans le résumé malgré son appartenance à l'équipage à ce stade ; Robin non plus. Le scraper n'a pas détecté les White Berets comme entité distincte de God's Guards. Amazon et Pagaya sont probablement présents en arrière-plan mais leur rôle actif dans ce chapitre précis n'est pas confirmé par le résumé.

title: Ordeals
summary: The Straw Hat Pirates realize that the old lady in at the entrance of Heaven's Gate tricked them, and they are now being chased by the authorities. Nami, with Robin and Chopper, decide to run and escape with the Going Merry, but a super speedy shrimp, a servant of God takes them and guides them to Upper Yard while the rest of the Straw Hats are informed regarding the forbidden island.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre appartient à l'arc Skypiea (Sky Island Saga), non à East Blue Saga — le scraper a commis une erreur d'attribution d'arc. Enel est mentionné comme 'God' mais n'apparaît pas physiquement selon le résumé; il est listé prudemment comme présent via sa référence contextuelle (le shrimp est son serviteur). Pagaya et Conis sont inclus car ils informent les Straw Hats sur l'île interdite. Le groupe est scindé en deux : Nami/Robin/Chopper sur le Going Merry emmenés de force vers Upper Yard, et Luffy/Zoro/Usopp/Sanji informés sur l'île. Aucun combat n'a lieu — il s'agit d'une phase de déplacement forcé et d'exposition.

title: SOS
summary: Luffy, Sanji and Usopp are walking in the Lovely Street of Angel Island and people avoid them because the Straw Hats are criminals. Then Conis confesses while crying that she is the one that called the shrimp because she has a responsibility to do. Enel watches the scene and sends lightning at Conis, but Gan Fall grabs her and Luffy before it can do any damage to them, and takes Conis back to her house. The three of them then head towards Upper Yard.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Conis révèle qu'elle est responsable d'avoir appelé la crevette (impliquant qu'elle a piégé les Straw Hats sur ordre de/par peur d'Enel), aveu fait en pleurant.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: fight_occurs est False car Enel envoie la foudre mais Gan Fall intercepte avant tout impact — cela reste une tentative d'attaque plutôt qu'un vrai combat. L'arc est Skypiea (Sky Island Saga), le scraper le classe incorrectement sous East Blue Saga. La liste du scraper inclut 'Goro Goro no Mi', 'McKinley', 'Karasumaru', 'Milky Road', 'vearth' qui sont des éléments de contexte mais McKinley et Karasumaru ne semblent pas physiquement présents dans le résumé.

title: Adventure on God's Island
summary: While Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji go to the Sacrificial Altar to rescue their friends, Zoro, Nami and Robin decide to explore the Sacrificial Altar, leaving Chopper in charge of guarding the Going Merry.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très court et ne détaille pas le contenu précis du chapitre. La division en deux groupes est confirmée : Luffy/Usopp/Sanji partent secourir leurs amis à l'Autel du Sacrifice, tandis que Zoro/Nami/Robin explorent le même lieu différemment. Chopper garde le Going Merry. Conis et Gan Fall sont listés comme personnages détectés mais leur rôle actif dans ce chapitre n'est pas confirmé par le résumé — ils sont inclus dans la taxonomie personnage avec prudence. Le niveau de tension est modéré car le groupe s'aventure dans Upper Yard, territoire dangereux de Skypiea.

title: Satori, Priest of the Wandering Forest
summary: Luffy and the others choose to go through the Trial of Balls which results in them falling from a great height straight into the Forest of Illusion. He says that he predicted there would be five left at the end of it, therefore, since there are six people left, one of them needs to be taken down. Robin, Zoro, Gan Fall, and Wyper look at each other and collectively decide that Enel will be the one to fall much to his annoyance.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Enel révèle les Ruines Principales de Shandora en faisant tomber les Ruines Supérieures, et annonce que son 'jeu' prédit cinq survivants, or il en reste six.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Skypiea (Sky Island Saga), non East Blue Saga comme indiqué par le scraper — probable erreur de métadonnée. Nola est un animal (serpent géant), pas un combattant humain. Pierre est le cheval ailé de Gan Fall. Chopper est mentionné comme membre de l'équipage présent mais n'est pas explicitement décrit dans le résumé. L'alliance informelle entre Robin, Zoro, Gan Fall et Wyper contre Enel est comptée comme nouvelle alliance formée. Wyper tire son Burn Bazooka sur Enel, donc fight_occurs=true.

title: Oratorio
summary: The fight between Zoro, Robin, Gan Fall and Wyper against Enel begins. Gan Fall attacks Enel saying that the world does not need a god, but the latter dodges it and retaliates with thirty million volts, gravely injuring him. Robin tries to trick Enel so that she could find the Golden Bell herself. Enel strikes Robin down with a lightning strike saying that he doesn't like manipulative women.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Robin tente de manipuler Enel pour trouver la Cloche d'Or seule — indique une décision stratégique indépendante. Gan Fall et Wyper mentionnés comme participants mais leurs actions détaillées sont minimales dans le résumé. Zoro est présent dans le combat mais aucune action spécifique lui est attribuée dans le résumé fourni. L'arc est Skypiea (Grand Line) et non East Blue Saga malgré l'indication du scraper.

title: Divina Comedia
summary: The chapter starts with Enel attacking the group. Enel attacks Robin who is then knocked into unconsciousness. Zoro defends Robin saying that she is a woman which provokes Zoro to attacks Enel, in vain. Wyper then uses Seastone on Enel, knowing that it would drain him of his Devil Fruit abilities. Wyper uses the Reject Dial which is ten times more powerful than an Impact Dial even though he knows that using the Reject Dial could potentially kill him. The penultimate pages in the chapter show an unconscious Enel which gives hope to the group left. They all think he is beaten but to their extreme dismay, Enel uses his Logia powers, to restart his heart.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Enel utilise ses pouvoirs Logia pour redémarrer son propre cœur après avoir été mis inconscient par le Reject Dial de Wyper, démontrant une résistance extraordinaire.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Skypiea (Sky Island Saga), non East Blue Saga — le scraper a mal classifié l'arc. Gan Fall, Braham, Kamakiri, Genbo, Raki et le Shandia Chief sont listés par le scraper mais absents du résumé ; non inclus dans characters_detailed. Le Reject Dial et l'Impact Dial sont des objets, pas des personnages. Le Seastone est utilisé par Wyper pour neutraliser temporairement le Fruit du Démon d'Enel. Nami est listée comme présente dans le groupe mais son rôle actif n'est pas décrit dans le résumé.

characters_detailed.name: Enel
characters_detailed.power_used: Goro Goro no Mi — redémarrage du cœur par électricité

title: Shandia Rhythm
summary: Wyper tries to continue to fight Enel, but is unable to and Enel attacks him. Zoro attacks Enel, but is easily defeated by him. Wyper gets up, but Enel defeats him in a single attack. Nami decides to go with Enel in order to survive.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le scraper liste de nombreux personnages (Gan Fall, Robin, Conis, Shandia Chief, Kalgara, etc.) qui ne sont pas mentionnés dans le résumé. Seuls Wyper, Enel, Zoro et Nami sont confirmés actifs dans ce chapitre. L'arc est Skypiea (Sky Island Saga), pas East Blue Saga — le scraper indique probablement un mauvais arc. Nami prend une décision stratégique importante en rejoignant Enel pour survivre. Le Reject Dial mentionné par le scraper pourrait avoir été utilisé par Wyper mais n'est pas explicitement décrit dans le résumé.

title: Conis
summary: Conis tries to warn everyone that Enel is going to destroy Angel Island and that they will die if they stay there, but no one believes her. Meanwhile, Luffy confronts Enel and prepares to fight.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Enel intends to destroy Angel Island entirely, threatening all its inhabitants
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The summary is brief; several characters listed by the scraper (Moyle, Divine Squad, God's Guards, Waver, Burn Bazooka, Cloud End) are items/groups/techniques rather than individual characters. Mantra, Devil Fruit, and Goro Goro no Mi are concepts/abilities, not characters. The fight between Luffy and Enel is described as beginning/preparing but not yet fully engaged, so fight_ends is false. Straw Hats count set to 2 (Luffy and Nami) as Robin's presence in Angel Island context is plausible but the summary only explicitly confirms Luffy; Nami and Robin are inferred from their known positions in this arc around chapter 278.

title: Pirate Luffy vs. God Enel
summary: Conis finally convinces the citizens to escape to the Blue Seas. Luffy and Enel begin to fight. Enel realizes that he cannot hurt Luffy, because Luffy is made of rubber.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Enel réalise que ses attaques de foudre sont inefficaces contre Luffy car le caoutchouc est non conducteur — son fruit est naturellement contré par Gomu Gomu no Mi.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le scraper listait 'Blue Seas', 'Angel Island' et 'God's Guards' comme personnages — ce sont des lieux ou des groupes, non des personnages individuels identifiables. McKinley est probablement brièvement présent lors de l'évacuation. Nami et Aisa sont possiblement présentes dans des scènes adjacentes à l'évacuation mais leur implication directe dans le combat n'est pas mentionnée. La révélation majeure (immunité de Luffy à la foudre) est un pivot narratif clé de cet arc Skypiea.

title: Floating
summary: Enel gets up after being knocked down. Luffy tells Enel that he is made of rubber, therefore his lightning based attacks will not work on him. Enel has not heard of rubber before, as it doesn't exist in the White-White Sea. Enel uses Mantra to predict Luffy's movements and attacks. Enel changes his staff into a trident to damage Luffy. Luffy tells his dream of becoming the Pirate King to Enel. Enel asks what country he rules, Luffy replies that the Pirate King is the king of the sea. Enel responds that the idea is not half bad.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Luffy révèle à Enel qu'il est en caoutchouc et donc immunisé contre la foudre ; Luffy déclare son rêve de devenir Roi des Pirates à Enel
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Nami et Aisa sont détectés par le scraper mais le résumé ne confirme pas leur présence physique active dans ce chapitre ; leur présence est probable (elles sont dans la zone de Skypiea) mais non décrite. Le Mantra d'Enel est un équivalent au Haki d'Observation, tagué comme tel. La transformation du bâton en trident n'est pas une nouvelle technique nommée. Le résumé mentionne la White-White Sea comme contexte géographique/culturel (Enel n'y connaît pas le caoutchouc).

title: Deathpiea
summary: Enel activates Arc Maxim's Deathpiea. Aisa begins to head towards Maxim on Pierre. Luffy continues to fight Enel, thinking of ways to get around Enel's Mantra ability.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très court. 'Mantra' et 'Shandia' et 'Skypiea' dans la liste du scraper sont des concepts/groupes, non des personnages individuels — ils ne sont pas ajoutés comme personnages présents. Nami est ajoutée car elle est à bord d'Arc Maxim dans cet arc à ce stade. Pierre est le cheval/oiseau d'Aisa. Le Fruit du Démon utilisé est celui d'Enel (Goro Goro no Mi) pour activer Deathpiea. Mantra est une capacité de perception d'Enel, pas un personnage. La présence de Nami reste incertaine dans ce chapitre spécifique, la confiance est modérée.

characters_detailed.name: Enel
characters_detailed.power_used: Goro Goro no Mi — Deathpiea activation

title: Desire
summary: Luffy continues his fight with Enel. Enel traps Luffy's right hand in a golden ball and throws him off the ship. Aisa tries to save Luffy, but Enel stops her. Conis notices that Sanji and Usopp have disappeared.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ark Maxim est listé comme personnage par le scraper mais il s'agit en réalité du vaisseau/lieu. Il a été retiré de characters_present. Robin est mentionnée comme présente selon le scraper mais n'a aucun rôle actif décrit dans le résumé — incluse avec présence minimale. Sanji et Usopp sont mentionnés comme ayant disparu, ce qui implique leur absence active de la scène principale. Le chapitre se déroule entièrement sur l'Ark Maxim. La balle d'or sur la main de Luffy est une technique d'Enel via le Goro Goro no Mi (manipulation du métal fondu via chaleur électrique).

title: On the Front Line of Rescuing Love
summary: Sanji wakes up and notices Nami is missing. He then wakes up Usopp and tells him they must go and save her. They start climbing up a rope which is hooked onto Ark Maxim. Enel tells Nami she had an unwise choice to make by giving up the life she knew. He also tells her that two of her crew mates have snuck aboard to and it would be foolish try to save her. Enel tells her no one will save her, as he prepares to take care of her. Nami prepares to engage in combat with Enel, as distraction to escape. Usopp is seen in lower part of the ship. Robin is seen moving Zoro with her Hana Hana no Mi powers. The Skypieans and Shandia are seen evacuating. Conis remembers her first meeting with the Straw Hats. Luffy asks Aisa to take him to the Golden Bell. Nami is seen battling Enel until Usopp interrupts the fight with a failed attack.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Chopper n'est pas mentionné dans le résumé, donc non compté parmi les membres présents. Robin est présente mais son rôle est secondaire (déplace Zoro). Gan Fall, Pierre, Su, Wyper et le Shandia Chief sont mentionnés dans la liste du scraper mais absents du résumé — non inclus dans characters_present. La Hana Hana no Mi est utilisée par Robin pour déplacer Zoro. Le combat Nami vs Enel est interrompu par Usopp sans conclusion. Nami utilise la Clima-Tact contre Enel.

title: Sorry
summary: Nami tries to fight Enel but her efforts are in vain. Meanwhile, Usopp and Sanji get onboard the Maxim and separate hoping to distract Enel. Usopp gets to Nami first and they try to escape using the Waver. Enel gets angry and tries to use God's Judgment but is stopped by Sanji, Sanji then takes the blow for Nami.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: God's Judgment is Enel's technique name used in context; 'new_technique_revealed' is debatable as it may have appeared earlier in the arc. Nami attempts to fight Enel — counts as fight_participant but fails entirely. Sanji takes the lightning blow meant for Nami, making him injured. Usopp participates in escape/distraction but not direct combat. Luffy is absent from this chapter's action.

title: Capriccio
summary: The Straw Hats and Aisa reunite in the ruins of the Golden City. Enel fixes the Ark Maxim. More Skypieans are seen evacuating. Luffy draws closer towards the Golden Bell. Enel begins a Thunder Storm over Sky Island.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Résumé très court et peu détaillé. L'arc Skypiea appartient à Alabasta Saga / Sky Island Arc dans le Grand Line, pas à East Blue Saga (erreur probable du scraper). Les personnages détectés incluent beaucoup d'éléments non-humains (lieux, objets) — seuls les personnages physiquement présents ont été retenus. L'utilisation du Goro Goro no Mi par Enel pour déclencher le Thunder Storm est implicite dans le résumé. Pas de combat direct décrit. Wyper et Gan Fall sont probablement présents dans les ruines mais non confirmés explicitement — inclus avec prudence.

title: The Monster of Shandora
summary: As the citizens of Angel Island try to escape the island, Enel's lightning continues to destroy the land while Luffy runs up the beanstalk aiming to defeat Enel. Down at the base of the beanstalk, Wyper thinks back to the story of his ancestor's good friend, Mont Blanc Noland. During the flashback we see his ancestor Kalgara dealing with an exploration crew, defeating them all and burning the ship's remains. It is also revealed that Noland was a strong and good leader, who single-handedly killed a Sea King underwater in order to feed his starving crew.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé mentionne plusieurs personnages listés par le scraper (Usopp, Nami, Zoro, Robin, Gan Fall, Conis, etc.) mais ne les montre pas physiquement actifs dans ce chapitre — ils ne sont donc pas inclus dans characters_present. Le combat mentionné dans le flashback concerne Kalgara contre un équipage d'exploration (non nommé) et Noland contre un Sea King. Enel utilise son Fruit (Goro Goro no Mi) pour détruire Angel Island mais aucun affrontement direct Luffy/Enel n'a lieu dans ce chapitre. fight_winner est attribué à Noland pour le Sea King en flashback. La taxonomie globale reflète l'action principale du chapitre centrée sur le flashback de Wyper et la montée de Luffy vers Enel.

title: God Killing
summary: The famous explorer Mont Blanc Noland voyages to Jaya and discovers that its people are plagued with Tree Fever. The villagers try to sacrifice Mousse, but Noland intervenes to save her, slaying Kashigami. Noland and Kalgara meet for the first time.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Introduction du légendaire explorateur Mont Blanc Noland et de son voyage à Jaya, posant les bases du lore de Skypiea et de la civilisation Shandia
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ce chapitre est un flashback historique centré sur Mont Blanc Noland arrivant à Jaya 400 ans avant le récit principal. Kashigami est le serpent-dieu que Noland tue pour sauver Mousse. La rencontre initiale entre Noland et Kalgara est un moment fondateur du lore de Skypiea. Le scraper liste 'Tree Fever', 'Jaya', et 'South Bird' qui sont des éléments/lieux, pas des personnages. Pantri, Seto et Herb sont des villageois Shandia mineurs dont la présence exacte dans ce chapitre précis est incertaine selon le résumé disponible.

title: Curse
summary: After Mont Blanc Noland slayed their "God" and saved Kalgara's daughter, he proceeds to duel against the Shandia warrior Kalgara who seeks retribution from Noland for killing their god. The two briefly clash. In the middle of the battle Mousse attempts to commit suicide after being pressured by her father. Noland berates her for her foolish actions. This distraction causes him to be struck in the chest by Kalgara's spear. Noland offers to cure the village's plague and was given until sunset to find the cure for the tribe's plague and Noland began to look for the tree with the treatment inside.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ce chapitre appartient au flashback Noland/Kalgara dans l'arc Skypiea (environ 400 ans avant le présent narratif). Le 'sea_region' est Grand Line car Jaya est en Grand Line. La mort de Kashigami (le serpent dieu) a eu lieu avant ce chapitre — aucune mort confirmée dans ce chapitre. Mousse tente de se suicider mais n'y parvient pas. Le combat entre Noland et Kalgara se conclut par une trêve conditionnelle plutôt qu'une victoire claire. L'arc narratif global est Skypiea/Upper Yard Saga, mais l'action se déroule dans le flashback.

title: Full Moon
summary: Noland was still swallowed up by the land. The citizens were getting ready to execute Noland's men even though the deadline of their agreement had yet to pass. Kalgara appeared and tried to kill Noland. Kalgara had a change of heart and saved him from Jaya. Mont Blanc Noland saved the Shandia from a disease, called Tree Fever.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ce chapitre se déroule entièrement en flashback (l'histoire de Noland à Jaya, 400 ans avant l'arc actuel). Kalgara tente de tuer Noland mais a un changement de cœur et le sauve. Noland a soigné les Shandia de la maladie Tree Fever, cimentant ainsi une alliance entre lui et Kalgara. Le 'fight_occurs' est vrai car Kalgara attaque Noland, mais le combat n'a pas de vainqueur car il est interrompu. L'alliance formée est entre Noland/Lvneel et les Shandia. Les personnages listés par le scraper comme 'Tree Fever', 'Jaya', 'Kashigami', 'Lvneel', 'Kona Tree' et 'Herb' sont des éléments de l'histoire (maladie, lieu, divinité, royaume, plante, plante médicinale) et non des personnages à part entière.

title: The Light of Shandora
summary: Kalgara takes Mont Blanc Noland to the Golden City, Shandora. There, Noland finally sees the large bell that he has been hearing at sea. Kalgara offers the crew extended stay as they finish their work, and in this time Kalgara and Noland bond deeply. A month into Noland's stay however, this is cut short by a sudden tension that has once again risen between the two groups. Kalgara is no longer interested in seeing Noland, and Noland decides that he will leave after his crew finishes their work in the forest in the three days.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Noland découvre Shandora, la Cité d'Or, et la grande cloche du beffroi qu'il entendait depuis la mer ; un lien profond se tisse entre lui et Kalgara avant qu'une tension mystérieuse ne vienne rompre leur amitié.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre se déroule entièrement en flashback (histoire de Noland et Kalgara il y a 400 ans). Nola le serpent géant est probablement présent à Shandora mais son rôle actif n'est pas précisé dans le résumé. Seto et Mousse sont des personnages secondaires Shandiens présents dans cet arc ; leur présence dans CE chapitre spécifique est probable mais non confirmée par le résumé seul. Le Poneglyph de Shandora est présent physiquement dans la ville mais n'est pas explicitement mentionné dans ce résumé comme élément central de l'action.

title: I'm Right Here
summary: Mont Blanc Noland leaves Jaya and prepares to set sail towards North Blue. Mousse tells her father Kalgara the reason why Noland and his crew cut down the trees of their ancestors. Kalgara races to tell Noland he will ring the Golden Bell every day, until Noland's return.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Mousse révèle à Kalgara la vraie raison pour laquelle Noland et son équipage ont abattu les arbres ancestraux (probablement pour éradiquer la fièvre des arbres/Tree Fever), résolvant le malentendu entre les deux peuples.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ce chapitre s'inscrit dans le flashback de Noland (arc Skypiea). Les personnages présents sont tous des figures historiques d'il y a 400 ans. Nola (le serpent) est mentionnée dans le contexte mais son rôle actif dans ce chapitre spécifique n'est pas confirmé par le résumé. La révélation sur la raison de l'abattage des arbres (Tree Fever) est un moment clé du flashback. Le cliffhanger porte sur Kalgara courant pour promettre à Noland de sonner la cloche d'or chaque jour jusqu'à son retour — moment émotionnel fort. L'arc est techniquement 'Sky Island/Skypiea' et non 'East Blue Saga' comme indiqué dans les métadonnées du chapitre.

title: To Meet, like the Half-Moon Hidden by Clouds
summary: Mont Blanc Noland returns to Jaya with the king of Lvneel, but finds Shandora missing. Unknown to him, the entire city had actually been shot into the sky by the Knock Up Stream.

taxonomy.revelation_description: La cité de Shandora n'a pas disparu de façon mystérieuse : elle a été propulsée dans le ciel par le Knock Up Stream, ce qui explique l'existence de Skypiea/Upper Yard.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ce chapitre est entièrement un flashback racontant le retour de Noland à Jaya avec le roi de Lvneel pour constater la disparition de Shandora. La révélation centrale est que la ville a été envoyée dans le ciel par le Knock Up Stream, liant directement ce flashback à l'arc Skypiea. Le Roi de Lvneel est probablement présent mais peu caractérisé. Nola (le serpent) et d'autres habitants de Jaya/Shandia peuvent apparaître brièvement. L'arc catalogué comme 'East Blue Saga' semble inexact — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Skypiea/Jaya du Grand Line Saga.

title: Bolero
summary: Wyper learns of Mont Blanc Noland's fate and Kalgara's dying wish in a flashback, reaffirming his desire to stop Enel.  Enel focuses his destruction on a few key areas, before setting his sights on the Golden Bell. Luffy continues to climb the Giant Jack to reach the Golden Bell before Enel does, with Nami close on his tail.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Wyper apprend le destin de Mont Blanc Noland et le vœu mourant de Kalgara, renforçant la connexion historique entre les Shandiens et la Cloche d'Or
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est bref. Le 'fight_occurs' est mis à false car il n'est pas décrit de combat direct dans ce chapitre — seulement une course vers la Cloche d'Or. Enel utilise le Goro Goro no Mi pour concentrer sa destruction mais aucun combat explicite n'est mentionné. Le flashback concerne le destin de Mont Blanc Noland et le vœu de Kalgara, tous deux présents en flashback. L'arc est Skypiea (Grand Line), non East Blue comme indiqué dans le titre du chapitre.

title: Raigo
summary: Enel reaches the top of Giant Jack only to find nothing, but manages to see Luffy just below him. Enel then proceeds to attack him using his Goro Goro no Mi powers to knock him off edge of the cloud. Despite being knocked off, Luffy manages to get back onto the cloud. He is then greeted by Nami who had ran over him with the Waver, and she tells him they must get away. Luffy refuses because he wants to ring the Golden Bell, as it will send a message to Mont Blanc Cricket to prove that the tale of his ancestor Mont Blanc Noland finding the Legendary Golden City, Shandora, wasn't a lie.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est court et focalisé sur Luffy vs Enel au sommet du Giant Jack. La présence de Wyper, Robin, Usopp, Sanji, Gan Fall, Aisa, Kalgara est listée dans les personnages détectés mais non confirmée dans le résumé textuel — taggés avec réserve. Nami frappe Luffy en le renversant avec le Waver, ce qui constitue une interaction physique comique. Kalgara est probablement absent du chapitre actuel (il est décédé et pourrait n'apparaître qu'en flashback), mais le résumé ne le confirme pas. Mont Blanc Cricket et Noland sont mentionnés narrativement comme motivation de Luffy. L'arc est Skypiea (Grand Line), pas East Blue — le scraper semble avoir mal classifié l'arc.

title: Giant Jack
summary: Luffy tries to board Enel's Ark Maxim, but Enel does not allow him to board the ark. Enel finds the Golden Bell of Shandora. Luffy and Nami send a message to everyone below the Giant Jack to cut Giant Jack westward. The Straw Hats, Wyper and Gan Fall begin attacking the stalk so it can fall westward.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est succinct. La présence de Zoro, Robin, Chopper, Usopp et Aisa est inférée du contexte (les 'Straw Hats' attaquent le Giant Jack aux côtés de Wyper et Gan Fall). Enel utilise implicitement son fruit Goro Goro no Mi pour repousser Luffy. Mont Blanc Cricket, Masira, Shoujou sont mentionnés dans la liste du scraper mais leur présence physique dans ce chapitre n'est pas confirmée par le résumé — exclus des personnages présents. La découverte de la cloche dorée par Enel est un élément de lore notable mais pas une révélation majeure au sens strict (elle était déjà connue comme objectif).

title: High-Altitude Situation
summary: Zoro cuts half of the Giant Jack, yet it does not fall down. Nola has a flashback to ringing the Shandorian Bell and crashes her head into the Giant Jack. Wyper uses a Reject Dial once more and the Giant Jack finally begins to fall.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très court. Seuls Zoro, Nola et Wyper sont mentionnés comme actifs dans ce chapitre. Les autres personnages listés par le scraper (Luffy, Nami, Robin, Chopper, Usopp, Gan Fall, Aisa, etc.) ne sont pas confirmés présents dans ce résumé. Nola a un flashback dans lequel elle se souvient d'avoir sonné la Cloche d'Or Shandorienne. Le Reject Dial utilisé par Wyper est une technique/arme déjà établie, pas nouvelle. Le Giant Jack commence à tomber, ce qui constitue un cliffhanger d'action.

title: Praises of the Earth
summary: Luffy stops Enel's Raigo using the Golden Ball that has been stuck on his hand.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très court (une seule phrase). Le chapitre 297 correspond à la fin de l'arc Skypiea où Luffy bloque le Raigo d'Enel avec la boule d'or soudée à son poing. La liste des personnages présents est déduite du contexte de l'arc à ce stade (observateurs sur Giant Jack, Nami, Aisa, etc.) mais le résumé ne les confirme pas tous explicitement. L'arc Skypiea appartient à la Saga Alabasta / Grand Line début — le champ 'arc_ends' reste false car ce chapitre n'est pas la conclusion finale. Giant Jack, Shandora, Shandorian Golden Belfry Bell, Maxim et Waver sont des lieux/objets et non des personnages, écartés de characters_detailed.

characters_detailed.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters_detailed.power_used: Gomu Gomu no Mi — Golden Ball block (utilisation de la boule d'or collée à son poing pour contrer le Raigo)

title: Fantasia
summary: Enel is defeated and the sound of the Shandorian Golden Belfry Bell, though 400 years late, is heard.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Le son de la Cloche Dorée de Shandora retentit enfin, 400 ans après avoir été réduite au silence, marquant l'accomplissement de la promesse de Noland et Kalgara.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très court (une seule phrase). Les tags sont inférés à partir du contexte encyclopédique de la fin de l'arc Skypiea. Plusieurs personnages listés par le scraper (South Bird, Mont Blanc Noland, Shandora, giants, Maxim, world) sont des entités/lieux/concepts plutôt que des personnages actifs dans ce chapitre. Straw Hats count limité à Luffy et Nami visibles dans le résumé, mais d'autres membres pourraient être présents. Arc marqué comme terminé car c'est le chapitre de conclusion de Skypiea.

title: I Was Here
summary: The Straw Hat Pirates try to steal the gold and treasure from the ruins of Shandora. Robin is with the Shandia, who recently found the Shandorian Golden Belfry Bell. The bell is revealed to have a poneglyph in it. Robin deciphers the poneglyph and explains how the poneglyphs are connected. She also finds out that the Shandia's battle for the protection of the bell has long been won and that Gol D. Roger knew how to read Poneglyphs. Robin then arrives with the Shandia and the Straw Hats think they are chasing after them, so they make a run for it. The Shandia are confused as to why the Straw Hats would want to run away and not want to take their offering of a gold pillar. Robin laughs and says that it's possible that they don't want it anymore. The Straw Hats continue running away.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Robin deciphers the poneglyph inside the Shandorian Golden Belfry Bell, revealing the connection between poneglyphs, that the Shandia's ancestral mission to protect the bell has long been fulfilled, and that Gol D. Roger could read poneglyphs.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The arc_ends flag is set to true as this chapter appears to be a concluding/epilogue chapter of the Skypiea arc. Gol D. Roger's mention is indirect (Robin's discovery from the poneglyph). The ancient_weapon_mentioned flag is set to true as Pluton and Poseidon were referenced in the scraper list and are contextually associated with the poneglyph revelations. The Will of D. is flagged as mentioned since Roger's ability to read poneglyphs and the connection to the Void Century is referenced. Road Poneglyph is false — this is a regular poneglyph, not a Road Poneglyph. title: Combat<nowiki>!!!</nowiki>
summary: In a brief flashback, Luffy and Usopp stand in awe at the various props before them in the "Resting Room" aboard the Sexy Foxy. The Foxy Pirate that is present explains to them that the contestants must wear boxing gloves, but aside from that they are allowed to dress up however they'd like for the fight. Usopp spots an afro, and asks Luffy how he looks as he puts it on. Luffy is absolutely blown away, telling Usopp he looks cool. Usopp states that the hairstyle will unlock one's deepest latent powers, and encourages Luffy that the afro will make his punch stronger. Luffy is ecstatic in his belief of Usopp, telling the latter that he was even talking differently while wearing the afro.  In the present, both contestants have entered the arena for the final round of the Davy Back Fight, the Battle Round. On Luffy's side, Usopp is proud of his role as coach; warning his opponent about the power of Luffy's punch, while Luffy himself is anxious to start the fight. On Foxy's side, he cracks his neck and compliments Luffy for his battle-ready appearance. In the stands, Zoro wonders how Usopp became the coach, while Sanji and Chopper enthusiastically cheer for their captain. Nami on the other hand wonders if Luffy actually takes anything seriously, though Robin is very amused at her captain's new appearance.  Usopp begins issuing another warning to Foxy, though he is cut off as Itomimizu announces that it is time for all noncontestants to exit the ring. Itomimizu takes this time to reiterate the rules of the Battle Round: the entirety of the Sexy Foxy is part of the arena (including the rooms below deck), as well as everything within a 100 meter radius of the ship's mast. Additionally, the Battle Round has no time limit, it ends when a contestant scores one point (knocking the opponent out of the arena). The audience stand rises up, both to give the audience a better view of the fight, but also so that only the contestants remain in the terrain of the arena.  Foxy repeats to Luffy that the entirety of the ship is in play, and he may fight as he pleases without worry of breaking anything. As Luffy acknowledges, both crews cheer on their contestants, with Nami reminding Luffy to watch out for his opponent's "Noro Noro Beam". Itomimizu sets the stage once more announcing the fight, and it finally begins upon the ringing of a bell. Luffy immediately attempts a Gomu Gomu no Pistol, but Foxy uses his Noro Noro Beam on Luffy's fist, allowing him to easily dodge. Luffy is shocked that his fist has become slow and won't return to him, while Foxy explains that the effect is worse with the more effort that Luffy exerts. Luffy falls down as he reels from the effects, only for Foxy to prepare another beam. Still unable to move his arm, Luffy attempts to dodge by jumping in the air. Foxy simply redirects the beam however, catching Luffy mid-air and upside down. The Straw Hats are unsettled by this new development, most notably Zoro, who points out that the beams are reducing the speed of Luffy's actions. Still unsure of what's going on, Luffy questions Foxy's actions, though his speech pattern is extremely slowed as well. Foxy unleashes the "Foxy Rush", a barrage of punches on Luffy's face. Sanji notes that punches are having no effect, but Zoro points out that the effects are probably being slowed down as well. Foxy confirms this, and states that Luffy is done for even if he is a rubber man. Foxy announces that 30 seconds have gone by, and Luffy's body is immediately rocked from the impact of the flurry of punches as he goes flying. Sanji makes a note of the 30 second rule, while Chopper panics that Luffy's body will fall into the sea at this rate. Luffy is able to catch his fall by extending his arm to grab the ship, surprising many of the Foxy Pirates with his Devil Fruit ability. Luffy states that the Noro Noro Beam is stronger than he anticipated, and resolves not to stretch himself too much for easy retaliation. He runs further onto the ship looking for Foxy, but arrows suddenly fly towards him that he barely manages to dodge. Luffy spots Foxy floating toward him on a cannonball, and notes that he must have used the Noro Noro Beam on it to do so. Because of this Luffy believes that he can jump on the cannonballs as well, but the Noro Noro effect wears off on the one he chooses. He catches a different cannonball to break his fall, but the same thing happens, causing Luffy to crash into the deck of the ship.  As Luffy rises to his feet, Foxy uses another weapon, the "Foxy Face Bomb", and it shoots miniature versions of Foxy's head at Luffy. Luffy wonders why they resemble the souvenir pins he bought, and one of the heads responds that they are bombs. As Luffy ponders why the bombs can talk, one of the heads is revealed to be Foxy himself, who lands a hard punch to Luffy's face. Foxy reveals that he has exchanged his boxing gloves for spiked ones, and also that the 30 seconds for the Foxy Face Bombs are now up. Luffy is caught in a powerful explosion, prompting Nami to show concern for her captain. Itomimizu notes that all the bombs landed direct hits, and says that Foxy is winning the fight.

L'arc est en cours, le combat n'est pas terminé.

title: The City of Water, Water 7
summary: Before leaving, Kokoro hands the Straw Hat Pirates a simple map and letter of recommendation. As they bid farewell, the Straw Hats are warned that Marines may be on Water 7. After visiting this strange train station of the sea, Luffy and friends leave the Shift Station to resume their search for a new shipmate. Destination: the City of Water, Water 7. In comical fashion, the Straw Hats discuss their ideal mechanic, Sanji wanting the "hottest babe" and Luffy wanting a man that's sixteen feet tall. Zoro however states the main concern is finding a good carpenter willing to join pirates. Nami has a look at the map Kokoro gave them only to realize it is completely useless. Luffy shows a sketch of his ideal mechanic, although it looks anything but human, to his worried and amused crew. Nami then calls them to get their week's spending money. As the crew remember all of the adventures they have had with Going Merry, they begin to imagine what it will be like after the repairs. Just then, Zoro spots Water 7 and the crew stare in amazement. A resident out fishing informs them how to enter and while passing through the streets, they realize that the buildings are built on submerged buildings. Another resident, after checking their intentions, tells them there is a small peninsula they can dock on. After docking, Zoro accidentally breaks the mast showing how much damage the Going Merry has taken on their travels. While trying to fix the mast, the others discuss that there must be really strong people in Water 7 for the residents not to fear pirates. It is decided that Luffy, Usopp and Nami will take the gold to get exchanged and the letter to Iceburg, the man Kokoro mentioned. Meanwhile in the city, the residents alert each other of trouble at dock 1 and race of to see. At the dock, the captain of the Big Helmet Pirates, Mikazuki, refuses to pay for the repairs the carpenters done. Iceburg is told about the chaos by a woman, Kalifa. The man in goggles states that they will not take the refusal silently and he along with the other carpenters easily defeat the Big Helmet Pirates. The name of the Water 7's shipwrights is the Galley-La Company.

title: Luffy vs. Usopp
summary: An angered Nami rants at Luffy, trying to stop the upcoming duel, but Luffy does not pay much attention to it. As she continues to complain, he tells her to stop, explaining that there is no turning back and remembering Usopp telling Luffy that he will return at 10 PM to fight. He continues that Usopp would not give his life and tells Nami to "chill" which silences her. On deck, Zoro and Sanji have an argument about Zoro's first encounter with the Franky Family, blaming each other for not taking them out then. Nami interrupts the pair as Chopper returns from trying to treat the heavily injured Usopp and being sent away, tearfully explaining Usopp's rejection of their friendship. Nami comments on it feeling like the whole group is falling apart. At ten o'clock, Usopp returns to duel Luffy, who is already waiting for him in front of the Going Merry. The two exchange words, with Usopp stating that he will be the victor and explaining that unlike those Luffy's past opponents, he knows how to fight him. The others watch on as Usopp starts the fight with a lie. Chopper believes him and is told to go inside. As Luffy charges, Usopp starts to attack him but suddenly collapses and coughs up some blood, causing the others to panic and Luffy to stop his attack. Usopp reveals it was just ketchup, blinds Luffy using a Flash Dial, and shoots rotten eggs at him. Angered, Luffy tells him to fight seriously, but Usopp explains that this is his actual fighting style before firing tabasco into Luffy's mouth. This causes him to fall onto Usopp's "Caltrop Hell", and Usopp says he plans to win via any means possible. The others comment on how fast Usopp's attacks have been. As Luffy stumbles to his feet, Usopp fires a shuriken that Luffy avoids just in time. While catching his breath, Luffy notices clouds of gas surrounding him. Because of the rotten eggs masking the smell of gas, Usopp was able to spread it around him without it being detected. Usopp ignites the gas with fire, causing the area to explode and shocking the other Straw Hats, who can do nothing but watch. As the pair sit exhausted after the blast, the Going Merry is seen with water running off of it, giving the impression it is crying.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le duel Luffy vs Usopp commence dans ce chapitre mais ne se termine pas. Usopp utilise des Dials (Flash Dial notamment) et des techniques de tromperie. Luffy utilise son Fruit du Démon implicitement en chargeant. Le Going Merry est personnifié à la fin avec l'eau 'pleurant' sur sa coque — élément émotionnel fort. La Franky Family est mentionnée dans une discussion mais n'est pas physiquement présente dans ce chapitre. Robin est absente du résumé. Le scraper incluait 'Going Merry', 'Dials', 'Franky Family' et 'Straw Hat Pirates' comme personnages, mais ce sont des éléments/groupes plutôt que des personnages individuels présents physiquement.
