taxonomy.tagger_notes: Smoker and Tashigi are listed in the scraper's detected characters but do not appear to be physically present in the chapter based on the summary — they may appear briefly or their mention may stem from the scraper detecting names elsewhere (e.g., cover page or next chapter preview). Marked as present but with low confidence. The 'character_return' flag is set true for Smoker and Tashigi as recurring characters reappearing in a new arc. The dragon confronting the group at the end is treated as a new character introduction. The stabbed samurai is off-screen and unconfirmed dead but implied. Arc classification as 'East Blue Saga' in the prompt appears erroneous — Punk Hazard is a New World / Dressrosa Saga arc; tagged sea_region accordingly.

title: Adventure on the Burning Island
summary: Luffy and Zoro battle the dragon, and find out it can talk. It takes off, but Luffy takes it down by making it bite its own wing and Zoro finishes it by cutting its head off. Back at the Thousand Sunny, Franky, Chopper, Nami, and Sanji are captured by some unknown figures, leaving Brook behind. After defeating the dragon, the group finds a pair of legs that does not have the top part of its body and the chapter ends with the legs running away.

taxonomy.revelation_description: A talking dragon exists on Punk Hazard, and a pair of disembodied legs is found running around the island independently
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Trafalgar Law and Caesar Clown are listed by the scraper but do not appear in the chapter summary — excluded from characters_present. The arc tag says 'East Blue Saga' but chapter 656 is clearly part of the Punk Hazard Arc (New World). The dragon is a creature, not a named antagonist at this stage. The disembodied legs are later revealed to be part of Trafalgar Law's Ope Ope no Mi ability, but that information is not in this chapter's summary. Unknown figures capturing Franky, Chopper, Nami and Sanji are not yet identified.

title: Severed Head
summary: On Punk Hazard, Luffy, Zoro, Usopp, and Robin continue their exploration and discover that the other half of the island is actually frozen and mountainous. Meanwhile, Sanji, Nami, Chopper, and Franky discover a severed samurai's head (somehow still living) while in captivity. In their quest to escape their confinement, Franky blasts a way out and the group runs into a room of gigantic children. Brook, however, is nowhere to be found.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Punk Hazard is divided into two halves: one side is burning and the other is frozen and mountainous. A living severed samurai's head is discovered, suggesting unusual supernatural circumstances on the island. Giant children are found in captivity.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The samurai head is later confirmed to be Kinemon (or part of him), though his full name is not given in this chapter. The devil fruit angle for the living severed head is ambiguous at this stage — it could be Ope Ope no Mi effects (Law) or Kinemon's own powers; tagged as unknown fruit. Brook's absence from both groups is noted as a plot point. Franky blasting through a wall is treated as a minor fight action rather than a full combat. Giant children discovery is a major mystery setup. Monet and Law are not confirmed to physically appear in this chapter based on the summary, so they are excluded from characters_present despite being detected by the scraper.

characters_detailed.name: Kinemon (Samurai Head)
characters_detailed.power_used: Unknown ability keeping severed head alive

title: Trafalgar Law, Warlord of the Sea
summary: Nami and Chopper continue to escort the children out of the building, while the children explain how they got here. They encounter a room encased in ice with corpses frozen inside all around them, making the children afraid to go in. Back at the Biscuits Room, Sanji and Franky manage to defeat their pursuers, but Sanji gets aggravated by the samurai head. Meanwhile, Smoker interrogates Law, demanding him to let them pass. Nami, Sanji, Chopper and Franky then emerge out of the door, surprising both the Marines and Law. The Marines start the pursuit, but are stopped by Law's improved "Room". Smoker and Law then prepare to fight.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Luffy n'apparaît pas physiquement dans ce chapitre selon le résumé. L'arc est Punk Hazard (New World), bien que le scraper mentionne 'East Blue Saga' par erreur. Kin'emon est présent sous forme de tête de samouraï (tête parlante) interagissant avec Sanji. Les corps gelés dans la pièce de glace sont visibles mais non identifiés. Tashigi est présente avec le groupe G-5 de Smoker. Le combat Sanji/Franky vs poursuivants se conclut dans ce chapitre, tandis que Law vs Smoker commence en cliffhanger.

title: Warlord Law Vs. Vice Admiral Smoker
summary: Tashigi is cut in half by Law with his ability when she tells him to kill her, but Law refuses saying that weaklings cannot choose how they die. Law fights with Smoker, while the other Marines escape Law's circle, along with Tashigi's body. Luffy and the others got Brownbeard to carry them across the tundra after stealing warm clothes, and wondered what happened to Nami and the others. Monet has been spying on Luffy and goes back to headquarters where she explains the situation to her gaseous master. Meanwhile, Smoker questions Law's reasons for being on Punk Hazard and Law seems to be at a disadvantage until he manages to use his powers to extract Smoker's heart. Smoker falls to the ground, defeated, just as Luffy's group arrives. Luffy recognizes Law and is happy to see him.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Chopper n'est pas mentionné dans le résumé mais est probablement présent avec le groupe Luffy — non inclus par sécurité. Caesar Clown est présent via Monet qui lui rapporte la situation mais ne semble pas apparaître physiquement. Le 'retour' de Law est notable car c'est sa réapparition depuis le Marineford/timeskip. L'arc est Punk Hazard, non East Blue Saga — le scraper indique incorrectement l'arc.

title: CC
summary: While riding on Brownbeard, Luffy spots Law, and starts shouting out to him, thanking him for saving him during the war at Marineford. He explains to the others about how he is indebted to him, Law only reacts to this with a cold stare. Law reminds the Straw Hats and Brownbeard that they are all pirates and should be careful around each-other, Luffy still does not change his bright smile and behavior towards Law and thanks him once again. The G5 marines return to see Smoker lying on the ground, Luffy notices this too. Tashigi jumps onto Law and tries to attack him, but in vain. Law asks the Straw Hats to go around the back of the lab, to which Luffy agrees and leaves, shouting that they'll meet again. Inside of the laboratory building, the Straw Hats with switched bodies are running with the confused children, who also notice something about the Straw Hats is different. They stop since a lot of children had started to feel cold and tired, seeing this, the samurai's head asks the children to put a rock or leaf on their head, which they agree to, the samurai shouts "poof" and the children and straw hats are suddenly covered in coats and shoes. They meet up with the other Straw Hats and summarize everything that has happened to their respective groups until now. The samurai from Wano gets his legs back, much to Luffy's grief. The samurai reveals that he is here to find his missing son, Momonosuke and that Law is now a Warlord. He says that Law sliced up his body into three pieces. The G5 Marines have escaped and Smoker and Tashigi's bodies have also been switched. The mastermind behind everything that is happening on this island is revealed to be Caesar Clown.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Caesar Clown est révélé comme le cerveau de tout ce qui se passe sur l'île. Law est révélé Shichibukai. Kin'emon révèle qu'il cherche son fils Momonosuke et que Law l'a découpé en trois morceaux. Smoker et Tashigi ont eu leurs corps échangés.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc indiqué par le scraper est 'East Blue Saga' mais le chapitre 663 appartient à l'arc Punk Hazard (New World/Dressrosa Saga). Corrigé dans sea_region et locations. Certains membres des Straw Hats ont leurs corps échangés (notamment Nami dans le corps de Franky ou autre), mais le résumé ne détaille pas précisément qui est dans quel corps — Zoro, Robin, Usopp sont mentionnés comme présents dans le laboratoire. Momonosuke est mentionné mais seulement par son nom (comme fils recherché), il n'apparaît pas physiquement dans ce résumé. Caesar Clown est révélé mais sa présence physique directe n'est pas décrite — il est nommé comme cerveau de l'opération. Bepo est listé comme présent car il accompagne Law. Le nombre de Straw Hats est difficile à préciser exactement depuis ce résumé (Luffy + plusieurs autres dont Zoro, Robin, Usopp au minimum).

characters_detailed.name: Trafalgar D. Water Law
characters_detailed.affiliation: Heart Pirates / Seven Warlords of the Sea

title: Master Caesar Clown
summary: While Smoker, Tashigi, and the G-5 Marines try to determine the reason for the children's presence on the island, the Straw Hats examine Brownbeard and learn more about the history of Punk Hazard. Caesar Clown then uses one of the defeated centaurs as a test subject.

taxonomy.revelation_description: L'histoire de Punk Hazard est révélée via Brownbeard, incluant le rôle de Caesar Clown sur l'île ; Caesar utilise un centaure vaincu comme cobaye pour une expérience.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est succinct. L'arc est Punk Hazard (pas East Blue Saga — le scraper semble avoir mal tagué l'arc). Caesar Clown est le personnage le plus mis en avant en termes narratifs. La liste des Straw Hats présents n'est pas précisément détaillée dans le résumé ; Luffy, Zoro et Usopp sont mentionnés explicitement, Kin'emon est listé par le scraper. Les personnages comme Hawkins, Vegapunk et World Noble apparaissent dans la liste du scraper mais ne sont pas mentionnés dans le résumé — ils sont exclus du tagging actif. Basil Hawkins et Vegapunk non confirmés présents physiquement dans ce chapitre.

title: Yeti Cool Brothers
summary: The Yeti Cool Brothers report that they have successfully killed Zoro, Nami, and Brook. Caesar Clown discusses the Straw Hats with Monet and Law, and recalls the time Law arrived on Punk Hazard. Nami and Chopper learn about the Yeti Cool Brothers from Brownbeard, just before they appear and shoot him on Caesar's orders. The brothers attack the remaining Straw Hats when they return, and kidnap Nami in the confusion. Law sets off on his own, slicing up one of Caesar's subordinates in the process.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Caesar Clown recalls the circumstances of Law's arrival on Punk Hazard, hinting at Law's past dealings with Caesar.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The arc is Punk Hazard, not East Blue Saga — the scraper's arc label is incorrect. Zoro, Brook and Nami are reported dead by the Yeti Cool Brothers but this is likely a ruse (no confirmed deaths). Law's flashback covers his arrival on Punk Hazard. Vegapunk is not physically present but may be referenced. Franky's presence is inferred from 'remaining Straw Hats' but not explicitly named in the summary.

title: COOL FIGHT
summary: Luffy and Franky go after the Yeti Cool Brothers to get back Nami. During the fight against the Yeti Cool Brothers, Luffy manages to control the fight despite Franky rampaging (as he transformed into Chopper's Monster Point), only for Scotch to make an escape up the mountainside with Nami. However, as he reaches the peak, Law appears and intercepts him, defeating the yeti. When Luffy catches up, Law makes an offer to Luffy to take down one of the Four Emperors.

devil_fruit_names: Hito Hito no Mi (Monster Point via Rumble Ball)
taxonomy.revelation_description: Law propose à Luffy une alliance pour renverser l'un des Quatre Empereurs
locations: sommet de la montagne de Punk Hazard
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Franky a utilisé le Monster Point de Chopper après avoir pris un Rumble Ball (suite des événements précédents où son cerveau avait été transplanté dans le corps de Chopper). L'arc est Punk Hazard (New World), non East Blue — le scraper indique 'East Blue Saga' mais c'est une erreur manifeste. La proposition d'alliance de Law est une révélation majeure mais l'alliance n'est pas encore formée. Scotch et Rock sont les deux frères Yeti Cool Brothers. Armement Haki utilisé implicitement par Law lors de la défaite de Scotch. Caesar Clown, Brownbeard, Smoker, Vegapunk et Rayleigh sont mentionnés dans le contexte de l'arc mais n'apparaissent pas physiquement dans ce chapitre selon le résumé.

characters_detailed.name: Franky
characters_detailed.power_used: Monster Point (Rumble Ball dans le corps de Chopper)

title: Blizzard With a Chance of Slime
summary: After arriving, Luffy is attacked by Tashigi and Smoker who were in each other's bodies (much to Luffy's amusement). Luffy evades their attacks and says he will fight Smoker when he is back in his own body. Franky manages to break down the lab entrance with his laser and calls Luffy and Robin to come. Suddenly, everyone on the battlefield sees a huge ball of slime land on the ship that the G-5 Marines stole. After being ignited by a Marine's flamethrower, it explodes violently, destroying the ship. Afterwards more huge slime balls begin raining from the sky on all sides and the people watching are overwhelmed by the toxic gas emitted from them. Caesar Clown then reveals himself on top of the destroyed ship, explaining his pet's ability to transfer itself from the other side of the island. Zoro, Brook, and Sanji see the Slime spitting pieces of itself across the distance. Caesar exclaims that once all the pieces are here, the whole area will turn into another poison gas incident. Luffy then manages to grab Caesar, much to his shock.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Caesar Clown révèle que son 'pet' Smiley peut se transférer lui-même par morceaux depuis l'autre côté de l'île, et que son rassemblement provoquera un incident de gaz toxique similaire à un précédent évènement
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Smoker et Tashigi sont dans les corps de l'autre (effet du Fruit de Trafalgar Law). Le fruit de Smiley est probablement le Sara Sara no Mi modèle Axolotl mais son nom exact n'est pas cité dans le résumé. Luffy utilise Gear 2 selon la liste du scraper mais cela n'est pas explicitement mentionné dans le résumé. L'arc est Punk Hazard (New World), le scraper indique incorrectement 'East Blue Saga'.

characters_detailed.name: Tashigi
characters_detailed.power_used: Moku Moku no Mi (dans le corps de Smoker)

title: Gasu Gasu no Mi
summary: Slime continues to spit pieces of itself across the lake, poisoning the water in the process. Despite this, Sanji dives in and searches for the samurai's torso. Trafalgar Law asks Monet to accompany him through the laboratory, saying he has need of her "ability". Caesar Clown slips out of Luffy's hold, and demonstrates the combat abilities of his Devil Fruit as the two fight each other. Although Luffy appears unharmed after all of Caesar's poisonous and explosive attacks, he spontaneously collapses and Caesar laughs in triumph. Shortly after, Law suddenly falls down injured in the laboratory, before being confronted by a mysterious figure he recognizes.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le personnage mystérieux qui confronte Law à la fin est fortement suggéré être Vergo mais n'est pas confirmé nommément dans le résumé. Luffy s'effondre de manière inexpliquée malgré l'absence de dommages apparents — possiblement un effet indirect du Gasu Gasu no Mi (gaz accumulé dans l'air). Law est blessé de façon mystérieuse. Sanji est présent dans le lac mais sans rôle de combat. Tashigi et Smoker sont référencés indirectement via Vergo. Le chapitre porte le nom du fruit 'Gasu Gasu no Mi' mais ce n'est pas un nouveau fruit introduit — il est démontré en combat. Les membres Straw Hats en dehors de Sanji (Zoro, Nami, Usopp, Franky, Brook, Robin, Chopper) listés par le scraper ne semblent pas présents dans ce chapitre selon le résumé fourni.

title: <nowiki>My Name Is Kin'emon!!</nowiki>
summary: In the research facility, Law is confronted by the mysterious man, Vergo. Law desperately attempts to fight him, but is instantly defeated. Outside the facility, Caesar Clown has incapacitated Robin, Franky, Smoker, and Tashigi without touching any of them. At the lake, Sanji saves the samurai's torso from being eaten by a shark, and successfully escapes from the lake before the surface is completely covered by poison. The reconstructed samurai introduces himself as Kin'emon of Foxfire, and destroys the Slime around them with his Foxfire sword style.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Kin'emon se présente comme 'Kin'emon of Foxfire' et révèle son style d'épée capable de couper et de brûler le Slime de Smiley
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc attribué par le scraper est 'East Blue Saga' mais le chapitre 672 appartient à l'arc Punk Hazard (New World). Plusieurs personnages listés par le scraper (Brook, Zoro, Nami, Luffy, Monet, Smiley, Yeti Cool Brothers) ne semblent pas physiquement présents dans ce chapitre selon le résumé; ils ne sont pas inclus dans characters_present. Smiley est mentionné implicitement via le Slime mais n'apparaît pas directement. Caesar Clown utilise le Gasu Gasu no Mi pour incapaciter les personnages sans les toucher. Law utilise l'Ope Ope no Mi. Vergo est un Shichibukai de Doflamingo mais pas officiellement listé comme Shichibukai lui-même — c'est un sous-officiel de Doflamingo.

characters_detailed.name: Kin'emon
characters_detailed.technique_revealed: Foxfire Style (Kitsunebi-ryu) — flame sword technique that cuts and burns Slime

title: The Observers
summary: The children's withdrawal symptoms continue to overpower them, and they rampage against Usopp and Nami in the hopes of receiving candy from Caesar Clown. Nami prevents Usopp from retaliating, and convinces him to fight their real enemy, but Caesar uses his Devil Fruit ability to manipulate the oxygen levels around him, nullifying Usopp's Firebird Star and suffocating both Straw Hats. Brownbeard arrives in time to rescue them from being crushed by the children, but he is quickly defeated by Caesar. Caesar boards his airship with the children, and broadcasts a video message to brokers in various locations in the New World. He offers to demonstrate the power of his new poison gas weapon against those who have intruded on Punk Hazard, promising that the capabilities of his weapon will go beyond anything the World Government could ever produce.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Caesar Clown broadcasts a video message to New World brokers promising to demonstrate a new poison gas weapon capable of surpassing anything the World Government can produce, revealing the political and criminal scope of his ambitions.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Arc is incorrectly labeled 'East Blue Saga' by the scraper — chapter 674 is firmly within the Punk Hazard arc (New World). Luffy is absent from this chapter's action. Tamago, Pekoms, and Eustass Kid appear only as recipients of Caesar's broker broadcast and are briefly visible; they are included as present but not as combat participants. NHC10 children act as a mob/obstacle but are not individually named combattants. Monet's presence is implied contextually but not explicitly confirmed by the summary; tagged as present with low confidence.

characters_detailed.name: Caesar Clown
characters_detailed.power_used: Gasu Gasu no Mi (oxygen manipulation / suffocation)

title: I Call It "Shinokuni"
summary: Caesar Clown and the children disembark from the Flying Gas Balloon, and enter the research laboratory. The children are told by Caesar that their candy that they've been craving for is located in the Biscuits Room, and they all hurry there eagerly except Mocha, who somehow resists the addictive drug. She tries to escape and screams out to Nami and Usopp for help. In the laboratory, Caesar meets with Monet and Vergo, ready to start the experiment. He reveals that he knows all of Law's plans thanks to Monet's abilities, and thanks Law for naïvely giving him his heart as part of their contract. Caesar resumes his broadcast to the brokers, explaining that by eating the special bait he prepared, Smiley will become Shinokuni; a stronger poisonous gas weapon than it was four years ago. Smiley continues to chase after Sanji, Zoro, Brook, and Kin'emon, before spotting a giant sweet in the distance. Ignoring Caesar's order, it consumes it in a single gulp.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Caesar révèle qu'il connaît le plan de Law grâce aux capacités de Monet, et que Smiley va se transformer en Shinokuni, une arme gazeuse encore plus puissante qu'il y a quatre ans, en consommant un appât spécial.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Smoker, Vegapunk, Den Den Mushi et les brokers sont mentionnés contextuellement mais pas présents physiquement dans ce chapitre. L'arc est l'arc Punk Hazard (New World), non East Blue Saga comme indiqué — le scraper semble avoir renseigné un arc incorrect. Smiley est un personnage/créature présent physiquement mais son rôle est ambigu (ni humain ni fruit du démon activé au sens strict, il EST une masse de gaz/slime vivante). Law est présent dans la réunion avec Caesar mais peu actif narrativement. Monet est une Shichibukai associée à Doflamingo, pas elle-même Shichibukai, mais Vergo est un agent de la Marine — aucun Shichibukai au sens strict n'est présent ; j'ai corrigé shichibukai_present à false a posteriori. Law est affilié à sa propre équipe mais est en accord temporaire avec Caesar.

characters_detailed.name: Smiley
characters_detailed.technique_revealed: Transformation en Shinokuni (amorcée par absorption de l'appât)
characters_detailed.power_used: Fruit du Démon Sara Sara no Mi, modèle Axolotl (transformation en cours)

title: The G-5 Spirit
summary: Caesar Clown, complaining over why the G-5 Marines were not in front of the gate, gets an emergency report from one of his subordinates that Luffy, his crew, Trafalgar Law, and the Marines have broken in and are going further. Shocked by the revelation of his sanctuary being invaded, Caesar orders the passage connecting building A and B to be closed and a wall to be blasted to allow Shinokuni to enter building A. As the Straw Hats fight against Caesar's gate defenders as well as the G-5 Marines blocking their way, an alarm is heard and the passage gate begins to close. Law tells Smoker that the enemy is planing to lock everyone up and they need to hurry to get everyone through the gate before the worst happens. They narrowly make it in building B, but some of Tashigi's Marines have perished in order to save her life.

locations: Punk Hazard - passage between A and B
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé indique 'Gear 2' dans la liste de personnages détectés mais aucune utilisation explicite n'est décrite dans le résumé textuel — non retenu comme devil_fruit_used. Plusieurs personnages listés par le scraper (Monet, Vergo, Chopper, Brook, Zoro, Kin'emon, Brownbeard, Smiley) ne sont pas confirmés présents dans le résumé fourni et ont été écartés du tagging actif. La mort de Marines de G-5 est confirmée dans le texte. Shinokuni est le gaz-arme et non un personnage. straw_hats_count estimé à 2 (Luffy + au moins un autre) faute de détail précis.

title: Marine G-5 Base Commander Vergo the Demon Bamboo
summary: In the passage connecting the building A and B blocks, the Straw Hats and Kin'emon ride on Brownbeard's back, much to his annoyance. Behind them, Tashigi and the remaining G-5 Marines are attacked by the dragon. The Marines celebrate the arrival of Vergo, believing he has come to save them, but are shocked when Vergo uses Shigan on his subordinates. Tashigi lunges at him, but Vergo defends against her by hardening his arm, then knocks her down. The G-5 Marines attack him, refusing to believe that he is Vergo, but are effortlessly defeated. Sanji arrives to rescue Tashigi, and kicks Vergo in the face with Diable Jambe. Luffy dashes through the B block with enough speed to set the ground behind him alight, while Smoker flies alongside him. Inside Caesar's laboratory, Caesar tells Monet to let Shinokuni into the connecting passage, even though Vergo is there. When Luffy and Smoker enter Caesar's laboratory, Smoker is disappointed to see that Vergo is not present, while Luffy immediately punches Caesar.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Vergo, la base G-5 Marine Commander, attaque ses propres subordonnés, révélant sa véritable allégeance à Caesar/Doflamingo.
locations: Passage reliant les blocs A et B
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Usopp, Zoro, Nami et Vegapunk sont listés par le scraper mais n'apparaissent pas dans le résumé — exclus de characters_present. Smiley mentionné uniquement par contexte. L'arc est Punk Hazard (New World), pas East Blue Saga — le scraper indique une erreur d'arc. Vergo utilise Shigan (technique de Rokushiki) et durcit son bras via Busoshoku Haki. Diable Jambe utilisé par Sanji. Le 'devil_fruit' de Smoker est le Moku Moku no Mi.

title: Luffy vs. Master
summary: Luffy begins to fight with Caesar, while Monet looks on. Smoker leaves them and sets out to find Vergo. Caesar uses his ability to create an explosion and then remove the oxygen from the surrounding area, forcing Luffy to fight from a distance. He prepares to attack with a hardened Jet Gatling, but Monet produces a wall to shield Caesar. She holds Luffy back while Caesar escapes, saying that Joker will kill her if she lets anything happen to him. In the connecting passage between the A and B-blocks, the B-block door closes whiles the A-block door slowly opens, allowing Shinokuni to enter the passage. Sanji and Vergo trade blows, and Vergo kicks hard enough to fracture Sanji's right leg. In the D-block, one of Caesar's subordinates announces over a broadcast that Law has entered the SAD Manufacturing Room. Law walks through the area with a smile on his face, while Caesar, Vergo and Monet realize what he is planning.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Law infiltre la salle de fabrication du SAD, révélant son véritable objectif sur Punk Hazard
locations: Punk Hazard - Passage entre blocs A et B
Punk Hazard - Salle de fabrication du SAD
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Punk Hazard (New World), non East Blue Saga — le scraper semble erroné sur ce point. Le Haki d'Armement est implicitement utilisé par Luffy (Jet Gatling durci) et Vergo (connu pour son utilisation intensive du Busoshoku). Doflamingo est mentionné via le surnom 'Joker' par Monet mais n'apparaît pas physiquement dans ce chapitre. Le Yuki Yuki no Mi de Monet est utilisé pour créer un mur de neige/glace. SAD est mentionné comme lieu et objectif mais n'est pas un personnage malgré sa présence dans la liste du scraper. Shinokuni désigne le gaz empoisonné qui entre dans le passage, non un personnage.

characters_detailed.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters_detailed.power_used: Gomu Gomu no Mi - Gear 2 (Jet Gatling)

characters_detailed.name: Caesar Clown
characters_detailed.power_used: Gasu Gasu no Mi (explosion, suppression d'oxygène)

characters_detailed.name: Monet
characters_detailed.power_used: Yuki Yuki no Mi (mur de neige)

title: Don't Do It, Vegapunk
summary: Smoker and Vergo begin their fight in the SAD Room. At the same time, Sanji, Tashigi, and the G-5 Marines are running through the battle torn B-block when a gas tank explodes, causing Shinokuni to be let in. Caesar Clown, sitting on the second floor of R-block with his subordinates (Vegapunk's old room), instructs that the doors to C and D-blocks be closed, driving everyone to the first floor of R-block where a trap is ready to expose them to Shinokuni. When one of Caesar's subordinates questions the nature of the gas, Caesar then makes a speech to his subordinates, saying that the poisonous gas bomb four years ago was Vegapunk's doing and that Caesar tried to stop him. However, in a flashback it is revealed that Caesar constructed the weapon himself, and when he was told to stop and banished from the science squad, he set it off. While the gates to C and D-blocks are closed, Luffy meets a small dragon who can talk.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Caesar Clown construit lui-même l'arme à gaz empoisonné il y a 4 ans et la déclenche après avoir été banni de l'équipe de Vegapunk, contredisant son propre discours qui en attribuait la responsabilité à Vegapunk.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Sengoku et Sakazuki sont listés par le scraper mais n'apparaissent pas dans le résumé — ils ne sont pas retenus comme présents. Shinokuni est un gaz/phénomène, non un personnage. Vegapunk n'apparaît pas physiquement mais est évoqué dans le discours de Caesar et dans le flashback. Momonosuke apparaît sous forme de petit dragon parlant — c'est sa première apparition sous cette forme, bien que son identité ne soit peut-être pas encore révélée au lecteur à ce stade. Le devil fruit de Momonosuke (dragon artificiel) n'est pas explicitement nommé ici. Le combat Smoker/Vergo débute seulement, pas de vainqueur. L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' est inexact pour ce chapitre qui appartient à l'arc Punk Hazard (New World), corrigé dans sea_region.

title: The Snow Woman in the Biscuits Room
summary: Monet and Zoro continue their battle, while Robin assures Nami and Chopper that she is fine. As Mocha continues to run from the berserk children, she has a flashback of Caesar Clown telling her and some other children about their illness, as well as when she met and made friends with the children. She then cries out pleading to the berserk children to go back to their normal selves. Meanwhile, Monet attempts to attack Nami and Chopper but Zoro blocks her attack and Nami responds with a Heat Ball, damaging Monet. Robin, Nami, and Chopper attempt to stop the children again, but Monet blocks the exit out of the Biscuits Room with a snow barrier. Monet then transforms into a terrifying demon-like snow woman, and attempts to bite Chopper and Nami but in vain. Robin stops Monet using her Hana Hana no Mi abilities. Zoro then cut down the snow barrier, allowing Robin, Nami, and Chopper to escape from the Biscuits Room and to chase after the children. Monet then comments that Zoro had not been on the offensive at all during his short battle with Monet. Suddenly, Sanji, the G-5 Marines and Tashigi arrive at the Biscuits Room. The Marines compliment Monet's beauty at which she blushes. However, she then transforms in her demonic snow body and attacks the Marines. Tashigi counterattacks with a Haki imbued attack, injuring Monet. The Marines seal up the entrance to the room and get ready to find the children. However, Tashigi declares that she will stay behind in the room and fight Monet.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Punk Hazard et non East Blue Saga — le scraper indique incorrectement 'East Blue Saga'. Caesar Clown apparaît uniquement en flashback dans le souvenir de Mocha, il n'est pas physiquement présent dans ce chapitre. Sind, Uzu, Doran, Konbu sont probablement des enfants berserk présents mais non nommés dans le résumé — non inclus dans characters_detailed faute de confirmation suffisante. Nami utilise son Art of Weather/Clima-Tact (Heat Ball) — taggé comme technique existante, pas nouvelle. Tashigi utilise le Haki d'Armement pour blesser Monet. Monet démontre une transformation 'démon' via son Yuki Yuki no Mi.

characters_detailed.power_used: Yuki Yuki no Mi — transformation démoniaque, barrière de neige

characters_detailed.name: Nico Robin
characters_detailed.power_used: Hana Hana no Mi — retient Monet

characters_detailed.power_used: Art of Weather / Clima-Tact — Heat Ball

title: Wild Beast
summary: Sanji is with Tashigi's subordinates as they try to reach the other Straw Hats. Sanji explains some of his motives and some of Zoro's own motives. In the Biscuits Room, Tashigi tells Zoro that she should fight Monet despite Zoro's protests. Zoro sits down and tells Tashigi to do what she wants. Monet attacks, and Tashigi is quickly outmatched. Monet bites Tashigi's shoulder, but Tashigi prevents permanent damage by holding on to Monet's head. Zoro then attacks Monet, slashing her on the cheek. Frozen by fear, Monet is then cut in half by Zoro. However, his attack was not imbued with Haki, so she does not die. Monet is then finished off by Tashigi.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Monet est battue mais pas confirmée morte dans ce chapitre — elle sera tuée plus tard par Caesar. Zoro n'utilise pas le Haki intentionnellement : c'est un point narratif clé du chapitre. L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' dans le prompt semble erroné — il s'agit de l'arc Punk Hazard (New World). Le scraper mentionne Nami, Robin et Loguetown mais ils ne sont pas présents dans le résumé du chapitre.

title: Mocha
summary: As Shinokuni begins to move into the Biscuits Room, Zoro escapes, carrying Tashigi. Meanwhile, Mocha is still running from the children while Robin, Chopper, and Nami hold them off. However, a group of children circle them and Mocha is forced to swallow all of the candy to prevent them from eating it. Mocha then remembers Chopper telling her that the candy was bad and that all of the children were going to die eventually. Luffy then appears with Momonosuke.

devil_fruit_names: Sara Sara no Mi, Model: Axolotl (Smiley)
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Shusui apparaît dans la liste du scraper mais il s'agit probablement de l'épée de Zoro mentionnée indirectement — non tagué comme personnage à part entière. Caesar Clown n'apparaît pas directement dans le résumé mais est probablement présent en toile de fond. Smiley est Shinokuni dans ce contexte (gaz toxique issu de Smiley). Le flashback de Mocha rappelant les paroles de Chopper est bref mais significatif. Les 'children' (enfants sous drogue) sont traités comme groupe combattant contre Mocha.

characters_detailed.name: Smiley
characters_detailed.power_used: Sara Sara no Mi, Model: Axolotl / Shinokuni gas

title: A Seemingly Non-Existent Island
summary: Brownbeard arrives in front of Caesar Clown and demands that he tell him what happened to his men outside on the island before Shinokuni was released. Caesar merely shrugs and says that he did not receive their distress call, when in truth he did receive it but left them to die outside. Angered by the callous disregard of the lives of his men, Brownbeard tries to reveal Caesar's true nature to the rest of the men protecting their "generous" master, but Caesar secretly injects a muscle relaxant into Brownbeard, making him spurt gibberish and be unable to stand. Now in control of the situation, Caesar whispers to Brownbeard that the poison gas incident was his doing. Brownbeard then furiously tries to attack Caesar, only to be shot down by the subordinates he swore to save. Feeling victorious, Caesar prepares to finish off Brownbeard, but a giant Haki-infused fist stops him. Luffy has arrived to finish the fight with Caesar. Caesar tells all his subordinates to head back up stairs and start the preparations. Once all the subordinates are gone, Caesar warns Luffy that if he fights him, one of the Four Emperors, as well as Doflamingo, will hunt Luffy down because the SAD that Caesar produces is used to turn his client's subordinates into Zoan users and taunts Luffy that he will never defeat all of them. Luffy remembers all the horrible things that he has heard that Caesar Clown has done and channels all his anger into a vicious punch on the mad scientist's face, shouting that he has been fighting people like them since entering the Grand Line.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Caesar révèle à Brownbeard que c'est lui qui est responsable de l'incident au gaz empoisonné, et que le SAD qu'il produit est utilisé pour transformer les subordonnés de ses clients en utilisateurs de Fruits du Démon Zoan — liant Caesar aux Quatre Empereurs et à Doflamingo.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le scraper liste 'Armament Haki', 'Four Emperors', 'Zoan', 'SAD', 'Grand Line', 'Gear 3', 'Kouzuki Momonosuke', 'Devil Fruits' comme personnages — ce sont des concepts/termes, pas des personnages physiquement présents. Momonosuke n'est pas mentionné dans le résumé. Gear 3 n'est pas explicitement nommé dans le résumé (seulement un 'giant Haki-infused fist'). Les Quatre Empereurs et Doflamingo sont mentionnés verbalement par Caesar comme menace future mais n'apparaissent pas physiquement. L'arc est Punk Hazard (New World), non East Blue Saga comme indiqué par le scraper.

characters_detailed.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters_detailed.power_used: Haki d'Armement (poing géant infusé de Haki)

characters_detailed.name: Caesar Clown
characters_detailed.affiliation: Underworld (client des Quatre Empereurs, associé de Doflamingo)
characters_detailed.power_used: injection de myorelaxant (technique chimique, non liée à un Fruit du Démon explicitement activé dans ce chapitre)

title: SAD
summary: Following Luffy's punch, Caesar's face has an imprint of a fist on it. Caesar tries again to intimidate Luffy with his connections before attacking him, but Luffy dodges the attack and punches Caesar again. Meanwhile, the rest of the Straw Hats and the G-5 Marines are heading towards Building R to escape Shinokuni. Brook and Kin'emon run the opposite way, as Kin'emon believes that he may have killed his son, who is now a dragon. Usopp enters the secret room of Building R looking for Seastone handcuffs and finds a nest of Caesar's subordinates. In the SAD production room, Vergo defeats Smoker, but Law manages to regain his heart due to Smoker's diversion. Law tells Doflamingo, who is listening via Den Den Mushi, that he is going to defeat Vergo, but Doflamingo laughs it off. Law then slices Vergo in two, cutting open the lab and the mountain around it in the process. Law then tells Doflamingo that he has destroyed the gears of the New World and that no one can fix it now.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Law détruit la salle de production du SAD, annonce à Doflamingo qu'il a brisé les rouages du Nouveau Monde et que personne ne peut le réparer, soulignant l'importance stratégique du SAD pour l'empire de Doflamingo.
locations: Punk Hazard - Salle de combat (bâtiment central)
Punk Hazard - Salle de production du SAD
Punk Hazard - Couloirs extérieurs (fuite de Shinokuni)
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Punk Hazard et non East Blue Saga — probable erreur du scraper. Momonosuke est mentionné indirectement (Kin'emon pense avoir tué son fils transformé en dragon) mais n'apparaît pas physiquement sous forme humaine. Vergo est vaincu (tranché en deux) mais non confirmé mort dans ce chapitre. Doflamingo est présent uniquement via Den Den Mushi (voix off). Le Haki d'Armement est mentionné implicitement dans le combat Vergo/Smoker/Law. straw_hats_count estimé à 3 (Luffy, Usopp, Brook visibles ; les autres membres fuient mais ne sont pas nommément décrits dans le résumé).

title: King of Shinokuni
summary: Following Law's attack, the mountains on Punk Hazard have been sliced in half, allowing Shinokuni to enter the facility. Zoro, carrying Tashigi, meets up with Sanji, Nami, Robin, and the G-5 Marines, and is told to turn around because he is going the wrong direction. In the SAD production room, Vergo has been defeated and cut into pieces by Law, but still tells the Shichibukai that he will fail because he does not know Doflamingo's past. Smoker and Law then leave, and Law tells Vergo that the room will soon be destroyed. Meanwhile, Caesar realizes that it must have been Law that cut open the laboratory, and then tells his men to open the air vents and allow Shinokuni to come in. His subordinates hesitate, then, believing that is all an act to deceive their enemies, follow his orders. Caesar then merges with Shinokuni and kills some of his men as an example to Luffy. Luffy turns and runs down a hallway away from Caesar. Usopp, on the upper floor of Building B, asks Caesar's subordinates to let him use the control panel. His subordinates wonder why Luffy is running, and Usopp states that Luffy will not run. Luffy then turns around, enters Gear 3, and prepares to attack Caesar with both arms.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Vergo hints that Doflamingo has a hidden past that Law is unaware of, suggesting a deeper secret to the Shichibukai's true power or origins.
locations: Punk Hazard - Building B upper floor
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Arc is actually Punk Hazard arc (part of Dressrosa Saga / New World), not East Blue Saga — the scraper's arc label is incorrect. Gear 3 is announced/prepared at the end of the chapter but not yet fully executed, tagged as technique initiated. Vergo is defeated (cut into pieces by Law) but not confirmed dead in this chapter, though his fate is implied. Caesar merging with Shinokuni (Shinokuni is a gas weapon, not a Devil Fruit awakening but rather Caesar using his Gasu Gasu no Mi to merge with the gas). Momonosuke and Brownbeard are listed by the scraper but not mentioned in the resume — kept out of characters_present. Chopper not explicitly mentioned in the resume either but listed in scraper; included cautiously given group context.

characters_detailed.name: Caesar Clown
characters_detailed.power_used: Gasu Gasu no Mi - merger with Shinokuni

title: The Most Dangerous Man
summary: The battle between Franky and Doflamingo's subordinates continues, as the rest of the Straw Hat Pirates and the G-5 Marines are escaping under a collapsing mountain. Caesar Clown stabs Monet's heart, thinking it was Smoker's, thus preventing the explosion. At the end of the chapter, Doflamingo decides to go over to Punk Hazard.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Caesar Clown accidentally stabs Monet's heart instead of Smoker's, killing her and preventing the island's explosion. Doflamingo decides to personally travel to Punk Hazard.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The arc label 'East Blue Saga' in the prompt appears to be an error — Punk Hazard is part of the Dressrosa Saga / New World. Tagged accordingly. Monet's death is treated as present/confirmed as Caesar stabs her heart in this chapter. The Buki Buki no Mi (Sugar's fruit) is mentioned as active via her involvement in the fight with Franky, though details are limited. Straw Hat count set to 1 (Franky) as he is the only individually named Straw Hat fighting; the rest are mentioned collectively as escaping.

title: Leave It to Us!!!
summary: Buffalo and Baby 5 continue fighting the General Franky, managing to pierce his armor. Franky blows them away with General Cannon, but the two get back up. Just then, Law, the Straw Hat Pirates, children, and G-5 Marines arrive outside, forcing both Buffalo and Baby 5 to retreat to Dressrosa with Caesar in tow. Law moves to take them out, but Usopp and Nami step up to do the job instead. Nami attacks first and knocks them out of the sky with Thunder Breed Tempo, and Usopp finishes them off with Shooting Star Rush. Out at sea, a shadowy figure on the sea has woken up and proceeds to head to Punk Hazard.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: La silhouette mystérieuse en mer à la fin du chapitre n'est pas identifiée dans le résumé — probablement Doflamingo qui se réveille et se dirige vers Punk Hazard, ce qui constitue le cliffhanger. Doflamingo est compté comme présent de manière implicite via cette scène. Law est présent physiquement mais ne combat pas, il cède la place à Nami et Usopp. Arc mentionné comme 'East Blue Saga' par le scraper est une erreur — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Punk Hazard (New World).

characters_detailed.name: Nami
characters_detailed.power_used: Art of Weather — Thunder Breed Tempo

title: A Deal
summary: In a flashback, Law tells Luffy not to underestimate the Four Emperors, as they once had even competed against Whitebeard for territory. Law tells him that with his plan, they have around a 30 percent chance of defeating Kaidou. Back to the present, the Straw Hats and G-5 Marines part ways. The Marines claims to hate pirates and the children are seen crying, unable to say goodbye to the Straw Hats, but the Marines reveal that they badmouth the crew because if they do not, they will come to love them. Flying over the ocean, Doflamingo approaches a life raft with Baby 5 and Buffalo's heads hanging on it, which were apparently cut off by Law. They tell him that they have failed to obtain Caesar, to which Doflamingo replies it is alright since they were only obeying orders. Law's Den Den Mushi is seen on the raft, when it starts talking to Doflamingo. Law tells him that he needs to quit the Shichibukai to get Caesar back or else Kaidou will wipe him out, infuriating Doflamingo.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Law révèle qu'il existe une chance de 30% de vaincre Kaidou avec son plan ; il menace Doflamingo de quitter les Shichibukai sous peine que Kaidou l'anéantisse, tout en ayant coupé les têtes de Baby 5 et Buffalo pour garder Caesar.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Baby 5 et Buffalo apparaissent avec leurs têtes coupées sur un radeau de survie, ce qui suggère une défaite mais non une mort canonique (Law les a vaincus sans les tuer). Caesar est mentionné mais sa présence physique dans ce chapitre n'est pas explicitement confirmée dans le résumé — inclus par déduction contextuelle. Kaidou et Whitebeard/Newgate sont mentionnés dans le flashback mais pas présents physiquement. Le nombre exact de membres des Straw Hats présents est estimé (Luffy, Nami, Chopper confirmés ; d'autres membres probables mais non cités). L'arc Punk Hazard se conclut avec la séparation des Straw Hats et des G-5.

title: Waiting Room
summary: After finding out that his brother's Devil Fruit is being offered as the prize in the Colosseum, Luffy makes it his mission to win the tournament and claim the fruit to prevent anyone from taking it.  Meanwhile, Zoro is still chasing the thief that took his sword and Sanji catches up to him only to get distracted by a dancer named Violet who asks him to hide her from the police because she stabbed her lover who cheated on her. Sanji, being lovestruck says it is all right since he never says no to a crying woman. Relieved, Violet asks Sanji to protect her until she gets to the next town because there is a man there she wants him to kill. Luffy and Franky reach the colosseum where upon Franky's advice Luffy enters with a fake name "Lucy" so that no one will recognize him. In the waiting room, some of the large contestants looks at Luffy with amusement while one of them takes his appearance as an insult and proceeds to attack him, but Luffy answers back by giving him a brutal shoulder flip, breaking the floor. The other contestants are rendered speechless as Luffy greeted them.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Viola is introduced as a new character, a dancer who enlists Sanji's help. The fight between Luffy and Spartan in the waiting room is brief and one-sided — Luffy wins easily with a shoulder flip. No Devil Fruit is explicitly used in the fight. The Mera Mera no Mi is mentioned as the prize for the Corrida Colosseum tournament (prize context), and Ace is referenced in relation to it, but neither is physically present — they are mentioned, not shown. Wicca (the thief who stole Zoro's sword Shusui) is implied to be the thief Zoro is chasing; included as present but not named explicitly in the summary. Marines are referenced as pursuing Viola. Kyros and Doflamingo are not physically present in this chapter.

title: B Block
summary: The battle royale is underway in the colosseum with 138 warriors, with those from the Prodence Kingdom as well as bribed combatants forming a protective ring around the fighting king Elizabello II to ensure the country's chance of taking the Mera Mera no Mi for themselves. Many of the B block fighters proceed to fight their way through each other while avoiding the water surrounding the ring which is infested with Dressrosa's dangerous fighting fish. While this was all going on, Bartolomeo lazily watches the fighting while doing nothing. Meanwhile Luffy and Cavendish are watching the battle royale while Cavendish wonders why none of the Worst Generation rookies have shown up since the prize is too good to pass up and believes that they are in disguise like Burgess and are waiting for the elimination rounds to end. Then Chinjao shows up behind the two pirate captains and exposes Luffy while asking how Garp is doing. Cavendish seems quite shocked to hear the real identity of Luffy.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Chinjao révèle publiquement la vraie identité de Luffy devant Cavendish, choquant ce dernier
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Dressrosa et non East Blue Saga — le scraper indique incorrectement l'arc. Monkey D. Garp est mentionné verbalement (Chinjao demande des nouvelles de Garp) mais n'est pas physiquement présent. Le Mera Mera no Mi est le prix du tournoi, mentionné comme enjeu contextuel. Wano Country et The Worst Generation sont des références contextuelles, pas des entités présentes. Burgess est en bloque B et mentionné comme étant en déguisement. Hack est combattant B block. Tank Lepanto protège Elizabello II.

title: Colosseum of Scoundrels
summary: Seeing that his true identity is exposed, Luffy tries to defend himself from Chinjao's devastating headbutts and Cavendish's irrational hatred while trying in vain to convince them he's "Lucy". Luckily, Chinjao's grandsons manage to intervene and halt Don Chinjao's rampage before he gets disqualified. They convinced him that they should focus on the "real prize" and that since Luffy is in Block C, they can kill him in the ring without repercussions. Cavendish, however, intends to kill Luffy before the match and proceeds to hunt down Luffy, who escaped the fight and is hiding outside, hanging underneath the stands window. At the Battle Royale, only 30 combatants remain in the ring with the numbers being further reduced with the defeat of Tank Lepanto by Abdullah and Jeet who are in turn defeated by Bellamy. However, much to everyone's disgust, Bartolomeo proceeds to urinate in the water in front of the audience. Hack sees this as a vulgar display and attacks him from behind, but somehow his attack was nullified and his arm broken and bleeding while Bartolomeo remains unscathed, leaving everyone who witnessed this shocked and confused at what happened.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Bartolomeo's Devil Fruit power is revealed implicitly — Hack's Fish-Man Karate attack is completely nullified and Hack's arm is broken without Bartolomeo taking damage, hinting at a barrier-type ability (Bari Bari no Mi).
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Monkey D. Dragon est listé par le scraper mais n'apparaît pas dans le résumé — probablement une erreur de scraping (confusion avec 'Dragon' comme terme ou autre). Il est exclu des personnages présents. Belly et Fish-Man Karate sont des concepts/techniques listés par le scraper, pas des personnages. L'arc est Dressrosa (New World), pas East Blue Saga comme indiqué dans l'en-tête. Le Fruit du Démon de Bartolomeo (Bari Bari no Mi) est fortement impliqué par la scène mais pas nommé explicitement dans ce chapitre.

characters_detailed.name: Bartolomeo
characters_detailed.power_used: Bari Bari no Mi (barrier, implicitly shown)

title: King Punch<nowiki>!!</nowiki>
summary: With Hack defeated and the remaining fighters reduced to 24, the battle royale is nearly over. Bellamy faces off Bartolomeo while at the same time Blue Gilly defeats Ricky. The bribed fighters protecting Elizabello II guard themselves from Blue Gilly's assault but were backstabbed by Dagama who revealed that Blue Gilly was his partner, but Dagama secretly plans to betray Blue Gilly. However, the long legged martial artist never trusted the tactical schemer and quickly knocks him out of the ring. Bellamy is currently struggling against Bartolomeo while at the same time, Elizabello II is cornered but is fully prepared to unleash his devastating punch. The audience heard of the fighting king's reputation and proceeds to get out of the way of his punch. When Blue Gilly moves in for the kill, the king delivers the punch at point blank, creating a destructive shockwave throughout the ring. When the smoke cleared, Elizabello II and Bartolomeo were the only ones standing with the latter revealing his Devil fruit and the former being defeated by that power. Bartolomeo is now the champion of the Block B battle royale. Meanwhile, Franky is informed by Thunder Soldier that he too is part of an operation to destroy the SMILE factory but needs the cyborg's help in rescuing the workers held prisoner there. The toy soldier then prepares to tell Franky the history of Dressrosa.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Bartolomeo révèle son Fruit du Démon (Bari Bari no Mi) et remporte le Block B ; le Soldat de Peluche révèle qu'il fait partie d'une opération pour détruire l'usine SMILE et propose de raconter à Franky l'histoire de Dressrosa.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Luffy est mentionné dans le contexte de l'arc mais n'apparaît pas dans ce chapitre. Doflamingo, Riku Doldo III et Kyros ne sont pas directement présents dans ce chapitre (Kyros via Thunder Soldier seulement). 'King Punch' est la technique d'Elizabello II nommée dans le titre. L'alliance Thunder Soldier/Franky pour détruire l'usine SMILE constitue une nouvelle alliance significative. L'arc est Dressrosa et non East Blue Saga — probable erreur du scraper.

title: To Green Bit
summary: At the arena, Luffy goes to talk to Bellamy, who is being carried away along with the other defeated fighters. Bellamy tells Luffy that his cheering crushed his pride, unknowingly revealing Luffy's identity to Bartolomeo who overheard them. With the Caesar Exchange team, the group is having difficulty fending off the fighting fish on the bridge to Green Bit. As they fight their way through, the bridge gets destroyed in front of them and a large fighting fish attempts to ram them, but is caught in a net by an unseen group before it could reach them. Usopp tries to call them to help them across, but instead the unknown fishermen hasten their retreat with their prize. With no other choice, the team decides to fly across with help from Caesar Clown. Upon their arrival to Green Bit, the group discovers a Marine ship that crashed and believed that the Marines had landed on the island. With fourteen minutes left before the exchange, Robin and Usopp begin to scout the island as Law takes Caesar to the meeting point. As they explore, Robin and Usopp discover a squad of Marines who are getting attacked by the forest's inhabitants, losing all of their belongings. As soon as the Marines fled, Robin uses her Devil Fruit power to capture the fast and seemingly invisible thieves. Usopp asks her what she has caught, and she tells him that she believes they are dwarves.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Robin and Usopp discover that the inhabitants of Green Bit are dwarves, previously unseen and invisible-seeming creatures who robbed the Marines
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Arc is Dressrosa, not East Blue Saga — the scraper listed 'East Blue Saga' incorrectly. Leo is introduced but barely named; he is among the dwarves. Bartolomeo overhears Luffy's identity which is a minor revelation. The exchange team (Robin, Usopp, Law, Caesar) is the dominant storyline. Haki is not explicitly used despite being listed by the scraper. Fighting Fish combat is fending off attacks on the bridge rather than a structured fight.

title: Violet
summary: Thirty minutes before Law's meeting with Doflamingo, Sanji was seen beaten and bloodied before Violet who was actually an assassin sent to interrogate him about Law's plan. Her Devil Fruit power allows her to look into Sanji's mind for the truth, only to recoil from seeing Sanji's perverted mind. Sanji, who was barely conscious, told her that he never doubted her tears, leaving her genuinely shocked. Before her subordinates could kill Sanji, she quickly defeated them and proceeded to warn Sanji of the grand deception Doflamingo and the World Government pulled. At the present time, on Green Bit, Nico Robin managed to find Law who told her that they need to get off the island immediately, though she could not directly help him so they decided to escape separately. At that moment, Doflamingo and Fujitora arrived and faced Law in a standoff. At the colosseum, the C block battle royale has started, and Luffy is excited to win this for the prize. Law confronted his former captain who fooled the whole world just to capture ten pirates, and said that it would take someone with the authority of the World Nobles to pull off something so ridiculous. Realizing what he said, Law remembered what Vergo had said about how his ignorance of Doflamingo's past would be their downfall and was about to ask further, but Doflamingo told him that it is much more deep-rooted than what he thinks.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Doflamingo and the World Government fabricated a grand deception to capture ten pirates, requiring the authority of the World Nobles; Doflamingo hints his past is far more deeply rooted than Law realizes
locations: Dressrosa (unspecified location where Sanji was interrogated)
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The arc is Dressrosa, not East Blue Saga — the scraper's arc label appears incorrect. Vergo is mentioned via dialogue/memory only (not physically present). CP0 and World Government are referenced narratively. The flashback covers the scene 30 minutes prior involving Sanji and Viola, treated as a past sequence. Usopp is listed by scraper but has no action described in the summary; included minimally. Cavendish is present at the Colosseum but not given any action. Will of D. is implicitly referenced via Law's full name 'Trafalgar D. Water Law' in the chapter title context and the broader lore discussion.

title: Don Chinjao
summary: Kelly Funk is on a roll, knocking out fighters blow by blow as it was revealed that he ate the Jake Jake no Mi, a fruit that allows him to be "worn" by his brother like a jacket using his brother's large, strong body as his own. Sai, enraged at Boo's defeat took revenge as he told Kelly that as a leader, he will always avenge his men, defeating the brothers with an axe kick. Meanwhile, Chinjao is rampaging towards Luffy, revealing the wrongdoings Garp did to him all while Luffy effortlessly dodges every weapon thrown at him by Jean Ango, who unintentionally harms Chinjao instead. Angry, Chinjao then delivers a powerful headbutt at Jean, knocking the bounty hunter out of the ring. In the middle of the ring, Sai and Ideo are seen dueling, showing signs that they are equally matched. Luffy and Chinjao then charge at one another, knocking out the two other duelers in their way, stunning the crowd and delivering haki-imbued fists at each other, creating a powerful shockwave that pushes the remaining fighters out of the ring. This leaves the two Supreme King Haki users the last fighters left standing in Block C.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Il est révélé que Chinjao possède le Haki du Roi Conquérant, tout comme Luffy, et que Garp lui aurait causé un tort dans le passé. La capacité du Jake Jake no Mi (Kelly Funk se transforme en veste portée par son frère Bobby) est également révélée.
locations: Dressrosa - Colossée de Corrida, Block C
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Garp est mentionné dans les paroles de Chinjao (torts passés) mais n'apparaît pas physiquement ; il n'est donc pas inclus dans characters_present ni characters_detailed. Boo est mentionné comme vaincu mais n'apparaît pas activement dans l'action de ce chapitre. L'arc est Dressrosa (et non East Blue Saga comme indiqué par le scraper — probable erreur de métadonnée). Jean Ango est éliminé par Chinjao. Le combat Block C se conclut avec Luffy et Chinjao seuls survivants, mais leur duel n'est pas encore terminé ; fight_ends=true reflète la fin des duels secondaires (Kelly/Bobby vs Sai, Jean Ango éliminé).

title: Open, Chinjao
summary: In the final minutes of the duel, Chinjao taunts Luffy that Rayleigh wasted his time training him and actually praises the Marines for executing Ace two years ago. These words are enough to get Luffy's blood boiling so much that he launched himself into the air and prepares to deliver a finishing blow to Chinjao while the old man prepares to do the same to Luffy. Chinjao then remembers the past. Thirty years ago, he was known as Chinjao the Drill, the man with an extremely long and pointy head and his signature move was the key to breaking the ice continent that protects his treasure. One day, he lost a fight with Garp whose fists manage to punch his pointy head down into the shape it is today. After he recovered, he discovered that his technique was useless against the ice. Heartbroken over the loss of his treasure, Chinjao vowed to hate Garp and his descendants. Back to the present, both fighters most powerful techniques are ready and Chinjao launches himself towards Luffy, looking forward to ending his life. The two then clash as they struggle for dominance. Ultimately Luffy wins, but to the complete eye-popping shock of everyone watching, Lucy's punch caused Chinjao's head to be pointy again and the unconscious Chinjao falls headfirst into the stadium, breaking it in half. With Chinjao defeated, Luffy wins Block C. On the sidelines, Cavendish and Bartolomeo argue over who will kill Luffy as Bellamy sits quietly in the shadows. Jesus Burgess then realizes that Lucy is Luffy, and gets excited.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Chinjao révèle que Garp lui a aplati la tête il y a 30 ans, lui faisant perdre l'accès à son trésor caché dans le continent de glace, ce qui explique sa haine envers Garp et ses descendants. Luffy, en le battant, lui redonne accidentellement sa tête en pointe.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Rayleigh et Ace sont mentionnés dans le dialogue de Chinjao mais n'apparaissent pas physiquement. Ace est mentionné comme mort (son exécution), mais c'est une référence narrative passée, pas un flashback visuel le montrant. Garp apparaît dans le flashback de Chinjao (il y a 30 ans). Jesus Burgess réalise que Lucy est Luffy, constituant un cliffhanger de type révélation. Le scrapeur inclut des entrées incorrectes comme 'Jewel Ice Sheet', 'Corrida Colosseum', 'The Worst Generation', 'pirate' et 'Gol D. Roger' qui ne sont pas des personnages présents dans ce chapitre. Gol D. Roger n'est pas mentionné dans le résumé.

title: Prison-Gladiators
summary: With the Stadium under repairs, Luffy goes inside to rest only to immediately block an attack by Cavendish who still wanted him dead. Bartolomeo then overhears one of the fighters pokes fun of Luffy, enraging him so much that he attacked him and told him that Luffy will become Pirate King. Bartolomeo reveals that he was there in Loguetown when Luffy declared his dream to the world, inspiring Bartolomeo to travel to sea when he heard of the Straw Hats' exploits. Luffy, still fighting Cavendish, hears Boo saying that his Grandfather wants a word with him. Chinjao expresses his gratitude to Luffy by bowing his restored head on the ground, splitting it giving Luffy the distraction needed to get away from everyone. Rebecca then guides Lucy (unaware its Luffy) away to safety where they ran into Jesus Burgess talking to Blackbeard via Den Den Mushi. Blackbeard reveals his intention of obtaining the Mera Mera no Mi where Luffy declared he will prevent him from doing so and ran off with Rebecca. After treating Lucy with food, Rebecca shows Lucy the Gladiators Quarters where he can safely eat. After a while of chatting Luffy gets grabbed from behind by the prisoners who shouted to Rebecca to do it now, which she complied by attempting to stab Lucy. But Luffy swiftly escapes his bind and pins Rebecca down. The prisoners were relieved when Lucy showed mercy and explained to Luffy that they including Rebecca are convicted Gladiators who stood up to Doflamingo and were punished to fight till they die. Rebecca then told Luffy that Mr. Soldier's plan was to defeat Doflamingo to set her and the prisoners free but tearfully expresses her wish to protect him instead of him protecting her.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Blackbeard révèle son intention d'obtenir le Mera Mera no Mi (le Fruit du Démon de Portgas D. Ace), et Luffy jure de l'en empêcher.
locations: Dressrosa - Arène du Colisée de Corrida - Quartiers des Gladiateurs
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Doflamingo est référencé comme antagoniste principal mais n'apparaît pas physiquement dans ce chapitre. Blackbeard intervient uniquement via Den Den Mushi (voix seulement). Bartolomeo a un flashback sur Loguetown et la déclaration de Luffy. Rebecca tente de poignarder Luffy (acte de trahison orchestré par les prisonniers) mais Luffy la maitrise sans dommages. L'arc est Dressrosa, pas East Blue Saga — le scraper indique incorrectement East Blue Saga. Boo et Sai sont présents dans le résumé (Boo relaie le message de Chinjao). Le shichibukai_present=true fait référence à Doflamingo mentionné comme figure oppressive active.

title: Rebecca and Soldier-san
summary: Luffy listens as Rebecca explains to him about her relationship with the toy soldier whom Luffy met when he first came to the colosseum. The toy soldier was her guardian when her mother died, and raised her during her childhood. When the stadium repairs are completed, Rebecca hears her cue and proceeds to the ring, leaving Luffy with the imprisoned gladiators for company. As she walks with the other combatants to the ring, Rebecca recalls her past when she was little. As a young girl, she helped her mother Scarlett sell flowers for a living. With the news of the kingdom soldiers pillaging their own country, they managed to escape to safety with the help of Thunder Soldier. Eventually, Scarlett lost her life trying to get food for Rebecca while Thunder Soldier failed to protect her. The toy soldier then vowed to protect the young daughter of the woman he failed to save. It was at that time that Doflamingo became king and made the previous king the most hated man in the country. Over the years, the toy soldier protected Rebecca and when he became a wanted man, he taught Rebecca how to fight in order to protect herself. As her flashback ends, Rebecca reaches the ring, where Gatz announces her arrival as the crowd sends a torrent of boos and jeers at her, proclaiming her as the heir of her grandfather, their former king who they believed pillaged their land years ago.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Révélation du passé de Rebecca : sa mère Scarlett est morte en cherchant de la nourriture, le Soldat de Jouet (Kyros) l'a élevée, et Doflamingo a pris le pouvoir en faisant haïr l'ancien roi (grand-père de Rebecca) par son propre peuple.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Doflamingo est Shichibukai à cette époque de l'arc. Kyros (Thunder Soldier) est représenté sous sa forme de jouet dans le présent du chapitre. Scarlett meurt en flashback. L'arc est Dressrosa, pas East Blue Saga — le scraper indique incorrectement 'East Blue Saga'. Le grand-père de Rebecca est Riku Doldo III, mentionné implicitement mais non nommé dans le résumé.

title: The Undefeated Woman
summary: Trafalgar Law and Donquixote Doflamingo begin their duel with a bang on the iron bridge while the escaped Straw Hats are already on their way to Zou. On the ship, Momonosuke talks about how he was traumatized by Doflamingo's cruelty and was afraid of what he might do to Kanjuro. Meanwhile on Dressrosa, Violet is seen heading towards the palace on her toy steed. Zoro and Kin'emon are with Bartolomeo who agrees to find Luffy for them only if Zoro gives him an autograph. At the battle royale, Rebecca is knocking out fighters by tripping them out of the ring without injuring a single one until Rolling Logan confronts her. Inside the Colosseum, Sai is being treated along with all of the other injured fighters who never knew Sai was secretly dropped into an underground chamber where all the tournament dropouts and "diseased" toys were thrown. Everyone there has no clue what Doflamingo plans on doing with them.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Les combattants éliminés du tournoi sont secrètement envoyés dans une chambre souterraine avec des jouets 'malades' — Doflamingo les stocke pour une raison inconnue.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé mentionne 'escaped Straw Hats' sur le bateau vers Zou — Luffy est sur ce bateau d'après le contexte de l'arc, bien que son rôle soit passif dans ce chapitre. Bartolomeo est présent à Dressrosa avec Zoro. Le nombre de Straw Hats comptabilisés (2) correspond à Luffy et Zoro comme membres actifs clairement mentionnés. L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' dans le prompt semble être une erreur du scraper — ce chapitre appartient clairement à l'arc Dressrosa (Dressrosa Arc). La révélation de la chambre souterraine est significative pour le lore de l'arc. Aucune utilisation explicite de Fruit du Démon ou Haki n'est décrite dans le résumé.

title: The Lurking Hero
summary: While the fight for block D continues, Thunder Soldier explains to the Straw Hat Pirates how King Riku lost the throne and respect of Dressrosa. Ten years ago Doflamingo appeared in the king's chambers, asking for a 10 billion ransom, in order to leave the country alone. Riku sent his soldiers to ask of the citizens' money, but while they were willingly trying to help their king, Doflamingo controlled Riku and his soldiers with his ability, and made them attack their own people against their will. In the shadows, Doflamingo and his crew are waiting for the right moment to interfere and act as a saving hero in the eyes of Dressrosa's confused citizens.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Doflamingo used his Ito Ito no Mi to control King Riku and his soldiers, forcing them to attack their own citizens, thereby engineering the fall of the Riku dynasty and positioning himself as a 'savior' in Dressrosa's eyes.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The chapter is primarily an exposition/flashback chapter explaining how Doflamingo usurped the Riku throne 10 years ago. Thunder Soldier (later revealed as Kyros) narrates this to Usopp, Franky, and Robin. The Block D fight continues in the background. The arc is Dressrosa Arc, not East Blue Saga — the scraper's arc classification is incorrect. Sevio and Celestial Dragons are mentioned contextually by the scraper but do not appear in the résumé; they are excluded from the character list. Devil Fruit usage shown in flashback (Doflamingo controlling Riku). The 10 billion berry ransom demand is a significant lore revelation.

characters_detailed.name: Donquixote Doflamingo
characters_detailed.power_used: Ito Ito no Mi (puppeteer control on Riku and soldiers)

title: An Underground World
summary: At the Flower Field, the dwarf army and the Straw Hats begin to move out, with Franky taking the front entrance via the toy house while the rest of the army take the secret underground tunnel that leads to the harbor. Franky, remembering Luffy's orders to go all out went and created a huge ruckus in front of the toy house grabbing the attention of every officer in the Donquixote Pirates. In the ensuing chaos, Senor Pink who was guarding the entrance prepares to face Franky. In the underground tunnel, the dwarves explains to Usopp the size of the Donquixote Family and the identities and strengths of the officers who are running the operations. As they reach the end of the tunnel, the army find themselves directly underneath the palace plateau where the huge harbor is located. Unnoticed by anyone, the army prepares to find their target, Sugar who is guarded by Trebol himself.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Les nains révèlent à Usopp la taille de la famille Donquixote, l'identité et les capacités de ses officiers, ainsi que la localisation de Sugar gardée par Trebol sous le plateau du palais.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Luffy est présent brièvement via les ordres qu'il a donnés à Franky (rappel/flashback interne), mais n'agit pas physiquement dans le chapitre. Doflamingo est Shichibukai et sa famille est présente (Senor Pink, Sugar, Trebol), ce qui justifie shichibukai_present=true. Le résumé indique un affrontement imminent entre Franky et Senor Pink mais pas encore conclu. L'arc est Dressrosa, mentionné comme East Blue Saga par le scraper — probable erreur de métadonnées, la région correcte est New World.

title: What Soldier-san Wants
summary: The colosseum D block battle is almost over with nearly 30 fighters remaining with Rebecca among them. At the Hidden Harbor, Usopp learned from the dwarves that Thunder Soldier left the group in order to assassinate Doflamingo at his palace, leaving Usopp in command of the army much to his disbelief. Though they were nearly caught by some soldiers the dwarves easily subdued them and their clothes were given to Usopp and Robin for disguise. Near the Harbor elevator, many soldiers were rushing towards the elevator to see the battle between Franky and Senor Pink, unaware that Thunder Soldier and a few dwarves were hiding inside a crate in the lift. Seeing no other way, Thunder Soldier assaults the soldiers in order to hijack the lift. During battle, he recalls his training of Rebecca to teach her battle instinct. He then declares his goal to restore Dressrosa to King Riku's rule. At the colosseum, an unexplained event caused every fighter in the arena to fall unconscious one after another. Before anyone could speculate what happened, an unidentified fighter is seen getting up in the arena.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Thunder Soldier reveals his plan to assassinate Doflamingo and restore Dressrosa to King Riku's rule; an unidentified fighter rises after all other combatants collapse in the Colosseum D block
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Doflamingo is referenced as the assassination target but does not appear physically; Riku Doldo III is mentioned as the rightful ruler but not physically present. Franky and Senor Pink's fight is ongoing off-panel near the harbor elevator. The mysterious collapse of all D block fighters and the unidentified survivor serve as the chapter's cliffhanger. Arc listed as 'East Blue Saga' by scraper but this chapter clearly belongs to the Dressrosa Arc (Dressrosa Saga/New World). Sea region corrected to New World accordingly.

title: Executive Officer Diamante
summary: As the four winners of the respective block battle royale and Diamante have entered the ring, a trio of gladiators from Block D rush to attack Rebecca not accepting that they lost the fight, but Diamante intervenes and easily knocks them away, revealing his devil fruit power to everyone. He also reveals a new obstacle, one of the new boss class fighting fish is guarding the prize and the goal is to steal it while everyone is at each other throats. With the sound of the gong, the battle for the Mera Mera no Mi begins. At the palace, the group cautiously sneaks inside to avoid sounding the alarm. Instead, Luffy stirs up a chaotic mess by attacking the gate and the guards head on causing the group to ditch their disguises and fight their way in. Doflamingo hears the news that Luffy is in the palace while watching "Lucy" fighting on screen. This angers him and he demands to know what is going on. As Luffy's group except Kin'emon ran towards the inner walls, they are caught by surprise when a large castle wall transforms into Pica. Inside the harbor lift, Lao G has stumbled upon Thunder Soldier's squad and proceeds to prevent them from reaching Doflamingo.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Diamante révèle son Fruit du Démon (Hira Hira no Mi) et dévoile qu'un Fighting Fish de rang boss garde le Mera Mera no Mi dans l'arène.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Zoro est listé parmi les personnages détectés mais n'apparaît pas clairement dans le résumé. Il est possible qu'il fasse partie du groupe au palais. Sabo combat sous l'identité de 'Lucy' dans le Colossée — le Mera Mera no Mi n'est pas encore physiquement utilisé dans ce chapitre, mais il est l'enjeu du combat. Kyros (Thunder Soldier) est identifié comme tel dans le résumé. L'arc appartient à Dressrosa, qui fait partie du New World, malgré l'indication incorrecte 'East Blue Saga' dans le prompt.

title: Officer's Tower
summary: At Doflamingo's palace, Luffy's group stood before Pica. Viola explained that Pica ate the Ishi Ishi no Mi, allowing him to assimilate stone. Pica reached into the surrounding walls, taking control of them and smashing them together, in an attempt to crush the group. In the Colosseum, Jesus Burgess earned the ire of the audience when he indiscriminately attacked the crowd while fighting the boss fighting fish. The fighting fish with the prize tried to attack Rebecca but missed and Lucy managed to get on top of the beast. Diamante moved to attack Lucy but broke his sword against the latter's pipe in the process. Jesus tried his turn to attack but Lucy intercepted and destroyed his elbow guard, with Diamante noticing the change in Lucy's fighting style. Cavendish finds himself detained by Trebol and before he could object, he was turned into a toy by Sugar and forced to work in the Harbor without any control over his new form, along with the other transformed fighters. It was then that Usopp's group snuck inside the tower and located their target. Leo told Usopp that their strategy was to mix the world's most spicy seasoning (disguised as a grape) into Sugar's bowl of grapes, so that upon eating it she would lose consciousness and her spell would be broken on all the toys in the kingdom. Seeing no other alternative, Usopp agreed to carry out the plan that could potentially free the kingdom from Doflamingo's rule.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Lucy in the Colosseum is Sabo disguised as Luffy — all actions attributed to 'Lucy' are actually Sabo's. Diamante's Beta Beta no Mi (Sticky-Sticky Fruit) is referenced. Arc listed as Dressrosa arc, not East Blue Saga — likely a scraper error. Robin is listed by the scraper but is not explicitly confirmed present in the résumé; included cautiously. Cavendish is transformed into a toy by Sugar — health_state set to defeated/transformed.

title: Trebol Army, Special Officer Sugar
summary: Leo prepares to plant the Tatababasco grape in Sugar's bowl, but is stopped by Robin after she sees how dangerous Trebol is. In the SMILE Factory, the enslaved dwarves are seen attempting to cultivate SMILEs under harsh conditions. An overseer punishes them for producing failures, and motivates them with the lie that the fruits are necessary to cure Princess Mansherry. Robin and Bian create a diversion to lure Trebol away from the tower, while the dwarves face Sugar. Sugar turns half of them into toys, and orders them to kill the rest. She calls out to Trebol for help, and Trebol responds by using his ability to smash a ship into the tower.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Les nains esclaves dans la SMILE Factory sont manipulés par le mensonge que les SMILE sont nécessaires pour guérir la Princesse Mansherry.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Mansherry est mentionnée mais semble absente physiquement — présente comme référence narrative. Usopp est listé parmi les personnages détectés par le scraper mais n'apparaît pas dans le résumé fourni ; son inclusion est maintenue avec prudence. Le fruit de Trebol est le Beta Beta no Mi (glue/slime). Le fruit de Sugar est le Hobi Hobi no Mi (transformation en jouets). L'arc est Dressrosa, non East Blue Saga — le scraper indique incorrectement 'East Blue Saga'.

characters_detailed.name: Bian
characters_detailed.power_used: Mushi Mushi no Mi, Model: Hornet

title: Commander
summary: The destruction caused by Trebol was enough to bring the attempted attack on Sugar to a stop as the dwarves were rounded up and interrogated. The dwarves however were betrayed by their naivety and revealed Usoland to them, allowing Trebol to ignite the slime they were caught in.
