Leo survives and lands near Usopp and Robin who evaded capture. Leo weakly told Usopp that their plan must succeed for the sake of their captain. At the Palace, Thunder Soldier was brutally kicked out of the lift by Lao G, and has a flashback of his fight with Rebecca over the false news of Doflamingo's resignation. At the Colosseum, Rebecca lies beaten by Diamante who taunts her over the death of her mother. Seeing this, Sabo told Bartolomeo to protect Rebecca. Thunder Soldier was later saved by his dwarf squad from Lao G, and the survivors told him that he must press on. Usopp was skeptical that they would put all their faith on a simple toy soldier, but Leo reveals that Thunder Soldier was the first to be turned into a toy and not given a contract. It is why he leads the resistance and that his human identity was the legendary gladiator, Kyros.

devil_fruit_names: Ato Ato no Mi (Trebol's slime ability implied)
taxonomy.revelation_description: Thunder Soldier est révélé être le légendaire gladiateur Kyros, le premier à avoir été transformé en jouet sans contrat par Sugar.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le fruit du démon de Trebol est le Beli Beli no Mi (substance collante/slime). Le chapitre confirme l'identité de Thunder Soldier comme étant Kyros, révélation majeure du lore. Sabo est présent comme membre de l'Armée Révolutionnaire, d'où revolutionary_army_present=true. La mention de Doflamingo comme Shichibukai (contexte) implique shichibukai_present=false directement, mais Doflamingo est Shichibukai — cependant il n'apparaît pas physiquement dans ce chapitre. Arc noté comme 'Dressrosa' malgré le scraper indiquant 'East Blue Saga', ce qui semble être une erreur du scraper.

title: Usoland the Liar
summary: Usopp decides to flee from the factory, but changes his mind after the dwarves told Trebol how much faith they had in their "hero". Meanwhile, Thunder Soldier reflects on his life as Kyros.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est très bref. L'arc est mal référencé comme 'East Blue Saga' alors qu'il s'agit clairement de l'arc Dressrosa (Dressrosa Arc, New World). Usopp tente de fuir mais se ressaisit grâce à la foi des nains, ce qui compte comme usopp_lies_or_runs=true (fuite initiale). Le flashback de Thunder Soldier/Kyros constitue la continuité de son récit de vie. Mont Blanc Noland est mentionné implicitement comme inspirateur du surnom 'Usoland' mais n'apparaît pas physiquement. Robin est listée dans les personnages détectés par le scraper mais sa présence directe dans ce chapitre n'est pas confirmée par le résumé — incluse avec prudence. Sugar est présente dans la zone de la fabrique mais son rôle actif dans ce chapitre n'est pas précisé.

title: I'll Always Be By Your Side
summary: Kyros' life takes a turn for the better when he meets Scarlett, who initially distrusts him but comes around when he rescues her from pirates. She even faked her death so she can spend her life with him. Eventually they had a daughter who she named Rebecca. When Doflamingo took over, Kyros attempts to rescue King Riku from Doflamingo. He cuts off his leg and lunges at Doflamingo, only for Sugar to turn him into a toy. Kyros (now Thunder Soldier) flees the palace with Riku, who does not remember him. Some day after the attack Scarlett was shot by Diamante when she went to get food for Rebecca. Violet shook Kyros out of his flashback, when they noticed that extra soldiers are heading towards Doflamingo and with the element of surprise quickly slipping, the group prepares to attack Doflamingo. In the Colosseum, Burgess's attacks are weakening the Colosseum's foundations, with soldiers remarking that another strong attack will cause them to break. Diamante reveals himself as the culprit who killed Rebecca's mother right in her face, leaving her vulnerable and in shock. Franky lies defeated by the Doflamingo family and is calling for Usopp in his head to save the day. Down at the hidden harbor, all the toys are silently rooting for Usopp to succeed but he is shown to be unconscious. As a final farewell, Sugar puts the Tatababasco ball in Usopp's mouth and makes him swallow it. But this causes Usopp to wake up screaming with a horrible expression on his face that terrifies Sugar so much she fainted.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Diamante révèle à Rebecca en face qu'il est celui qui a tué sa mère Scarlett. Usopp effraie accidentellement Sugar en avalant le Tatababasco, ce qui provoque l'évanouissement de Sugar et pourrait libérer tous les jouets.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le flashback de Kyros couvre une grande partie du chapitre, incluant sa rencontre avec Scarlett, leur mariage, la naissance de Rebecca, la transformation de Kyros en jouet par Sugar, et la mort de Scarlett par Diamante. Doflamingo est mentionné et présent comme antagoniste global mais n'agit pas directement. Le Hobi Hobi no Mi de Sugar est utilisé dans le flashback. La scène finale avec Usopp et le Tatababasco constitue le cliffhanger majeur du chapitre, suggérant l'imminente libération des jouets.

title: Revolutionary Army Chief of Staff
summary: During the confusion within the arena, Sabo grabs the Mera Mera no Mi and eats it, before using his new powers to break into the harbor while bringing Rebecca to safety. Once out of the way, he reveals himself as the second in command of the revolutionary army along with his comrades, Koala and Hack, and their mission is to find and destroy the weapons factory hidden here. In the underground port, Usopp is seen by the trapped pirates and gladiators as a saint who rescued them from their terrible fate, and he manages to enlist them in the destruction of the weapon factory. At the palace, Kyros holds his own against Doflamingo's soldiers while Luffy and Viola go to unlock Law's chains, despite the latter's protest to kill him if he does so. However, Pica arrives, and Doflamingo turns out to be alive despite having been decapitated. The pirate announces his intent to use the "bird cage", which startles Law.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Sabo est révélé comme le second en commandement de l'Armée Révolutionnaire ; Doflamingo survit à sa décapitation apparente et annonce son intention d'utiliser la 'Cage d'Oiseaux' (Birdcage) ; Sabo mange le Mera Mera no Mi et hérite des pouvoirs de feu d'Ace.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: La 'réapparition' concerne Sabo, dont l'identité de haut responsable révolutionnaire constitue un retour majeur dans la narration (sa survie était déjà connue depuis le chapitre 731). Doflamingo survit à sa décapitation, suggérant que ce qui a été décapité était un double ou une illusion (Ito Ito no Mi). La mention de la 'Birdcage' est le cliffhanger central. Bartolomeo, Diamante, Trebol, Gladius, Burgess, Buffalo, Riku Doldo III et Hajrudin sont détectés par le scraper mais n'apparaissent pas explicitement dans le résumé — ils ne sont pas inclus dans characters_detailed par manque de confirmation. Le arc est correctement 'Dressrosa' et non 'East Blue Saga' (erreur probable du scraper).

characters_detailed.name: Donquixote Doflamingo
characters_detailed.power_used: Ito Ito no Mi (implied survival via strings/double)

title: Trump Card
summary: Gladius first attacks with multiple rupture balls sent at Luffy, but Bartolomeo blocks them with a large barrier, which he then converts into a long staircase towards the 4th level. As Luffy climbs the stairs, Gladius attacks him again but Bartolomeo takes it head on, leaving him injured. Robin thanks him for helping Luffy since the Straw Hats always knew Luffy as their winning trump card. Cavendish remains behind to stall the nutcrackers. Sabo's fight with Fujitora continues as the Admiral creates a sideways gravity force that pushes Sabo back. Sabo on the other hand wonders if the Admiral is hiding something. In the Flower Field, Rebecca was too frightened to face Diamante and tries to escape, but Diamante easily exposes and injures her. As Diamante aims a gun towards Rebecca, he was stricken by a swift attack by Kyros who angrily exclaims that he won't let him take away another family member again. Rebecca, seeing her savior missing leg recognized him as the toy soldier and tears up as he is also her father. Luffy carrying Law finally reaches the top of the stairs and calls Rebecca for the key to unshackle Law. With Law free from the cuffs, he is ready to help Luffy take down Doflamingo.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Rebecca reconnaît le soldat jouet comme étant Kyros, son père, grâce à sa jambe manquante — révélation émotionnelle majeure de leur lien filial
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Doflamingo est mentionné comme cible mais n'apparaît pas physiquement dans le chapitre. Scarlett est mentionnée implicitement via le dialogue de Kyros ('ne pas perdre un autre membre de la famille') mais n'apparaît pas directement. L'arc est Dressrosa, pas East Blue Saga — le scraper semble avoir mal tagué l'arc. Le Haki utilisé par Issho est présumé (gravitational force) mais pas explicitement nommé Haki dans ce résumé. Bartolomeo utilise son Bari Bari no Mi. Robin est présente mais son Hana Hana no Mi n'est pas explicitement utilisé dans le résumé.

title: Secret Plan
summary: The battle between Robin's group and the nutcracker army comes to a stop as the toys revert into their human selves due to Sugar being knocked unconscious again. At the palace, Doflamingo questions Luffy's decision to help a former enemy like Bellamy, but Luffy tells him that past is behind him. Doflamingo then berates Bellamy calling him a lowlife. Angered, Luffy tries to kick Doflamingo but hits Bellamy instead when the Shichibukai uses him like a shield. Law admonishes Luffy to not get angry since Doflamingo likes to provoke his enemies. Doflamingo then tells the duo that he is sick of them ruining his plans and that they remind him of the anger he experienced 13 years ago. Law says if it weren't for that time, he wouldn't be standing here, but Doflamingo retorts that if he didn't do it, Law would have been the "third Corazon" and then attacks Law with a string clone. All the while, Luffy fights a controlled Bellamy. Mad at the Shichibukai for sitting through the fight, Luffy tells Law that he's gonna take down Doflamingo and readies an attack on Law. Law then creates a bubble and switches with Doflamingo, causing him to be struck by Luffy "Red Hawk". Trebol is shocked by this surprise, before being incapacitated by Law's "Radio Knife". Law tells Luffy that he's the worst but Luffy remarks the he is also part of the same generation.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Doflamingo révèle que la colère qu'il ressent remonte à 13 ans et que Law aurait pu devenir le 'troisième Corazon' s'il n'avait pas agi à ce moment-là.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Dressrosa et non East Blue Saga — le scraper indique incorrectement 'East Blue Saga'. Sugar est inconsciente, causant la libération des jouets, mais son rôle est passif dans ce chapitre. Monet, Vergo, Caesar, Rosinante et les autres personnages listés par le scraper ne sont pas physiquement présents dans ce chapitre selon le résumé. Law utilise l'Ope Ope no Mi pour échanger Doflamingo avec lui-même (ROOM + Shambles implicites). Red Hawk implique Haki d'Armement sur Gomu Gomu no Mi. Tashigi non présente dans ce chapitre selon le résumé.

title: The Same Bet
summary: On the streets of Dressrosa, Sabo is being scolded by Koala for fighting an Marine Admiral since it will attract unwanted attention to the Revolutionaries. Usopp and the others at the Plateau are released by the citizens since the people are confused at all of the chaos. They beg to their former king for help, but Riku tells them to trust Luffy to overthrow Doflamingo. Admiral Fujitora also declares his trust in Luffy. Trebol is having difficulty in reforming himself after being cut to pieces by Law. Before Law can attack him again, Doflamingo stops and brutally skewers Law with strings. Luffy tries to fight, but Doflamingo overcomes him and binds him, leaving him at the mercy of the controlled Bellamy. Doflamingo tells them that he hates people looking down at him and reveals his family's past, of how his father made the family leave the life of luxury and how his mother died of illness because of their fallen status. Doflamingo held his father with disdain and killed him, hoping to return to the life of a World Noble but was rejected by them, leaving him to swear to destroy the entire world ruled by them.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Doflamingo révèle son passé : son père Homing a renoncé au statut de Noble Mondial, ce qui a conduit à la mort de sa mère. Doflamingo a tué son père et a tenté de retrouver son statut de Noble Mondial, mais fut rejeté, le poussant à vouloir détruire le monde gouverné par eux.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Dressrosa (et non East Blue Saga — probablement une erreur du scraper). Trafalgar Law est mentionné comme combattant et victime de Doflamingo mais n'est pas dans la liste du scraper — ajouté. Donquixote Homing est identifié comme décédé en flashback (tué par Doflamingo enfant). La mère de Doflamingo meurt également en flashback de maladie mais n'est pas nommée. Le fruit Noro Noro no Mi est celui de Trebol — il s'agit en réalité du Beta Beta no Mi (Boue-Boue). Devil fruit de Sabo = Mera Mera no Mi. L'Ope Ope no Mi est mentionné dans la liste du scraper mais ne semble pas directement utilisé dans ce chapitre — omis des fruits utilisés. Hack (Fish-Man) figure dans la liste du scraper mais n'apparaît pas dans le résumé — non inclus dans characters_detailed.

title: Ope Ope no Mi
summary: The Marines are having difficulty maintaining order in the streets of Dressrosa as they deal with rampaging animals and pillaging pirates as well as the absence of Admiral Fujitora. Luffy is struggling against a Doflamingo clone and a controlled Bellamy while Law questions Doflamingo's feat in manipulating CP0 and the World Government. Doflamingo explains that he learned of a national treasure that the World Nobles would not want revealed and used the knowledge to blackmail them into granting him their power. He also reveals the full potential of Law's Ope Ope no Mi with its power to give eternal life at the cost of the user's own life, but Law is not interested in using it and states that it was thanks to Corazon that he has the power to defeat Doflamingo. Law then remembers his time in the Donquixote Pirates 16 years ago when he discovered that he had little over three years to live, which fueled his desire to destroy everything. He was part of the new recruits that recently joined the crew and was placed under the command of Corazon, a clumsy but talented officer of Doflamingo's crew. Law learned the hard way that Corazon hates children when he was thrown out the window.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Doflamingo révèle qu'il a fait chanter les Nobles Mondiaux grâce à un trésor national secret, obtenant ainsi leur protection et pouvoir. Il révèle aussi le vrai potentiel de l'Ope Ope no Mi : accorder la vie éternelle à quelqu'un au prix de la vie de l'utilisateur.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' dans l'entrée semble erroné — ce chapitre appartient clairement à l'arc Dressrosa (New World). Le scraper liste 'Primula' (ville du Nord Blue mentionnée dans le flashback de Law) mais ce n'est pas un personnage. Sabo est listé dans les personnages détectés mais aucune mention explicite de lui dans le résumé — non inclus dans characters_detailed. Issho/Fujitora est mentionné par son absence, donc présent dans le contexte narratif mais pas physiquement visible. Rosinante/Corazon apparaît dans le flashback de Law, compté comme présent. Les membres du clan Donquixote (Lao G, Gladius, Diamante, Trebol, Baby 5, Buffalo) sont mentionnés comme recrues passées dans le flashback, donc inclus dans le flashback.

title: The White Town
summary: It has been over a week since Trafalgar Law joined the Donquixote Pirates and still stays despite Corazon's brutal methods. Law is then revealed to be a survivor of Flevance, a once prosperous country that no longer exists and that he escaped under a pile of corpses. While the Donquixote Pirates continue their raids, Baby 5 asks Gladius of the kingdom Law was part of and he reveals its history. The kingdom was called the "White City" because of a material called Amber Lead which gave riches to all the inhabitants of the city. But a century ago, the World Government discovered that it was poisonous, but hid the fact because of the wealth it brings. Eventually the poison grew more potent in every generation, causing shorter lifespans and painful deaths, and the neighboring countries, fearing that the disease was contagious, quarantined Flevance. While the royalty of Flevance were evacuated, the citizens were mercilessly butchered by the squads of soldiers sent to exterminate them, despite their efforts to fight back. Law was there with his sister and parents along with the local orphanage while his father was trying to find a way to cure the disease, but tragedy struck when everyone Law knew was killed by the soldiers leaving him the only survivor. Law then finds Corazon reading a newspaper and quickly attacks him from behind, stabbing him, but the attack is witnessed by Buffalo, who rushes to report to Doflamingo; who decreed the rule that anyone who harms even a single hair on his brother will die by his hand.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Law est révélé être un survivant de Flevance, la Cité Blanche, dont la population a été exterminée à cause de l'empoisonnement au Plomb d'Ambre dissimulé par le Gouvernement Mondial. Law a perdu toute sa famille lors du massacre.
locations: Lieu de repli des Donquixote Pirates
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé mentionne Lami (sœur de Law) comme morte en flashback — c'est la mort principale du chapitre en flashback. Les parents de Law sont également tués en flashback mais non nommés. Le Gouvernement Mondial est mentionné comme acteur central de la dissimulation du Plomb d'Ambre, mais aucun agent n'est physiquement présent dans le présent narratif. Le scraper listait 'Flevance', 'Amber Lead', 'World Government' et 'Sui Sui no Mi' comme personnages, ce qui est incorrect — ce sont des lieux/substances/fruits du démon et non des personnages. Pica, Machvise, Giolla, Lao G, Senor Pink sont probablement présents en tant que membres des Donquixote Pirates en arrière-plan mais leur présence explicite dans le résumé est minimale.

title: Declaration of Humanity
summary: Doflamingo has a nightmare of the suffering his family had endured after they renounced their status, but wakes up at the sound of a Den Den Mushi ringing. He then remembers the time his father gave up the Celestial Dragon status and moved the family to a northern country, but their stay turned to a fight for survival when the locals were discovered to carry a deep hatred for the World Nobles. Law is then brought in front of Doflamingo who then declares Law to become an official member of the Donquixote Pirates. He goes on by saying if Law finds himself a Devil Fruit that can cure his illness, he will train Law to be his right-hand man in the future. Law then witnesses Corazon lying to Doflamingo over the cause of his injury, protecting him. The next two years were spent accompanying the crew in their acts of piracy as well as his training and lessons with them. One day, Law reveals his full name, Trafalgar D. Water Law, to Buffalo and Baby 5, but is then grabbed quickly by Corazon and carried away to a remote area. Here, Corazon speaks to Law for the first time, telling him to get away from Doflamingo.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Corazon (Rosinante) parle pour la première fois à Law et lui révèle qu'il doit fuir Doflamingo ; le vrai nom de Law, Trafalgar D. Water Law, contenant le D., est révélé aux membres du groupe.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre se déroule entièrement en flashback (passé de Law et Doflamingo). Donquixote Homing (père de Doflamingo) apparaît dans le flashback mais n'est pas nommé explicitement dans le résumé — mentionné comme 'his father'. Rosinante/Corazon est le personnage pivot : il protège Law en mentant à Doflamingo, puis lui parle pour la première fois. Le 'fight' mentionné dans le résumé ('their stay turned to a fight for survival') est une métaphore de survie sociale/physique contre les locaux, pas un combat structuré — fight_occurs conservé à false. Le D. est mentionné explicitement dans le nom de Law.

title: White Monster
summary: Law was surprised at the fact that Corazon has kept up his mute charade from his own crew and that Corazon was also a Devil Fruit user. Corazon warns Law that Doflamingo is a monster and Law will become one if he continues to follow the same path, but Law argues that he will still die soon and rushes to tell Doflamingo. Corazon tries to stop him but was surprised that Law didn't reveal his ruse as Law owes him for the stabbing incident. Doflamingo later learns that Corazon kidnapped Law and is travelling toward all known hospitals in the sea to cure Law's illness. Corazon then makes a call to Marine Headquarters where he explains to Admiral Sengoku of his current objective. After he hung up, Sengoku meets a recruit named Vergo requesting for a transfer to G-5. Corazon and Law spent months travelling to many hospitals, attempting to cure the younger pirates Amber Lead poisoning, but they all refused to treat Law, causing Corazon to attack them for hurting Law emotionally. This causes them to be hunted by the authorities for leaving a trail of damaged hospitals. One night, Corazon told a sleeping Law that he understands his pain unaware that Law was listening. The next morning, Law and Corazon received a call and answers it, unaware that Doflamingo was on the line.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Corazon révèle à Law qu'il parle (il simulait être muet devant ses propres équipiers), qu'il est un utilisateur de Fruit du Démon, et qu'il est un informateur secret travaillant pour l'amiral Sengoku contre Doflamingo. Vergo est introduit comme recrue demandant un transfert à G-5.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre se déroule entièrement en flashback (arc Dressrosa, passé de Law et Rosinante). Les 'combats' de Rosinante consistent à attaquer des hôpitaux qui refusent de soigner Law, ce sont des altercations ponctuelles non développées en affrontements formels. Le scraper listait des entités non-personnages (Amber Lead, Nagi Nagi no Mi, G-5, Den Den Mushi, Flevance, etc.) qui ont été filtrées. Vergo apparaît brièvement comme recrue Marines. Doflamingo est mentionné mais sa présence physique dans ce chapitre est limitée à la fin (appel téléphonique).

title: Minion, the Isle of Fate
summary: Corazon and Law were contacted by Doflamingo, who asked them to return to him since he is planning to steal the Ope Ope no Mi from a secret trade guarded by the World Government, and intends to make Corazon eat it. After he hung up, Corazon rejoices with Law that the Ope Ope no Mi is the absolute cure to Law's illness and plans to give the Devil Fruit to Law by stealing it before Doflamingo does. Corazon calls Sengoku and confirms the dealing before requesting information of the trade location. Sengoku refuses to share it but changes his mind when he learns that Doflamingo plans to steal it. The information Corazon provided allows the Admiral to plan an ambush for the Donquixote Pirates when they arrive. After the call with Sengoku, Law collapses due to the advanced state of his illness. Corazon pleaded Law to stay strong for three more weeks until he can get the fruit for Law. At the week of the trade off, the two reached the Minion Island, where the trade will happen and Corazon snuck inside while leaving Law in a safe place. Using the ability of the Nagi Nagi no Mi, he causes confusion and chaos among the pirates while he successfully steals the Fruit. However, in his escape, he slips and lands in the middle of a pirate group who surrounded him. Law still waits for Corazon to return with the Ope Ope no Mi.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Le Ope Ope no Mi est révélé comme le remède absolu à la maladie de Law ; Corazon trahit Doflamingo en informant Sengoku du lieu du trafic et en volant le fruit pour Law.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre est entièrement dans le flashback de Rosinante/Law (arc Dressrosa). Doflamingo est présent via Den Den Mushi. Sengoku apparaît via communication. Le 'combat' de Corazon dans la base de Barrels est une infiltration avec usage du Nagi Nagi no Mi mais pas un affrontement au sens strict. fight_occurs = false car Corazon infiltre et fuit sans combattre directement. La mention de Pica, Diamante, Baby 5 dans le scraper laisse supposer leur présence avec Doflamingo mais n'est pas confirmée explicitement dans le résumé ; ils sont inclus avec prudence.

title: Smile
summary: Donquixote Rosinante retrieves the Ope Ope no Mi and gives it to Law, forcing it down his throat. Rosinante falls, beaten and bloody, but gives Law a letter to give to a nearby Marine ship. He runs and gives the letter to the Marine, Vergo, then immediately brings Vergo to Rosinante. Upon discovering Corazon's identity, Vergo calls Doflamingo and his crew to Minion Island. Doflamingo activates his Birdcage and captures all the Marines on the island. As Rosinante nears death, he smiles, wishing his smile to be the last thing Law remembers about him.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Rosinante force Law à manger le Ope Ope no Mi pour le sauver ; Vergo découvre l'identité de Rosinante comme Corazon (Marine infiltré) et prévient Doflamingo ; Doflamingo active sa Birdcage sur Minion Island pour piéger tous les Marines
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ce chapitre est un flashback sur l'arc Law/Corazon. Rosinante est agonisant mais pas encore confirmé mort dans ce chapitre spécifiquement — il sourit à Law avant la fin, sa mort imminente est fortement suggérée. Le fight_occurs est mis à false car la narration décrit Rosinante 'battu et ensanglanté' (résultat d'un combat antérieur) mais aucun affrontement physique direct ne se déroule dans ce chapitre. L'Ito Ito no Mi est utilisée par Doflamingo via le Birdcage. L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' dans le prompt semble erroné — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Dressrosa (flashback Corazon/Law), situé dans la New World.

title: Cora-san
summary: A glimpse of the Donquixote Family's past is shown as Doflamingo executes his father in front of Rosinante who begged him to stop. Doflamingo finds Diez Barrels and kills him for losing the fruit he was about to steal. His crew then began looting the pirates treasure and searching the island for the traitors. But Rosinante openly gives away his position as he wants them to focus on him to keep Law safe who was being kept in a chest with a silence spell given by Rosinante for good measure. Law could only listen as the crew beat up Rosinante and stopped as Doflamingo arrived. Rosinante then points a gun at Doflamingo as he pronounces his position as a Marine sent to infiltrate Doflamingo's criminal activities. He lied to them that Law is out of the cage and in Marine hands which they believed to be true as they heard of a boy in their custody. Law could do nothing but listen helplessly as Doflamingo kills his own brother in cold blood over giving the fruit to Law. Rosinante however held onto his life as much as he can to keep the silence spell on Law until the Doflamingo pirates were off the island. With that accomplished he gives his final farewell to Law and passed away when Law's voice returns along with his sorrowful cries.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Rosinante révèle être un Marine infiltré dans la famille Donquixote, et meurt après avoir protégé Law grâce à son sort de silence jusqu'au départ des pirates.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre se déroule entièrement en flashback sur l'arc de Law/Cora-san. Rosinante meurt dans le présent narratif du flashback. Doflamingo est présent en tant que chef de la famille et exécute son frère. La mort de Donquixote Homing est mentionnée/montrée au début (exécution par Doflamingo). Diez Barrels est tué par Doflamingo. Le Nagi Nagi no Mi (fruit du silence) est utilisé par Rosinante pour protéger Law. X Drake et Sengoku sont détectés par le scraper mais ne semblent pas directement présents dans ce chapitre selon le résumé ; ils ne sont pas inclus dans characters_present. Doflamingo est Shichibukai à cette époque.

title: Parent and Child
summary: Luffy continues attacking Fujitora, but declares his attacks beforehand to show him how he will defeat him. Fujitora blows Luffy into the sky, but Hajrudin catches him, and the pirates run away. Fujitora plans to crush their ship with all the rubble he lifted, but is interrupted by the citizens of Dressrosa, who wish to help their savior escape, revealing that they knew about Rebecca and Kyros all along. Aboard the Yonta Maria, Cavendish, Bartolomeo, Sai, Ideo, Hajrudin, Orlumbus, and even Leo all pledge allegiance to Luffy with their respective crews, and ask Luffy to exchange sake cups with them as their "parent" and take them under his wing.

taxonomy.revelation_description: The citizens of Dressrosa reveal they knew about Rebecca and Kyros all along, and multiple pirate captains (Cavendish, Bartolomeo, Sai, Ideo, Hajrudin, Orlumbus, Leo) pledge allegiance to Luffy aboard the Yonta Maria, forming the Straw Hat Grand Fleet.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Zoro and Usopp appear in the scraper list but are not mentioned in the summary; excluded from characters_present. Roronoa Zoro, Usopp, and other named crew/fleet members listed by scraper may be aboard but are not described as active in the summary. The main alliance-forming event (Straw Hat Grand Fleet formation) is a major lore moment. Fujitora's devil fruit (Zushi Zushi no Mi) is used to lift rubble. The 'fight' with Luffy vs Fujitora is brief and inconclusive — Luffy declares his moves, Fujitora repels him, then is interrupted by citizens. Arc end not tagged as the chapter is part of the Dressrosa arc's conclusion sequence but not the final chapter.

characters_detailed.name: Leo
characters_detailed.affiliation: Tontatta Tribe / Straw Hat Grand Fleet

title: Zou
summary: The Straw Hats and Trafalgar D. Water Law are making their way toward Zou by crossing the treacherous seas of the New World with the Barto Club, however, they encounter various misfortunes along the way, as the Barto Club does not have a navigator, forcing them to rely on Law's Vivre Card. Meanwhile, at Marine Headquarters, Admiral Kizaru muses over the destruction caused by the self-proclaimed son of Whitebeard - Edward Weevil, who is hunting down all the former allies of Whitebeard at the behest of his mother, Miss Buckin. Upon learning of Donquixote Doflamingo's defeat, Weevil and Buckin decide to find Monkey D. Luffy and interrogate him about Marco's location. A week later, the Straw Hats and allies arrive at Zou, which they are shocked to discover is on the back of a 1000-year old elephant and is purportedly home to an isolationist tribe that does not like humans.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Zou est révélée comme étant située sur le dos de Zunesha, un éléphant vieux de 1000 ans naviguant dans le New World, et est habitée par la tribu des Minks qui rejette les humains. Edward Weevil, se proclamant fils de Barbe Blanche, est introduit comme nouvelle menace chassant les anciens alliés de Barbe Blanche.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre est principalement un chapitre de transition et d'introduction. Sanji, Nami, Robin et Chopper ne sont pas explicitement mentionnés comme présents dans le résumé malgré leur appartenance probable à l'équipage voyageant vers Zou. Le scraper mentionne Zou comme personnage mais c'est en réalité le lieu/l'éléphant. Zunesha est traité ici comme personnage (l'éléphant millénaire). Edward Weevil et Buckin sont présentés pour la première fois. Borsalino/Kizaru est présent au QG de la Marine. Arc narratif: début de l'arc Zou.

title: Adventure in the Land Atop the Elephant's Back
summary: The Straw Hats and Law dodge the falling monkey, but Kin'emon and Kanjuro fail to notice it and fall off the dragon. They turn out to be alright and tell the others they will catch up later. Luffy and co. reach the back of Zou with the help of Kanjuro's drawing, which then reverts back into its original form (much to the sorrow of the crew, excluding Zoro and Law), and begin exploring the town they find. It seems to be deserted, but after a while they are attacked by members of the Mink Tribe, one of whom is wearing Nami's clothes.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: The arc label 'East Blue Saga' in the prompt appears incorrect for chapter 804 — this is the Zou Arc, part of the Yonko Saga. Straw Hats count is approximate as only Luffy, Zoro and Nami are explicitly named in the summary; other crew members likely present but unconfirmed. Ryunosuke (Kanjuro's dragon drawing) is technically not a real character but listed by the scraper. Carrot is introduced here as a new Mink Tribe member attacking the group. Raizo is mentioned in the scraper list but does not appear in the chapter summary — not tagged as present. The fight at the end is brief and unresolved.

characters_detailed.name: Kurozumi Kanjuro
characters_detailed.power_used: Fude Fude no Mi (drawing reverts to original form)

title: The Mink Tribe
summary: Wanda tells everyone that the rest of the Straw Hats lie dead in the Rightflank Forest. She then goes with Carrot to the Whale Forest, where the Heart Pirates try to stop the sudden dispute between Luffy and the guardians. Wanda and Carrot manage to calm down both parties. The Straw Hats discover that the country was only recently destroyed, while Wanda tells Luffy that the perpetrator is Jack. Wanda says she will take Luffy to the Right Belly Forest.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Le pays de Zou a été détruit récemment par Jack, identifié comme le responsable des ravages infligés au peuple Mink.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Zou et non East Blue Saga — le scraper indique 'East Blue Saga' mais le chapitre 805 appartient à l'arc Zou (Yonko Saga). Jack est mentionné comme antagoniste responsable de la destruction mais n'est pas présent physiquement dans ce chapitre. Les membres des Straw Hats présents incluent Luffy + le groupe de la Thousand Sunny (Zoro, Usopp, Franky, Nami, Robin) mais Sanji est absent sur Zou à ce stade — sa présence est incertaine. Straw_hats_count ajusté à 6 par précaution (Luffy, Zoro, Usopp, Franky, Nami, Robin). Le 'combat' entre Luffy et les gardiens Mink (Roddy, Blackback) est une dispute rapidement calmée plutôt qu'un vrai combat.

title: At the Fortress of Right Belly
summary: As the elephant showers its back with water, the Straw Hats flee to higher ground, while Kin'emon, Kanjuro, and the monkey have trouble climbing up. The Straw Hats arrive at a Minkmen settlement in the Right Belly Forest, where they are hailed as heroes. They meet Nami and Chopper, but Nami has grave news regarding Sanji.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Nami annonce une grave nouvelle concernant Sanji, suggérant un événement critique lié à ce personnage.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est listé comme 'East Blue Saga' dans le résumé mais le contexte (Zou, Minks, Law, Kin'emon) indique clairement qu'il s'agit de l'arc Zou (Zou Arc) dans le New World. La grave nouvelle concernant Sanji constitue un cliffhanger de type mystery. Zoro n'est pas mentionné explicitement dans le résumé mais est vraisemblablement parmi les Straw Hats présents — conservé dans la liste avec prudence. Jack, Issho, Sengoku et Nekomamushi sont listés par le scraper mais non mentionnés dans le résumé, donc non inclus dans characters_present. Wany est le crocodile géant (monture).

title: Capone "Gang" Bege
summary: The Straw Hats continue to recount what occurred two days ago on Zou. Pekoms and Capone Bege disembarked at the island and discovered it in ruins. Meanwhile, while celebrating with the minks, the Curly Hat Pirates learned that their pursuers had caught up with them. Caesar begged Sanji not to hand him, revealing that Big Mom commissioned some research from him, but he simply swindled her funds while hiding behind Doflamingo's protection. Sanji and Brook eventually confronted the new arrivals; to their surprise, Pekoms was grateful to the Straw Hats for saving his homeland and offered to spare them from the consequences of a second, new mission if they handed over Caesar. However, Bege shot Pekoms for disobeying Big Mom's orders, before ordering his men out of his body and instructing them to surround the Straw Hats. After their capture, Bege took the Straw Hats inside his body castle and revealed the new mission given to the Big Mom Pirates. Bege passed Sanji an invitation to Big Mom's next Tea Party, where he, the third son of the Vinsmoke Family, will be wed to the 35th daughter of the Charlotte Family, Pudding.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Sanji, troisième fils de la famille Vinsmoke, doit épouser Pudding, la 35e fille de la famille Charlotte, lors du prochain Tea Party de Big Mom — révélant le mariage arrangé entre les Vinsmoke et la famille Charlotte.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre est raconté en flashback (deux jours auparavant), ce qui place la narration dans un cadre rétrospectif. Vito est mentionné comme membre des Fire Tank Pirates mais son importance narrative est mineure ici. Pudding est nommée dans la révélation finale mais n'est pas physiquement présente à Zou. Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom) et Donquixote Doflamingo sont mentionnés mais absents physiquement. L'arc est la Zou Arc au sein du Whole Cake Island/Four Emperors Saga — le tag 'East Blue Saga' du scraper est erroné. Pekoms est blessé/vaincu par Bege mais pas confirmé mort.

characters_detailed.name: Capone Bege
characters_detailed.affiliation: Big Mom Pirates / Fire Tank Pirates

title: Tea Party Invitation
summary: The Curly Hat Pirates inside Bege's castle react with shock at the news of Sanji's upcoming wedding. Sanji asks Bege who was behind the wedding, and Bege reveals that it was Sanji's family. Nami, Brook and Chopper reflect on the little they know about Sanji's past, and wonder about who Sanji's family could be.  Sanji refuses to attend the wedding, but Bege threatens the other Straw Hats, and Vito whispers something to Sanji that convinces him to write a note. After Sanji gives the note to Nami, he frees the other Straw Hats from Bege's body and takes Caesar hostage at gunpoint. With Nekomamushi also arriving at the scene, Bege agrees to Sanji's demands and leaves Zou with Sanji and Caesar still inside his body castle. As the Straw Hats call after Sanji, Sanji's note falls onto the ground; it simply states that he was going to meet a woman, and that he would be back.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Sanji's family is behind his arranged wedding with Big Mom's family; Vito reveals a secret that convinces Sanji to comply; Sanji's true family origins are hinted at
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Luffy is not explicitly present in the scene inside Bege's castle based on the summary; the Straw Hats counted are Nami, Brook, Chopper, and Sanji. Vito's whispered secret is not revealed in the summary, creating a mystery cliffhanger. Bege uses his Shiro Shiro no Mi passively (castle body). The arc label 'East Blue Saga' in the prompt appears incorrect for chapter 813 which belongs to the Zou arc / Whole Cake Island lead-up; tagging sea_region as New World accordingly. Caesar is taken hostage but no physical fight occurs.

title: Raizo of the Mist
summary: Jack and his men sail through the ocean, alive after their battle with the Marines. On Zou, Kin'emon shows the crest of the Kouzuki Family on his back. However, Inuarashi and Nekomamushi start arguing again, but Momonosuke stops them, saying his father would be saddened to see this. Kin'emon reveals that Momonosuke is not his son, but is the son of Oden, the Daimyo of Kuri in Wano Country. Inuarashi and Nekomamushi reluctantly make peace in order to help him. The Straw Hats are taken to the tail of the Whale Tree, where there is a hidden door leading to Raizo. They see Raizo chained to a Poneglyph, and are saddened by his ugly appearance, but become entranced when Raizo uses ninja arts.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Momonosuke est révélé être le fils de Kouzuki Oden, le Daimyo de Kuri dans le Pays de Wano, et non le fils de Kin'emon. Raizo est retrouvé vivant, enchaîné à un Poneglyph.
locations: Zou - Queue de l'Arbre Baleine (chambre secrète)
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est catalogué comme 'East Blue Saga' dans la requête mais il s'agit en réalité de l'arc Zou (Zou Arc), appartenant à la saga Whole Cake Island / Four Emperors Saga. Jack est montré en mer, donc hors de Zou. Le Poneglyph auquel Raizo est enchaîné n'est pas explicitement identifié comme un Road Poneglyph dans le résumé, mais le contexte narratif de Zou le suggère fortement (Road Poneglyph de Zou) — taggé road_poneglyph_found=true avec réserve. Luffy, Zoro, Sanji, Usopp, Chopper, Brook ne sont pas mentionnés dans le résumé. Seuls Nami, Franky, Robin et Law sont cités parmi les Chapeaux de Paille présents à la scène de la queue.

title: Momonosuke, Heir to the Kouzuki Family
summary: Kin'emon, Kanjuro, and Raizo reveal their intentions to take back Wano Country from Kaidou and its shogun with the minks' help, and ask the Straw Hats to help them. However, Luffy refuses and tells Momonosuke to speak for himself. Remembering how Kaidou killed his father and mother, Momonosuke states his desire to take down Kaidou and asks the Straw Hats for help. Luffy accepts his request, but wants to get Sanji back first. Meanwhile, the minks prepare to throw a party to celebrate the truce between Inuarashi and Nekomamushi. However, Jack and his crew return to Zou, with Jack intending to kill the elephant itself.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Momonosuke reveals that Kaidou killed his father (Kouzuki Oden) and his mother, and officially asks the Straw Hats to help him take down Kaidou; Jack returns to Zou with the intent to kill Zunesha.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Sanji is mentioned by Luffy as someone to rescue first before going to Wano, but his physical presence in this chapter is unclear from the summary — tagged as present given the context. Kaidou is referenced but not physically present. Jack's return to Zou constitutes the cliffhanger. Kouzuki Oden's death is shown/referenced via Momonosuke's memories (flashback). The alliance formed is between the Straw Hats, the Kozuki retainers, and the Mink Tribe. Arc listed as East Blue Saga appears to be a scraper error — this chapter belongs to the Zou Arc (Yonko Saga).

title: Understood
summary: Jack and his men attack Zunesha's left front leg as Luffy and Momonosuke hear Zunesha telling them to command it. Momonosuke realizes that Jack is attacking Zunesha, and the minks prepare to head to sea to combat him. Momonosuke finds out that a long time ago, Zunesha was punished and not allowed to do anything except walking, and he can give it permission to fight. He does so, and Zunesha smashes Jack's fleet to pieces with its trunk. As the Straw Hats and minks prepare to head out, Scratchmen Apoo reports to Kaidou that their communications with Jack have been cut off.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Zunesha a été punie il y a longtemps et n'est autorisée qu'à marcher ; seul un ordre explicite peut lui permettre de se battre. Momonosuke est capable de lui donner cet ordre, et il le fait pour détruire la flotte de Jack.
locations: Mer des Nouveaux Mondes (flotte de Jack)
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc de Zou se conclut avec la destruction de la flotte de Jack par Zunesha. Kaidou est mentionné via la communication Den Den Mushi avec Apoo mais n'est pas physiquement présent sur Zou. Gol D. Roger et Kouzuki Oden sont mentionnés dans le contexte de la liste du scraper mais n'apparaissent pas dans le résumé ; ils ne sont donc pas inclus dans les personnages présents. Bariete n'apparaît pas non plus dans le résumé. L'arc 'East Blue Saga' indiqué par le scraper est probablement une erreur de classification — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Zou (Zou Arc, Four Emperors Saga).

characters_detailed.name: Zunesha
characters_detailed.power_used: Frappe de trompe (destruction de la flotte de Jack)

title: The WENP's Comic Strip
summary: On board Big Mom's ship, Vito talks to Sanji about Germa 66, revealing how they are the villains in the comic strip, Sora, Warrior of the Sea. Sanji gets annoyed at Vito constantly following him around, and tries to shake him off. This provokes the ire of Vito's crewmate Gotti, who threatens to attack Sanji, but Gotti is prevented from doing so by a woman. Meanwhile, the Sanji Retrieval Team is suffering from starvation and extreme heat, when Luffy manages to catch a fish. However, the fish's skin is poisonous and Luffy is brought to the brink of death. As the crew worry about Luffy's condition, the Thousand Sunny enters Big Mom's territory, where the crew encounters the ship of Germa 66.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Germa 66 est présenté comme les antagonistes du manga/manga strip fictif 'Sora, Warrior of the Sea', révélant la nature populaire et fictionnalisée de la famille Vinsmoke dans la culture grand-ligne
locations: Thousand Sunny (en route vers Totto Land)
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Luffy attrape un poisson mais le mange et est intoxiqué — scène de quasi-mort comique/tendue. Le combat entre Gotti et Sanji est évité par l'intervention d'une femme (probablement une membre du Fire Tank Pirates). Big Mom est mentionnée/présente sur son navire mais son niveau d'implication direct est flou. La Thousand Sunny entre dans le territoire de Big Mom et rencontre le navire de Germa 66 = cliffhanger d'arrivée. L'arc est Whole Cake Island, pas East Blue Saga — le scraper a mal catégorisé l'arc.

title: 0 and 4
summary: The hooded man on the Germa 66 ship introduces himself to the Sanji Retrieval Team as Vinsmoke Yonji, Sanji's younger brother, but refuses to provide an antidote for Luffy's poisoning. However, he is kicked off the ship and berated by his (and Sanji's) elder sister, Vinsmoke Reiju, who cures Luffy by sucking the poison into her own body with a mysterious ability. During a brief exchange, Reiju reveals part of the history and status of the Vinsmoke Family, as well as the family's own efforts to retrieve Sanji. Germa 66 then depart, agreeing not to disclose their encounter with the Straw Hats. Aladine watches the affair from underwater, and reports to Jinbe that Luffy is indeed on board the ship above.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Vinsmoke Reiju révèle l'histoire et le statut de la famille Vinsmoke, et indique que Germa 66 cherche à récupérer Sanji. Aladine confirme à Jinbe que Luffy est bien à bord du Thousand Sunny.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Yonji est présenté au chapitre précédent comme l'homme encapuchonné mais son identité est confirmée ici. Reiju est une première apparition physique. L'arc est bien le Whole Cake Island (Totto Land), rattaché à la saga Yonko et non East Blue — le scraper indique incorrectement 'East Blue Saga'. Sanji est mentionné mais physiquement absent du chapitre (il est déjà parti). Jinbe et Aladine apparaissent sous l'eau, en observation. Pekoms et Pedro sont vraisemblablement à bord du Sunny selon le contexte de l'arc mais ne sont pas mentionnés explicitement dans le résumé — leur présence est probable mais non confirmée par le résumé fourni. Charlotte Linlin, Duval, Noble, Sora, Levely sont mentionnés par le scraper mais n'apparaissent pas dans ce résumé — non inclus. Le 'combat' entre Reiju et Yonji est bref (coup de pied).

title: Totto Land
summary: The Sanji Retrieval Team disembarks on Cacao Island, an island close to Whole Cake Island in which everything on it is made of chocolate. Luffy and Chopper eat an entire cafe and are nearly arrested, but are saved by the cafe's owner, Charlotte Pudding. They converse with her, but Luffy accidentally reveals who he is. On Whole Cake Island, Big Mom oversees the preparation for the wedding Tea Party, which will occur in three days.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Totto Land est entièrement constitué d'îles dont tous les éléments sont comestibles (Cacao Island tout en chocolat) ; Big Mom prépare un Tea Party de mariage dans trois jours
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Usopp et Robin ne sont pas mentionnés dans le résumé bien qu'ils fassent partie de l'équipe de récupération — leur présence physique est probable mais non confirmée par le résumé ; Pekoms et Pedro sont membres de l'expédition et probablement présents sur Cacao Island mais non cités explicitement dans la scène. Charlotte Pudding est introduite ici pour la première fois. L'identité de Luffy est involontairement révélée à Pudding, ce qui constitue un élément de tension narrative léger.

title: 1 and 2
summary: Pudding discovers that she is talking to the Straw Hat Pirates, while the Sanji Retrieval Team also learns that Pudding is Sanji's betrothed. After explaining more about the Charlotte Family and her thoughts on Sanji, Pudding shows the team a route to Whole Cake Island that will allow them to arrive undetected. After restocking, the Sanji Retrieval Team return to the Thousand Sunny, but is unable to find Pekoms; instead, they find a message telling them to turn back. Elsewhere, on Broc Coli Island, Sanji's two older brothers lead Germa 66 to end a two-year war in four hours.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Pudding est révélée être la fiancée de Sanji, et Germa 66 sous la direction des frères aînés de Sanji met fin à une guerre de deux ans en quatre heures sur Broc Coli Island.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Charlotte Linlin est mentionnée dans le contexte de la Charlotte Family et de Totto Land mais n'apparaît pas physiquement dans ce chapitre. Pekoms disparaît mystérieusement laissant un message — sa présence est narrative (message) et non physique directe. La liste des Straw Hats compte Luffy, Nami et Chopper (3 membres) comme membres confirmés présents. Le combat de Germa 66 sur Broc Coli Island est résumé mais non détaillé — les participants directs exacts autres qu'Ichiji et Niji sont non précisés.

title: Emperor of the Sea, Charlotte Linlin
summary: The Sanji Retrieval Team travels on Pudding's route and approaches the next island on their route, Jam Island. They decide to avoid it in order to avoid surveillance and encounter a giant sea centipede. On Whole Cake Island, Big Mom gets a craving for croquembouche, causing her to rampage at the capital, Sweet City. Her sixteenth son, Charlotte Moscato, attempts to stop her, but he fails. Jinbe then arrives and feeds Big Mom some croquembouche tourists, returning her to normal. Jinbe prepares to discuss something important with Big Mom, and she questions in rage if he intends to leave her crew.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Jinbe rencontre Big Mom et semble prêt à lui annoncer son intention de quitter son équipage, révélant sa situation au sein de l'équipage des Pirates de Big Mom.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Tamago est mentionné comme présent sur Whole Cake Island dans cet arc mais son apparition physique dans ce chapitre précis est incertaine — inclus avec réserve. Charlotte Moscato est une première apparition. Le 'combat' de Big Mom contre Moscato est plutôt une démonstration de puissance unilatérale (rampage) que véritable affrontement. fight_occurs laissé à false. Jinbe est un ancien Shichibukai mais son titre est en suspens à ce point de l'histoire. L'arc est Whole Cake Island, non East Blue Saga — le scraper semble avoir commis une erreur sur l'arc.

title: A Man You Can Bet On
summary: A few hours ago, Jinbe asked his crew to allow him to join the Straw Hat Pirates, and they agreed. However, Charlotte Praline told them that no one who has left her mother's crew has ever come out alive. In the present, Big Mom agrees to let Jinbe leave her crew, but says he will have to lose something as she spins a roulette wheel. As night falls, the Sanji Retrieval Team battles some giant aquatic ants. Pedro reveals to the team that he once traveled with Pekoms as a pirate searching for poneglyphs, but were defeated when they came to Totto Land. They later reach Whole Cake Island and see someone standing onshore.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Pedro révèle qu'il a voyagé avec Pekoms en tant que pirate à la recherche de poneglyphes, et qu'ils ont été défaits lorsqu'ils sont arrivés à Totto Land.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre se déroule sur deux temporalités : quelques heures avant (Jinbe demandant à quitter les Sun Pirates / rencontrant Big Mom) et le présent (l'équipe de récupération de Sanji en route vers Whole Cake Island). Charlotte Moscato et Mont d'Or sont listés par le scraper mais leur présence n'est pas explicitement confirmée dans le résumé — ils pourraient apparaître lors de la scène avec Big Mom. Jinbe accepte de perdre quelque chose (roulette) pour quitter l'équipage de Big Mom, ce qui constitue une décision majeure. L'arc est correctement tagué comme Whole Cake Island (Big Mom Arc), non East Blue Saga comme indiqué par le scraper. La confiance est modérée car certains personnages secondaires sont incertains.

title: Adventure in the Mysterious Forest
summary: After arriving at the southwestern shore of Whole Cake Island, Pedro and Brook split off from the rest of the Sanji Retrieval Team to search for Big Mom's Road Poneglyph. Meanwhile, Luffy, Nami, Chopper, and Carrot disembark onto the shore. After Luffy thinks he sees Sanji, his group runs into the nearby forest filled with sweets, where they encounter new dangers.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est court et peu détaillé. Sanji, Charlotte Linlin, Pudding, Pekoms sont mentionnés dans la liste du scraper mais n'apparaissent pas physiquement dans le chapitre selon le résumé (Luffy croit voir Sanji mais c'est une erreur/illusion, Sanji n'est pas physiquement présent). Road Poneglyph est mentionné comme objectif de recherche mais n'est pas découvert. L'arc est en réalité l'arc Whole Cake Island (sous-arc de Big Mom), le tag 'East Blue Saga' fourni par le scraper est incorrect — corrigé en New World. Les 'nouvelles dangers' dans la forêt suggèrent un possible début de conflit mais aucun combat n'est confirmé dans le résumé.

title: Germa Kingdom
summary: In the Seducing Woods on Whole Cake Island, Nami, Chopper and Carrot are attacked by a member of the Big Mom Pirates. They find their way back to Luffy as he fights his mirrored self, but when they attempt to leave the forest, they find themselves returning constantly to the same spot. "Luffy" grabs Nami, and reveals herself to be Charlotte Brûlée. Meanwhile, beside Whole Cake Chateau, the Germa Kingdom is shown gradually converging. Inside its royal castle, Sanji and Vinsmoke Reiju discuss their past and the upcoming wedding, before being interrupted by their father.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Charlotte Brûlée révèle son identité après avoir imité Luffy grâce à son Mira Mira no Mi, piégeant Nami et le groupe dans la forêt des illusions. Le Germa Kingdom converge vers Whole Cake Island.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le 'Luffy' qui combat dans la forêt est en réalité Charlotte Brûlée utilisant le Mira Mira no Mi pour imiter Luffy — le vrai Luffy est peut-être aussi présent dans la forêt mais contrôlé/trompé par l'illusion selon le résumé. Le flashback de Sanji sur son passé est court/implicite (discussion avec Reiju sur leur passé). Randolph est identifié comme membre des Big Mom Pirates attaquant le groupe. Yonji est listé comme détecté mais n'apparaît pas clairement dans le résumé — possible apparition secondaire.

title: Vinsmoke Judge
summary: In a courtyard outside the Germa Kingdom's royal castle, Sanji duels his father. The fight brings back memories of his childhood, including his abuse at the hands of his brothers. Eventually, Judge emerges victorious, due in large part to his use of advanced technology, and his willingness to sacrifice Germa 66 soldiers in order to get the jump on Sanji. Back inside the castle, Reiju tends to Sanji's injuries while Judge explains his motivations for arranging both the wedding and the alliance. While Sanji is distracted by their father's comments, Reiju places exploding wristlets on Sanji's arms in order to prevent him from escaping the wedding.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Judge révèle ses motivations pour organiser le mariage et l'alliance avec Big Mom. Reiju place des bracelets explosifs sur les poignets de Sanji pour l'empêcher de s'échapper.
locations: Germa Kingdom - Cour du château royal
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le Haki d'Armement est mentionné dans les personnages détectés et cohérent avec le niveau de Judge ; Sanji l'utilise probablement aussi. Yonji est listé comme présent dans le scraper mais son rôle dans ce chapitre semble marginal (probablement mentionné ou brièvement visible). Charlotte Linlin est mentionnée en contexte mais n'apparaît pas physiquement. Les bracelets explosifs constituent la révélation/cliffhanger principal du chapitre.

title: The Nation of Souls
summary: Nami rejoined with Luffy after he mistakenly captured her thinking she was a duplicate. She informed him that Carrot was captured by Brûlée and Chopper got separated while fighting the witch's tree henchmen. Nami believed that the buried man with the giant head witnessed the whole scene and knows something. The man revealed that all the inanimate objects in the kingdom were brought to life by Big Mom's ability and Big Mom collects pieces of people souls as tax to bring more objects to life. The numerous duplicates that Luffy captured were of Brûlée's handiwork. The man also revealed that he was one of Big Mom's husbands, who was discarded after giving two daughters. Suddenly, Charlotte Cracker appeared and pulled the man out of the ground, angry that he is revealing vital information to the enemies. The man pleaded that he wants to see his daughters, Chiffon and Lola, one last time. Nami was shocked as she remembers who Lola is.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Big Mom utilise le Soru Soru no Mi pour prélever des morceaux d'âmes humaines comme taxe afin d'animer les objets inanimés du royaume. Pound révèle être l'un des ex-maris de Big Mom et le père de Chiffon et Lola, ce qui établit un lien direct avec Lola, connue de Nami.
locations: Whole Cake Island - Miroir-Monde / forêt de Brûlée
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc mentionné dans le prompt ('East Blue Saga') est manifestement erroné — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Whole Cake Island (Big Mom). Carrot, Chopper et Brûlée sont mentionnés comme absents/capturés et n'apparaissent que par référence narrative ; Carrot est capturée hors-scène. Chiffon et Lola sont mentionnées uniquement dans les paroles de Pound (pas d'apparition physique). Sanji et Pudding sont évoqués implicitement dans le contexte de l'arc mais n'apparaissent pas directement dans ce chapitre selon le résumé fourni. Le Soru Soru no Mi est décrit/expliqué par Pound mais non utilisé activement dans ce chapitre. Le Mira Mira no Mi est référencé via les duplicates de Brûlée. fight_occurs=false car aucun affrontement physique direct n'a lieu dans ce chapitre selon le résumé.

characters_detailed.name: Charlotte Brûlée
characters_detailed.power_used: Mira Mira no Mi (références aux duplicates)

title: The Vivre Card Lola Gave
summary: Nami realizes that the Vivre Card Lola gave her belongs to Big Mom. Chopper is revealed to have been captured by Brûlée as well. Cracker attempts to execute Pound but is stopped by Luffy, and the two start fighting. Nami and Pound run from the homies, who they manage to repel with the Vivre Card.

taxonomy.revelation_description: La Vivre Card que Lola avait donnée à Nami appartient en réalité à Big Mom (Charlotte Linlin), ce qui explique pourquoi les homies obéissent à son porteur.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le Soru Soru no Mi est référencé via la Vivre Card de Big Mom qui permet à Nami de repousser les homies (les âmes des homies obéissent à la peur de Big Mom). Chopper est mentionné comme capturé par Brûlée mais sa scène directe est dans le Mirro-World. Charlotte Lola et Charlotte Chiffon sont mentionnées en contexte narratif (lien avec la Vivre Card) sans apparition physique directe. Le résumé ne confirme pas d'usage explicite de Haki dans ce chapitre. L'arc est classé 'Whole Cake Island Arc' et non 'East Blue Saga' — probable erreur du scraper.

characters_detailed.power_used: Vivre Card de Big Mom (Soru Soru no Mi indirect)
