title: Luffy vs. Commander Cracker
summary: As Luffy fights Charlotte Cracker, Luffy finds himself overwhelmed by Cracker's swordsmanship and Armament Haki. At the same time, in her fight with Nami, Brûlée reveals that Eustass Kid and Scratchmen Apoo had previously been overwhelmed by Big Mom's forces, just as they were currently being; the only exception was Urouge, who managed to defeat one of the Sweet Four Commanders, but was then defeated by Cracker. Nami and Pound successfully fend off Brûlée's attack, with Nami knocking Brûlée out with Thunder Tempo, but Brûlée escapes into her Mirro-World. Soon after being antagonized by Cracker's taunts, Luffy activates Gear 4 and lands a critical hit on Cracker using Kong Gun.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Eustass Kid et Scratchmen Apoo ont été vaincus par les forces de Big Mom ; Urouge a vaincu l'un des Sweet Four Commanders (Snack) mais a ensuite été battu par Cracker.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Whole Cake Island (Big Mom arc), non East Blue Saga — le scraper a renseigné un arc incorrect. Eustass Kid, Scratchmen Apoo, Urouge et Charlotte Linlin sont mentionnés dans les révélations de Brûlée mais n'apparaissent pas physiquement dans le chapitre. Charlotte Snack est mentionné implicitement comme le Sweet Commander vaincu par Urouge. Gear 4 est activé et Kong Gun utilisé, mais Kong Gun existait déjà comme technique connue. Brûlée s'échappe dans le Mirro-World, ce qui justifie location_change=true.

title: I Owe You My Life
summary: The reunited Vinsmoke Family have breakfast in their castle. As they discuss their political affairs, Sanji and Niji engage in a confrontation which ends with Niji attacking the head chef, Cosette, and with Sanji once again denouncing his family's pride and values. Judge proceeds to threaten Zeff to pressure Sanji into cooperating with the upcoming wedding, leading Sanji to recall periods of his time at the Baratie.  Later, Sanji discovers a bloodied and beaten Cosette in the castle. Yonji appears and goads Sanji into confronting Niji again. Yonji then leads him to a sequestered area of the castle, where Sanji is shocked to discover soldiers of Germa 66 being monitored inside liquid capsules.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Des soldats de Germa 66 sont conservés dans des capsules remplies de liquide, révélant la nature expérimentale/artificielle des troupes de Germa.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom) et Tamago sont mentionnés ou impliqués dans la dynamique politique (mariage) mais leur présence physique directe dans ce chapitre est ambiguë selon le résumé ; ils sont inclus comme présents de manière indirecte. Zeff apparaît en flashback. Le 'combat' de Niji contre Cosette est une agression unilatérale plutôt qu'un vrai duel. La révélation des soldats Germa dans des capsules est majeure pour le lore de Germa 66. L'arc est Whole Cake Island, pas East Blue Saga — le scraper a mal catégorisé.

title: The Iron Mask
summary: In the laboratory of the Germa castle, Yonji reveals to Sanji that Germa 66's soldiers are all clones of past exceptional soldiers, developed using the joint research of Judge and Vegapunk. Ichiji and Niji then enter the laboratory, and Sanji attacks Niji for beating Cosette. Using Zeff as a threat, Niji retaliates and overpowers Sanji. Ichiji reminds Sanji of his position as their family's failure, leading Sanji to reminisce further about his childhood.  In Sanji's recollection of their early childhood, the Vinsmoke children were informed by their father that their bodies had been physically and intellectually enhanced using genetic manipulation, and that, through training, the siblings would develop the strength to lead Germa 66 to new glories. However, Sanji was continually outpaced by his siblings, leading them to bully him. Eventually, intent on erasing Sanji's existence from his plans, Judge held a state wake to "mourn" Sanji's accidental death; simultaneously, he had soldiers place an iron mask on Sanji and lock him in a dungeon, causing Sanji to break down and apologize piteously for being born weak.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Les soldats de Germa 66 sont des clones de soldats d'élite issus de la recherche conjointe de Judge et Vegapunk ; les enfants Vinsmoke ont été génétiquement améliorés physiquement et intellectuellement ; Judge a feint la mort de Sanji et l'a fait emprisonner avec un masque de fer dans un cachot.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Sanji compte comme seul membre des Straw Hats présent physiquement. Vegapunk est mentionné mais n'apparaît pas physiquement — absent de characters_present. Zeff est mentionné comme otage/menace par Niji mais n'apparaît pas physiquement (présent uniquement en référence) — inclus dans characters_detailed avec présence contextuelle. Cosette est mentionnée comme victime des coups de Niji mais n'est pas montrée directement dans le présent narratif. Le 'masque de fer' du titre fait référence à l'emprisonnement de Sanji enfant en flashback. L'arc est Whole Cake Island (Grand Line/New World), non East Blue Saga — le scraper indiquait East Blue Saga à tort.

title: To the East Blue
summary: As a child, Sanji was imprisoned in the dungeon for six months, during which time he remembered how he used to cook for his ill mother. After his siblings discovered him in the dungeon, his brothers continued to bully him but Reiju patched him up. She informed Sanji that the Germa Kingdom was preparing to cross from the North Blue into the East Blue, and Sanji tearfully expressed his hope of become a chef and escaping the kingdom forever in East Blue. Reiju, sympathizing with Sanji's plight, helped him escape; while Judge caught Sanji out of his cell, he allowed his third son to leave, only ordering Sanji not to associate himself with the Vinsmoke Family ever again. Back in the present, Reiju discovers a badly beaten Sanji inside the Germa laboratory, asking him why he continued to protect Zeff. In the Seducing Woods, Luffy and Cracker continue their gruelling 11-hour fight, with Luffy eating Cracker's Biscuit Soldiers and challenging him to produce more.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Reiju aide Sanji à s'échapper de Germa Kingdom avec la complicité tacite de Judge, qui ordonne à Sanji de ne jamais s'associer à nouveau à la famille Vinsmoke. Révélation que Judge savait et a laissé partir Sanji volontairement.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le flashback couvre l'enfance de Sanji en prison et son évasion aidée par Reiju avec la complicité silencieuse de Judge. Zeff est mentionné dans le présent narratif par Reiju mais n'apparaît pas physiquement — il est le sujet de la question posée à Sanji. Sanji est retrouvé sévèrement battu dans le laboratoire Germa. Le combat Luffy vs Cracker dure depuis 11 heures et n'est pas encore conclu. Les lieux se répartissent entre le flashback (Germa/North Blue/Red Line) et le présent (Whole Cake Island). La mère de Sanji est mentionnée en flashback mais ne reçoit pas de nom canonique dans ce chapitre.

title: Vinsmoke Sanji
summary: Cracker is sent flying into Sweet City, causing a state of emergency to be activated. Luffy and Nami continue on despite Pound's accounts of the wrath Big Mom has in store for them, riding on top of Kingbaum out of the Seducing Woods. Nami communicates with Chopper and Carrot through a mirror shard, but Chopper and Carrot are in trouble and the connection suddenly breaks. Luffy and Nami then run into the Germa Kingdom carriage where Sanji is, but after much thought Sanji kicks Luffy away, saying his name is Vinsmoke Sanji and that he has accepted his royal status, insulting the Straw Hats as commoners. However, Luffy does not believe Sanji and prepares to fight him.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Sanji rejette son identité de Straw Hat, se proclame 'Vinsmoke Sanji' et accepte son statut royal, insultant ses anciens compagnons de commoners.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Charlotte Linlin, Smoothie, Katakuri, Mont-d'Or, Galette, Opera sont mentionnés contextuellement via la menace de Big Mom et l'état d'urgence de Sweet City mais n'apparaissent pas physiquement dans le chapitre. Cracker est envoyé dans Sweet City (conséquence du combat précédent), sa présence est marginale. Chopper et Carrot apparaissent via le miroir shard (communication interrompue). Les Vinsmoke apparaissent dans le carrosse. Zeus et Prometheus non actifs dans ce chapitre. L'arc est Whole Cake Island (sous-arc de la Saga Totto Land), non East Blue Saga — erreur probable du scraper.

title: Luffy vs. Sanji
summary: Sanji continues claiming to disown Luffy and Nami, and he attacks the persistent Luffy, who does not fight back. Eventually, Sanji defeats Luffy and heads back to his family, but Luffy knows that this is all an act and tells Sanji that he will wait for him at this spot until he comes back, not willing to continue on his journey without his cook.

locations: Whole Cake Island — forest road near Whole Cake Chateau
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le combat Sanji vs Luffy est particulièrement remarquable car Luffy refuse de se défendre, rendant la victoire de Sanji creuse sur le plan moral. La promesse de Luffy d'attendre sans manger constitue le cliffhanger émotionnel central. Charlotte Cracker et Germa 66 sont listés par le scraper mais n'apparaissent pas physiquement dans ce chapitre selon le résumé fourni. La mention 'All Blue' par le scraper suggère probablement un dialogue de Sanji mais n'est pas confirmée comme une scène distincte. Les Big Mom Pirates ne semblent pas physiquement présents dans la scène principale.

title: Luffy and Big Mom
summary: Chopper and Carrot are captured by Brûlée and taken to her house, where she prepares to cook Carrot. However, Chopper has a plan to escape from his chains. Meanwhile, Big Mom takes the Vinsmoke Family to her library, where her son Mont-d'Or captures many kinds of humanoids and beasts inside of books. Vinsmoke Judge asks why he has not seen any giants in Totto Land, causing Big Mom to briefly become enraged before excusing herself to attend to other matters. She then contacts Luffy and Nami, who are trapped within another book, with a Den Den Mushi. Luffy maintains his determination to rescue Sanji and defeat Big Mom, but Big Mom asks about Lola, whom Nami explains that they are friends with. However, Big Mom reveals that she thinks little of Lola, as she ran away from a political marriage that would have enabled her to defeat the other Four Emperors and allowed her to become the Pirate King. Big Mom wants Nami to tell her Lola's location, but Luffy continues challenging her. Meanwhile, Sanji sits by a window, hoping the best for his crewmates. In the Room of Treasure, Pedro creates a distraction, and Brook prepares to unleash a special concert while the mink covers for him.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Big Mom révèle que Lola avait fui un mariage politique qui lui aurait permis de vaincre les autres Quatre Empereurs et de devenir le Roi des Pirates ; Big Mom méprise Lola pour cela.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Whole Cake Island (partie de Yonko Saga), et non East Blue Saga — le scraper contient une erreur d'arc. Le Fruit Buku Buku no Mi de Mont-d'Or est utilisé pour emprisonner des créatures/personnages dans des livres. Le Mira Mira no Mi de Brûlée est implicite via la Mirro-World et la capture de Chopper/Carrot. Aucun vrai combat physique n'a lieu : Chopper planifie une évasion mais ne combat pas encore. Vinsmoke Family présente (Judge est nommé, Niji mentionné dans le scraper mais pas dans le résumé — non retenu). Personnages comme Tamago, Bobbin, Perospero, Opera, Galette, Pudding, Lola (mentionnée seulement), géants (mentionnés seulement) non confirmés physiquement présents dans le chapitre selon le résumé.

title: Moist Cigarette
summary: Pudding gleefully looks forward to shooting Sanji and his family down, revealing her revolver, which carries bullets strong enough to penetrate through the Vinsmokes' genetic armor. She then wonders how Sanji will react to her true nature, mockingly making shocked faces. Meanwhile, Sanji stands outside and cries, being unable to light a cigarette due to the rain. In the Room of Treasure, Big Mom easily overwhelms Brook with Zeus and Prometheus, though Brook continues getting back up. He reveals to Big Mom that he is determined to get her Road Poneglyph at any cost in order to make their journey here worth something, even if they fail to get Sanji back. Meanwhile, in the Mirro-World, Brûlée is revived, and she reveals that Chopper and Carrot can ask the mirrors where they lead to. After asking some nearby mirrors about Sanji, Carrot starts drawing Sanji's face. Back in Pudding's room, she extracts and removes Reiju's memory of their encounter with the power of the Memo Memo no Mi. In the Prisoner Library, Opera receives orders to extract Lola's location out of Nami, and he threatens to torture her for noncompliance. However, Jinbe arrives, punches Opera, and prepares to free Luffy and Nami.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Pudding révèle qu'elle possède des balles capables de percer l'armure génétique des Vinsmokes et efface la mémoire de Reiju grâce au Memo Memo no Mi ; Chopper et Carrot apprennent que les miroirs peuvent leur dire où ils mènent.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc indiqué par le scraper (East Blue Saga) est incorrect — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Whole Cake Island (Big Mom Arc) de Totto Land. Zeus et Prometheus sont des hommes-météo/familiers de Big Mom utilisés comme armes, non des personnages indépendants au sens strict. Charlotte Lola est mentionnée par Opera mais n'est pas physiquement présente. La liste du scraper contient plusieurs éléments non-personnages (Walker 36 Caliber Percussion Revolver, Candy Jacket, Mirro-World, Memo Memo no Mi, Poneglyph, Nitro, Rabiyan) qui ont été écartés du tagging personnage.

title: Germa's Failure
summary: In an infirmary inside Whole Cake Chateau, Reiju wakes up and finds Sanji in the room. Sanji proceeds to explain to her what happened between Pudding and herself.  Inside the Prison Library, Jinbe burns and destroys Mont-d'Or's books, thereby releasing all those trapped inside. Luffy leaves Nami with Jinbe and goes off on his own to find Sanji. Back inside the infirmary, Reiju accepts Sanji's explanation of events and, to his shock, tells him to allow the assassinations to go ahead. She proceeds to explain her memory of the circumstances surrounding Sanji's birth, before urging him to flee the island with the other Straw Hat Pirates.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Reiju révèle les circonstances de la naissance de Sanji : le Facteur Lignager des fils Vinsmoke a été manipulé par Judge, et Sora s'est sacrifiée pour que Sanji conserve ses émotions humaines
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le Memo Memo no Mi (Fruit de Pudding) est mentionné de façon narrative comme ayant servi à effacer la mémoire de Reiju — Pudding n'apparaît pas physiquement dans ce chapitre mais est centrale à l'exposition. Reiju est le personnage dominant. Le flashback sur la naissance de Sanji implique Judge et Sora (décédée, apparaît en flashback). Jinbe libère les prisonniers de la Prison Library via le feu (action physique mais non-combat). Charlotte Mont-d'Or n'apparaît que de façon implicite à travers ses livres-prisons détruits. Smoothie et Opera sont dans la liste du scraper mais n'apparaissent pas dans le résumé — non inclus dans characters_detailed.

title: Not Here
summary: In Whole Cake Chateau's Treasure Room, Big Mom admires a captured Brook as her chess soldiers search Brook's belongings. After Big Mom learns that nothing has been stolen, Pudding arrives and asks to speak to her mother in private.  In the third floor courtyard, Hiyoko and Pedro continue their duel. Hiyoko begins to undergo a series of transformations, but an impatient Pedro reveals and sets off explosives hidden under his clothes. To his great surprise, he is pulled into the Mirro-World by Chopper and Carrot just before the courtyard explodes. Carrot shows the mirrors her portraits of Sanji, Luffy, Brook and Nami, and is informed by one mirror that Nami is with Jinbe.  On the third floor, Luffy noisily continues to search for Sanji. As Luffy passes the infirmary, Reiju pulls him into the medical room and informs him that her brother is aware of Pudding's deceptions. A relieved Luffy thanks Reiju before jumping out of the window, landing on a citizen's house. Recovering slightly, Luffy starts making his way back to the place where he had promised to be waiting for Sanji. Elsewhere in the Chateau, a solitary Sanji assesses his situation before deciding that he cannot turn back now.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Reiju confirms to Luffy that Sanji is aware of Pudding's deception and her true nature, relieving Luffy's fears about their crewmate.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Hiyoko est l'alter ego de Tamago en cours de transformation via le Tama Tama no Mi — identifié comme personnage distinct dans ce chapitre bien que ce soit Tamago. Le scraper mentionne Tamago/Tama Tama no Mi comme entrées séparées, ils ont été fusionnés sous Hiyoko (forme intermédiaire). Nami est mentionnée via un miroir (sa localisation confirmée avec Jinbe) mais n'apparaît pas physiquement en scène active — comptée comme présente. Brook est capturé mais physiquement présent dans la salle au trésor. L'arc mentionné comme 'East Blue Saga' semble être une erreur du scraper — ce chapitre appartient clairement à l'arc Whole Cake Island (Big Mom Arc) de l'ère New World.

title: Gugyurururu!!!
summary: After being attacked by Sanji, Bobbin recovers and vows to take care of the situation himself. Sanji, meanwhile, heads for the location where Luffy had promised to be waiting for him. Inside the Mirro-World, Nami, Chopper, Carrot, Pedro and Jinbe locate Brook, who is still being held by a sleeping Big Mom. The group hatches a plan to silently switch Brook with an identical corpse. After a few tries, they manage to wake Brook and make the switch. Brook then reveals that he succeeded in stealing rubbings of Big Mom's poneglyphs, having stored them inside his skull. After arriving at the promised location, Sanji begins to search for Luffy. Hearing a loud growl, he follows the sound and spots his captain, weak and asleep from hunger at the base of the defeated Kingbaum.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Brook révèle avoir réussi à copier les poneglyphes de Big Mom et les avoir stockés dans son crâne, permettant aux Chapeaux de Paille d'obtenir des informations cruciales pour la Route Finale.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Bobbin est présent au début du chapitre. Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom) est présente mais endormie. Kingbaum apparaît implicitement (Luffy est au pied de Kingbaum vaincu). Zeus, Prometheus et Napoleon sont des armes de Big Mom potentiellement présentes mais non mentionnés activement. Mirro-World est un lieu, pas un personnage — retiré des personnages. 'Tea Party', 'poneglyph', 'Diesel' sont également des entités/lieux/concepts et non des personnages. Le road_poneglyph est mentionné via les frottis (rubbings) obtenus par Brook. fight_occurs=false car la confrontation Sanji/Bobbin s'est déroulée avant le chapitre (Bobbin se 'remet' d'une attaque déjà survenue).

title: Rook
summary: The Sanji Retrieval Team finds Sanji and Luffy from mirror shards on the outskirts of Sweet City, and Luffy and Sanji tell them about their intention to crash the wedding and save Sanji's family. Knowing that they are vastly outnumbered by Big Mom's forces, Jinbe asks Luffy about proposing an alliance to Capone Bege, who also seeks to bring down Big Mom in order to destabilize the world's structure of power. Pekoms had been shot by Bege after being offered to work with the latter but refusing, though had been saved by one of Jinbe's comrades. Despite Bege's actions, Luffy reluctantly agrees to work towards a deal. Inside his crew's hideout, Bege learns of his upcoming meeting with Luffy and is willing to work with his fellow Supernova, though will not hesitate to take Luffy down if the latter angers him.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Capone Bege complote pour renverser Big Mom afin de déstabiliser la structure de pouvoir mondial ; Pekoms a été abattu par Bege après avoir refusé de collaborer mais a été sauvé par un compagnon de Jinbe.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Whole Cake Island (Big Mom arc), pas East Blue Saga — probable erreur du scraper. Pekoms apparaît via un récit rétrospectif mentionné (flashback partiel). Brûlée et Diesel sont présents dans le Mirro-World avec Chopper et Brook. Kingbaum est mentionné dans ce contexte. Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom) est mentionnée mais pas physiquement présente dans ce chapitre. La Vinsmoke Family, Germa 66 et Sun Pirates sont mentionnés mais non présents physiquement. L'alliance Luffy-Bege n'est pas encore officiellement formée dans ce chapitre, seulement envisagée.

title: Emperor Assassination Plan
summary: Inside the hideout of the Fire Tank Pirates, Capone Bege explains the details of his plan to assassinate Big Mom. As Luffy's group questions the possibility of physically injuring Big Mom, Bege explains his plan to trigger one of Big Mom's tantrums, as well as the plan to deploy the new gas weapons created by Caesar Clown. Bege also informs Luffy of his key role as the bait to distract Big Mom's subordinates, which Luffy readily accepts. Finally, all sides confirm that their alliance concludes upon their successful getaway, which will be via the Mirro-World, before wishing each other luck in executing their respective roles. Sanji then remarks that he must return to the Chateau to prepare for his "wedding", and all parties disperse to see to their respective preparations.  As the dawn of the wedding day breaks over Totto Land and the Germa Kingdom, their citizens awaken and begin to celebrate in anticipation. With the tea party's Underworld guests beginning to arrive, both Big Mom and the Vinsmoke Family are shown getting ready. At the same time, a fully-dressed Pudding muses to her homies that she hopes her dress will not become spattered with blood, before sighing about how tiresome it will be to have to modify the guests' memories at the conclusion of the ceremony.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Pudding révèle qu'elle prévoit d'utiliser le Memo Memo no Mi pour effacer les souvenirs des invités après la cérémonie, confirmant sa véritable nature malveillante et ses plans contre les Vinsmoke.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est catalogué 'East Blue Saga' par le scraper mais il s'agit clairement de l'arc Whole Cake Island (New World). Straw Hats comptés : Luffy, Sanji, Nami, Brook, Pedro (bien que Pedro soit techniquement un allié externe). L'alliance Bege-Luffy est officiellement scellée dans ce chapitre avec plan détaillé. Carmel est mentionnée implicitement via le plan déclenchant la crise de Big Mom (photo de Carmel). Haki Royal de Big Mom mentionné comme facteur dans les crises mais non utilisé dans le chapitre. Charlotte Brûlée présente via le Mirro-World comme outil d'évasion mentionné.

title: Natural Born Destroyer
summary: Sixty-three years ago, a five-year-old Charlotte Linlin was abandoned by her parents on Elbaph. There, she was taken in by Mother Carmel, who ran the "Sheep's House" which took in lost children of all races. Despite being a human, Linlin's massive size and strength made her inadvertently wreak havoc on other peoples' lives, though Carmel forgave her for her actions. Linlin developed a craving for semla during a feast, and when she was forced to partake in 12 days of fasting during the Winter Solstice Festival, her craving caused her to go on a rampage, bringing destruction to a village and taking down giants. Offended by her actions and seeing her as uncontrollable, the giant Jorul attempted to kill Linlin despite Carmel's pleas.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Révélation sur l'enfance de Big Mom à Elbaph : abandonnée par ses parents à 5 ans, elle fut recueillie par Mother Carmel dans la Sheep's House, montrant ses capacités destructrices incontrôlables dès son plus jeune âge.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre est entièrement un flashback se déroulant 63 ans avant le présent narratif. Charlotte Linlin est présente en tant que fillette de 5 ans. Plusieurs géants sont introduits ou montrés jeunes (Dorry, Brogy, Oimo, Kashii, Hajrudin, Gerd, Raideen, Goldberg, Loki, Jarul, Jorul), bien que le résumé reste centré sur Linlin et Carmel. Jorul tente de tuer Linlin, constituant un affrontement non conclu dans ce chapitre. La mort éventuelle de Jorul ou de Carmel n'est pas confirmée dans ce chapitre. Le titre 'Natural Born Destroyer' fait référence au caractère destructeur inné de Linlin.

title: Happy Birthday
summary: Sixty-three years ago, Linlin ended up fatally injuring Jorul during her rampage, and as she was satiated with semla, Carmel created a sun homie to act as a god to appease the giants. However, this was not enough to atone Linlin, and Carmel was forced to move the Sheep's House to another island. Life in the orphanage resumed as normal, but Carmel, who was actually a child trafficker who sold the orphans to the Marines and Cipher Pol, prepared to sell Linlin. In the meantime, the Sheep's House celebrated Linlin's sixth birthday with a great feast, but as Linlin ate, Carmel and all her housemates suddenly disappeared. This caused her to enter a crisis, and in the present, Big Mom continues crying out as she remembers this sad time.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Carmel est révélée être une trafiquante d'enfants travaillant pour les Marines et le Gouvernement Mondial/CP0, préparant de vendre Linlin. De plus, la disparition mystérieuse de Carmel et des orphelins lors du sixième anniversaire de Linlin est montrée, laissant entendre que Linlin aurait involontairement absorbé le Fruit du Démon de Carmel en les mangeant.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ce chapitre est entièrement un flashback sur la jeunesse de Big Mom (Linlin). La disparition soudaine de Carmel et des orphelins lors du festin d'anniversaire suggère fortement que Linlin les a dévorés inconsciemment et a absorbé le Fruit du Démon de Carmel (Soru Soru no Mi), mais cela n'est pas explicitement confirmé dans ce résumé. Jorul est blessé mortellement mais il ne meurt pas nécessairement dans ce chapitre (il survit comme géant selon le lore). La mort en flashback est donc incertaine. Le tag 'marines_present' est justifié par la mention que Carmel vendait des enfants aux Marines. Nika est mentionné par le scraper mais ne semble pas présent dans le résumé du chapitre.

title: KX Launcher
summary: 63 years ago, Linlin's role in Carmel's disappearance caused her to be even more reviled by the giants, and caused a nearby Streusen to take interest in her. Together, Linlin and Streusen formed the beginnings of the Big Mom Pirates, and Linlin's power quickly caused her to become infamous at a young age. Linlin turned the island where the Sheep's House was into Whole Cake Island, where she sought to achieve Carmel's ideals. In the present, the Fire Tank Pirates shoot their KX Launchers at Big Mom, but the power of her scream destroys the shots before they hit her. The Big Mom Pirates then regain their composure, and Caesar attempts to fly in the mirror for the alliance to make a getaway, but Big Mom's scream shatters the mirror. Surrounded by enemies, Bege transforms into a giant fortress and tells his allies to get inside him.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Le flashback révèle comment Streusen a rencontré Linlin après la disparition de Carmel, et comment ensemble ils ont fondé les Big Mom Pirates. Linlin transforme l'île de la Maison des Moutons en Whole Cake Island pour honorer les idéaux de Carmel.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Whole Cake Island (sous-arc de Totto Land), rattaché à la Saga Four Emperors et non East Blue Saga — le scraper commet une erreur sur l'arc. La mort de Carmel est implicite (disparition mystérieuse lors du festin de Linlin, très probablement dévorée) mais pas confirmée explicitement dans ce chapitre comme une mort en flashback — taggée false par prudence. Katakuri est mentionné comme reprenant ses esprits avec les Big Mom Pirates mais son rôle actif dans le chapitre est minimal. Le Mochi Mochi no Mi de Katakuri et le Kuku Kuku no Mi de Streusen sont dans la liste du scraper mais leur utilisation directe dans CE chapitre n'est pas confirmée par le résumé — inclus par association. Les KX Launchers sont des armes de Caesar Clown, utilisées ici par les Fire Tank Pirates.

characters_detailed.name: Charlotte Linlin
characters_detailed.power_used: Soru Soru no Mi — cri dévastateur (Soul Pocus / scream)

characters_detailed.name: Capone Bege
characters_detailed.power_used: Shiro Shiro no Mi — transformation en forteresse géante

characters_detailed.name: Caesar Clown
characters_detailed.power_used: KX Launcher / tentative de fuite via miroir

title: Parting
summary: Bege finds himself under attack by Big Mom, with the rest of her crew lying in wait. He comes up with an escape plan to turn back human and have Caesar fly him out, and the Vinsmoke Family heads out to distract Big Mom in order to get rid of their debt with Sanji. As the plan is initiated, Big Mom overwhelms Reiju with her opening attack, causing both Luffy and Sanji to come out and clash with her.

locations: Whole Cake Island — Whole Cake Chateau surroundings
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The arc is listed as 'East Blue Saga' by the scraper but the chapter clearly takes place on Whole Cake Island (New World), part of the Whole Cake Island Arc (Yonko Saga). Sea region corrected accordingly. Charlotte Lola is listed by the scraper but does not appear to be physically present in the chapter — omitted from characters_present. Wano Country, Armament Haki, Germa Kingdom, East Blue, Big Mom Pirates, Four Emperors are factions/concepts rather than characters and handled at tag level. Vinsmoke Family treated as a group; Judge and Reiju named individually as active participants. Zeff is not present in this chapter. Capone Pez is present inside Bege's fortress body. Prometheus used as a weapon/avatar of Big Mom in the clash.

characters_detailed.name: Capone Bege
characters_detailed.power_used: Shiro Shiro no Mi (Big Father fortress form)

characters_detailed.name: Prometheus
characters_detailed.power_used: Homie (fire elemental created by Soru Soru no Mi)

title: Trapped Like Sweets in a Cage
summary: Katakuri prepares to hunt down the Sanji Retrieval Team himself, but the Big Mom Pirates are suddenly approached by Big Mom, who is on a rampage induced by a craving for wedding cake. Perospero lies that the Straw Hats have a second wedding cake with them, and Big Mom hunts them down. Pudding then reveals that she can make a wedding cake on Cacao Island if she forces Chiffon to help her. Meanwhile, the Sanji Retrieval Team finds a newly resurrected Kingbaum and forces him to carry them, but Big Mom suddenly flies in on Zeus and prepares to attack them.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Pudding révèle qu'elle peut fabriquer un nouveau wedding cake sur Cacao Island en forçant Chiffon à l'aider, offrant une solution pour calmer Big Mom.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Kingbaum apparaît comme résurrection (homie détruit puis ressuscité), ce qui constitue le 'character_return'. Zeus est utilisé comme monture par Big Mom (Soru Soru no Mi implicitement). Le résumé mentionne plusieurs personnages (Tamago, Sun Pirates, Jinbe, Bege, Germa, etc.) qui ne semblent pas physiquement présents dans ce chapitre selon le résumé fourni — ils sont donc exclus des characters_present. Napoleon est mentionné indirectement via Big Mom. L'arc est Whole Cake Island (Yonko Saga) et non East Blue Saga — le scraper semble erroné sur ce point.

title: Pudding Coincidentally Appears!!
summary: Big Mom is unaffected by Nami's lightning blast, and as the Straw Hats continue running, Pudding and Chiffon meet up with them. They try to tell Sanji about their plan to make a cake to feed Big Mom, but Pudding is split between her lovestruck and murderous attitudes towards him. Sanji agrees to help, and Pudding and Chiffon guide the other Straw Hats to the Thousand Sunny, where Chopper and Brook are holding their own against the Chess Soldier army.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre se situe dans l'arc Whole Cake Island (Big Mom arc), pas dans l'East Blue Saga comme indiqué dans les métadonnées — probable erreur du scraper. Luffy est présent mais en fuite avec l'équipage, sans action de combat directe confirmée dans le résumé. L'alliance entre Pudding/Chiffon et les Straw Hats pour faire le gâteau est considérée comme une nouvelle alliance. Rabiyan est le tapis volant de Pudding. Prometheus et Zeus sont des manifestations du fruit de Big Mom. Le Memo Memo no Mi appartient à Pudding mais son utilisation dans ce chapitre spécifique n'est pas explicitement confirmée dans le résumé.

title: Not Sweet
summary: Perospero traps Brook and Chopper in candy and prepares to kill them by turning their whole bodies into candy. The Straw Hats then emerge onto the coast while still being chased by Big Mom, and Luffy attacks Katakuri to get him off the Thousand Sunny. As a naval blockade is called to converge on the Straw Hats, Katakuri knocks Luffy down while Perospero subdues Pedro after the mink tries to attack him. However, Pedro then lights up the bombs in his jacket, causing a massive explosion that engulfs him and Perospero.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Pedro's death is treated as present/confirmed in this chapter via the explosion he causes. The arc is listed as 'Whole Cake Island Arc' but the scraper labeled it East Blue Saga — that appears to be a scraper error. Katakuri's Mochi Mochi no Mi is used to knock Luffy down. Haki is not explicitly confirmed as used in the summary. Brook and Chopper are trapped but not actively fighting. Pudding and Chiffon are listed as detected but do not appear in the summary — they are not included in characters_present.

title: One of Big Mom's "3 Sweet Commanders", Katakuri
summary: Jinbe encourages the Sanji Retrieval Team to stop mourning Pedro's sacrifice and press on in honor of it, and as they head to Cacao Island, Big Mom continues pursuing them on a candy road made by Perospero. Meanwhile, Sanji, Pudding, and Chiffon reach Cacao Island, and Chiffon reveals that Lola was once the Minister of Chocolate, and that Pudding refuses to take her place. In the Mirro-World, Katakuri manages to perfectly counter Luffy's attacks by forming fists out of mochi that act in the exact same way to Luffy's stretched punches. Luffy is left planted in the wall as Katakuri overwhelms him with both speed and power.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Lola était autrefois la Ministre du Chocolat de Totto Land, et Pudding refuse de prendre sa place.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Pedro est mentionné comme sacrifice récent motivant l'équipage — sa mort est passée (chapitre précédent) et évoquée narrativement, non comme flashback formel. Lola mentionnée indirectement via Chiffon. Gear 2 et Gear 3 figurent dans la liste du scraper mais le résumé ne précise pas lesquels sont utilisés explicitement — conservés par défaut comme usage général du Gomu Gomu no Mi. Katakuri fait des poings de mochi mimant les attaques étirées de Luffy, ce qui illustre son fruit spécial sans relever de l'Éveil.

title: Beyond the Emperor's Expectations
summary: In the Mirro-World, the duel between Luffy and Katakuri continues. Brûlée, having overheard Luffy's earlier conversation with Nami, conveys to Perospero that the Straw Hats survived the tidal wave and are on their way to Cacao Island. Meanwhile, back on Whole Cake Island, Mont-d'Or learns that the Big Mom Pirates have lost track of the Fire Tank Pirates. At the Germa Kingdom, the Vinsmoke siblings defeat the pursuit squad sent after them and trick Mont-d'Or into thinking that Germa 66 have been defeated. Germa 66 prepare to set sail after hearing where the Straw Hats were going.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Arc label 'East Blue Saga' dans le scraper est incorrect — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Whole Cake Island (Big Mom Arc). Pekoms, Pedro, Tamago, Chiffon, Charlotte Linlin mentionnés dans la liste du scraper mais leur présence physique dans ce chapitre n'est pas confirmée par le résumé ; ils ont été exclus des personnages présents. La présence de Nami est induite par la mention d'une conversation Luffy/Nami entendue par Brûlée, ce qui implique une communication (Den Den Mushi probable) mais pas nécessairement une présence physique directe dans le Mirro-World. Gear 4 listé dans les tags du scraper mais aucune activation explicite dans le résumé. Haki non explicitement mentionné dans le résumé.

title: Merienda
summary: Katakuri prevents Luffy from activating Gear 4 and ends their fight by piling mochi on Luffy in order to get to his snack time. Receiving a large quantity of sweet treats, Katakuri hides himself in a house and feasts with gluttonous abandon. However, Luffy escapes by consuming the mochi and intrudes on Katakuri's snack time, enraging the Sweet Commander. The two start to brawl again, and Luffy deduces a weakness of Katakuri's as he finally manages to activate Gear 4.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Luffy découvre une faiblesse de Katakuri et parvient à activer Gear 4 malgré les tentatives de Katakuri pour l'en empêcher ; la scène du snack time révèle la nature cachée et vulnérable de Katakuri.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le titre 'Merienda' désigne la collation/goûter de Katakuri, moment clé du chapitre. La faiblesse de Katakuri découverte par Luffy est vraisemblablement liée à son visage/bouche (révélée dans les chapitres suivants), mais dans ce chapitre elle est seulement 'déduite' sans confirmation explicite. Gear 4 est finalement activé en fin de chapitre. L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' dans le prompt semble erroné — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Whole Cake Island (Big Mom/Totto Land), partie du Yonko Saga.

title: Who Is That?
summary: With Gear 4, Luffy gains the upper hand against Katakuri. However, the battle shifts to Katakuri's favor once he regains his composure. Pound arrives at Cacao Island, wanting to see Chiffon, but he is later attacked by Oven. Sanji, Pudding, Chiffon, and the chefs continue working on making the wedding cake. In the ocean, Praline uses her singing voice to captivate the territorial sea slugs, preventing them from tracking the Straw Hats' location.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' semble erroné — le chapitre 884 se situe dans l'arc Whole Cake Island (Big Mom Pirates), New World. Le nombre de membres de l'équipage présents (3) inclut Luffy, Nami et Jinbe (allié temporaire). Aladine est présent en tant que membre des Sun Pirates accompagnant Praline. Charlotte Brûlée, Mont-d'Or et d'autres sont mentionnés par le scraper mais n'apparaissent pas dans le résumé fourni — ils n'ont pas été inclus. L'état de santé de Luffy est marqué 'injured' car le combat avec Katakuri reprend l'avantage contre lui.

title: It's Brûlée!!!
summary: Luffy runs out of time in Gear 4, so he retreats from his battle with Katakuri and escapes the Mirro-World while holding Brûlée captive. They end up on Nuts Island, where Big Mom is rampaging. Perospero and Amande notice Luffy and Perospero has Big Mom attack him as they pursue the Straw Hat. Meanwhile, the Big Mom Pirates assemble to go after their enemies. On Cacao Island, Sanji finishes his secret ingredient, whipped simsim cream, which can nearly kill people with deliciousness. With the core pieces of the cake made, the group on Cacao Island prepares to head out.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Arc tag shows 'East Blue Saga' but this chapter clearly belongs to the Whole Cake Island arc (Big Mom arc). Gear 4 timeout is referenced but the fight with Katakuri is temporarily paused rather than concluded. Luffy takes Brûlée hostage to escape the Mirro-World, which is a key tactical move. Sanji's whipped simsim cream is a plot element but not a combat technique. Big Mom's fruit (Soru Soru no Mi) is implicitly used as she rampages under Perospero's direction. Sun Pirates and Fire Tank Pirates are mentioned as assembling but not explicitly shown acting.

title: Way of Life
summary: As the chefs leave the Sweets Factory with the base cake and are heading for the port, they encounter Oven, who prepares to punish Chiffon for her actions. Pound and a disguised Sanji free her temporarily, before Oven recaptures her and uses her as a hostage to force Capone Bege to surrender. Bege seemingly agrees, but upon nearing Cacao Island's port, he fires at Oven, knocking him down and releasing Chiffon in the process. Meanwhile, journeying across Totto Land through the Mirro-World, Luffy and a captured Brûlée are in hiding as Luffy tries to figure out a way to defeat Katakuri.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Big Mom (Charlotte Linlin) est présente dans le contexte de l'arc mais pas explicitement mentionnée comme apparaissant physiquement dans ce chapitre — marquée yonko_present=true car son ombre plane sur l'arc. Katakuri est mentionné dans le contexte de Luffy dans le Mirro-World mais sans combat actif dans ce chapitre. Pudding est mentionnée parmi les chefs partis avec le gâteau. Carrot et Nami sont présumées à bord du Thousand Sunny, mentionné dans les éléments détectés. L'Observation Haki est mentionné dans le contexte de l'entraînement de Luffy contre Katakuri.

title: Somewhere Someone is Wishing for Your Happiness
summary: Bege continues his assault on Cacao Island, revealing that the Nostra Castello can travel on land with tank treads. Sanji gets the cake on the ship, and the cake baking group successfully gets off the island. However, Oven damages the Nostra Castello by boiling the ocean, but Pound rescues its crew by attacking his stepson. Oven retaliates by attacking Pound with a flaming sword, but Pound is happy to have seen Chiffon and his grandson Pez. Meanwhile, Big Mom and her fleet catch up to the Thousand Sunny.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le scraper inclut des entrées non-personnages (Nostra Castello, Thousand Sunny, WCI31, Devil Fruit, Netsu Netsu no Mi, Cacao Island) qui ont été filtrées. Charlotte Lola est mentionnée indirectement via Pound qui est son père biologique et père de Chiffon par extension — sa présence est incertaine; incluse car pertinente au contexte émotionnel. Pound est le personnage central émotionnellement de ce chapitre malgré sa défaite imminente. L'arc mentionné comme 'East Blue Saga' semble être une erreur du scraper — ce chapitre appartient clairement à l'arc Whole Cake Island (Big Mom Pirates Arc). La mort de Pound n'est pas confirmée dans ce chapitre, juste fortement implicite.

title: Lion
summary: Luffy returns to the Mirro-World and confronts Katakuri again. Katakuri asks if Luffy returned to be killed or to join the Big Mom Pirates. Luffy answers by claiming that he'll defeat Katakuri and they clash once more. Meanwhile, the Big Mom Pirates fleet has surrounded the Thousand Sunny as Smoothie and Daifuku joined in the pursuit of the Straw Hats. Perospero notices that Big Mom has lost weight due to her chasing the Thousand Sunny for hours. Carrot tells the Straw Hats that she'll handle the situation due to the full moon and proceeds to transform into her Sulong form.  Carrot begins her attack on Daifuku's ship and proceeds to destroy the helm as the Straw Hats are stunned by her strength.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Carrot révèle sa transformation Sulong grâce à la pleine lune, une capacité des Minkens encore peu montrée en action.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est catégorisé comme 'East Blue Saga' par le scraper, mais le chapitre 888 appartient en réalité à l'arc Whole Cake Island (Totto Land) de la Saga Yonko. La transformation Sulong de Carrot est une révélation majeure sur les capacités des Minkens. Le Rumble Ball de Chopper mentionné dans le scraper n'est pas utilisé dans ce résumé. Bavarois est listé mais son rôle reste mineur dans le résumé. L'arc est 'East Blue Saga' est une erreur du scraper.

title: Big Mom on the Ship
summary: Despite not finding cake on the Thousand Sunny, Big Mom attacks the Straw Hats. She overpowers them and damages the Sunny, but Jinbe unleashes a surprise attack to knock her off the ship. Nami then baits Zeus with thunderclouds, and the cloud homie's angry attack allows Brook to slice it in half before Nami manipulates its energy to deliver a massive shock to Big Mom. Nami then captures Zeus, but a weakened Big Mom prepares to attack again.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Arc tag says East Blue Saga but context is clearly Whole Cake Island arc in New World. The scraper list included 'Homies', 'Emperor', 'Armament Haki', 'Fish-Men', 'Fish-Man Karate' as non-character entries — these were used as attributes rather than character names. Bavarois and Perospero are listed as present but their specific actions in this chapter are not detailed in the summary; included based on scraper detection. Zeus is treated as a named character/homie. Nami capturing Zeus is treated as a notable technique/event. Fish-Man Karate is likely Jinbe's technique used against Big Mom.

title: Flampe, 36th Daughter of Charlotte
summary: Flampe's shot on Luffy allows Katakuri to seize the advantage and pummel him. However, Katakuri realizes what Flampe has done, and stabs himself to compensate for his advantage before berating her for her actions. Katakuri's display of weakness as well as the uncovering of his mouth causes Flampe's perfect image of Katakuri to be shattered, and started to hate her older brother for being an imperfect being. Both Luffy and Katakuri knock her and her subordinates out with Supreme King Haki before resuming their fight on equal terms.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Katakuri's true face (his mouth) is revealed to Flampe and her subordinates, shattering the perfect image they had of him; Katakuri deliberately stabs himself to even the fight rather than accept an unfair advantage, showing his code of honor.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Flampe was introduced earlier in the arc; this chapter focuses heavily on her character moment and her disillusionment with Katakuri. The arc tag is listed as 'East Blue Saga' in the prompt but this chapter clearly takes place during the Whole Cake Island arc (New World / Big Mom arc). Silvers Rayleigh is listed by the scraper but does not appear in the summary — likely a scraper error referencing Haki training context; not tagged as present. The Conqueror's Haki (Supreme King Haki) is jointly used by both Luffy and Katakuri to knock out Flampe and her subordinates. Flampe's subordinates are knocked out but not named individually.

title: Luffy the Pirate vs. Commander Katakuri
summary: Luffy unveils his new Gear 4 form, Snakeman, which makes him slimmer and faster. Luffy unleashes a new set of moves against Katakuri and pushes his dodging abilities to the limit, but Katakuri manages to fight back with powerful mochi attacks. The two fighters then claim that they will end the fight and engage in a tremendously powerful clash.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Arc incorrectement labellisé 'East Blue Saga' par le scraper — le chapitre 895 appartient à l'arc Whole Cake Island (Big Mom Arc), partie du Yonko Saga dans New World. Gear 4 Snakeman est une nouvelle forme/transformation, considérée comme nouvelle technique révélée. Le combat ne se conclut pas dans ce chapitre, il se termine au chapitre suivant. Katakuri est un Sweet Commander de l'équipage de Big Mom. Le Haki d'Observation (Kenbunshoku) est probablement utilisé par les deux combattants dans ce chapitre (Katakuri est connu pour son Observation avancé), mais le résumé ne le mentionne pas explicitement, donc seul l'Armement est tagué avec certitude.

characters_detailed.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters_detailed.power_used: Gomu Gomu no Mi — Gear 4 Snakeman

title: Pekoms' Cacao Island Escape Plan
summary: Pekoms prepares to activate his Sulong form to help Luffy escape, even though he cannot control it. The duo come to Cacao Island, but are quickly overwhelmed by Oven's army of the Big Mom Pirates. Sanji comes in to rescue Luffy, but faces fierce opposition and he and Luffy are soon surrounded. However, the Germa 66 fleet then arrives and attacks the Big Mom Pirates.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre est correctement situé dans l'arc Whole Cake Island, pas East Blue Saga — le scraper a mal référencé l'arc. Pekoms active son mode Sulong (transformation Mink liée à la lune), non un Fruit du Démon. Oven utilise le Netsu Netsu no Mi. La réapparition de Germa 66 constitue un retour notable. Sulong de Pekoms mentionné mais pas clairement confirmé comme déclenché, ambigu selon le résumé.

title: Even If You Die, Don't Die!!!
summary: Wadatsumi managed to pull the Thousand Sunny underwater and put the Sun Pirates' ship in the path of the Big Mom Pirates' cannon fire, but the Big Mom Pirates quickly see through this ruse and Oven attacks Wadatsumi. With the Sunny still hours away from escaping Totto Land, and a revitalized Big Mom heading for Cacao Island at great speed, the Sun Pirates attack the forces on the Queen Mama Chanter, and Jinbe cannot bring himself to leave them. Luffy tells Jinbe to survive and reunite with them at Wano Country, proclaiming himself to be Jinbe's captain. With the Sun Pirates keeping the Queen Mama Chanter at bay, the Straw Hats and Fire Tank Pirates head toward freedom without impediments, and elsewhere, Morgans predicts to Stussy that one of the Worst Generation will become the next Pirate King.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Morgans prédit à Stussy que l'un des membres de la Worst Generation deviendra le prochain Roi des Pirates.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le scraper liste 'Thousand Sunny' et 'Sun Pirates' comme personnages — Thousand Sunny est un navire, pas un personnage ; Sun Pirates est un groupe. Fisher Tiger est mentionné implicitement via les Sun Pirates mais pas directement dans le résumé — exclu. Straw_hats_count estimé à 2 (Luffy et Jinbe confirmés présents sur le Sunny), les autres membres sont probablement présents mais le résumé ne les nomme pas individuellement. Le chapitre est numéroté 901 mais classé East Blue Saga par le scraper — il s'agit en réalité de l'arc Whole Cake Island (Big Mom Pirates), probablement une erreur de classification du scraper. L'arc indiqué est conservé tel quel.

title: End Roll
summary: On Cacao Island, Pudding recalls all her experiences with Sanji as she stares at a roll of film containing Sanji's removed memory of her kissing him. Inside the Mirro-World, Brûlée tends to Katakuri's injuries. She reveals that she had seen his back touched the ground before, but still looked up to him because he had attacked bullies that gave her the scar on her face when they were children. Big Mom arrives at Cacao Island while the Sun Pirates and Germa 66 continue fighting, much to the Big Mom Pirates' joy. However, the Straw Hats have successfully managed to escape from Totto Land. Sanji learns about Pedro's self sacrifice from Carrot, and makes the crew a meal just as Zeff does on the Baratie.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Brûlée révèle qu'elle avait vu Katakuri le dos au sol mais qu'elle l'admirait quand même car il avait défendu son honneur contre des brutes qui lui avaient infligé la cicatrice sur le visage étant enfants. Pudding possède la mémoire effacée du baiser qu'elle a donné à Sanji.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Pedro est mentionné comme mort (sacrifice) par Carrot à Sanji, mais sa mort a eu lieu dans un chapitre précédent — classé comme non-mort présente/flashback dans ce chapitre. Zeff est mentionné en référence à travers l'action de Sanji de cuisiner pour l'équipage, similaire à ce que Zeff faisait au Baratie. Le résumé mentionne les Straw Hats comme groupe ayant réussi à s'échapper de Totto Land. straw_hats_count limité à Sanji et Carrot car nommés explicitement.

characters_detailed.power_used: Mémoire (Fruit Memo-Memo, pellicule de la mémoire de Sanji)

title: Introducing the Revolutionary Army Commanders
summary: After losing their base of operations at Baltigo, the Revolutionary Army set up their new base at Kamabakka Kingdom. Ivankov commented about the Straw Hats' exploits in Totto Land and Dragon plans to declare war against the World Nobles at the upcoming Levely. Elsewhere, four revolutionary commanders—Belo Betty, Morley, Lindbergh, and Karasu—appear at Lulusia Kingdom to help its citizens fight and defeat the Peachbeard Pirates.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Monkey D. Dragon annonce son intention de déclarer la guerre aux Nobles Mondiaux lors du prochain Levely. La base de l'Armée Révolutionnaire a été déplacée au Royaume de Kamabakka après la perte de Baltigo.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Luffy est mentionné par Ivankov via les exploits à Totto Land mais n'apparaît pas physiquement. Plusieurs nouveaux personnages introduits simultanément (4 commandants révolutionnaires). Moda est une résidente de Lulusia Kingdom apparaissant brièvement. Inazuma et Koala sont présents à Kamabakka. L'arc est mal classifié comme 'East Blue Saga' dans le scraper — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Levely/Reverie (post-Whole Cake Island).

title: Seppuku
arc: The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Chapters
summary: While the Levely takes place, Nekomamushi manages to find Marco. Marco has taken up residence in Whitebeard's homeland, which his crew now protects. With the threat of Edward Weevil likely coming to this country, Marco stays to protect it, but gives Nekomamushi a message to pass on to Luffy. Meanwhile, Zoro's group has made it to Wano Country. Kin'emon gave them orders to blend in, but Zoro is apprehended after being accused of cutting down some people at night. He is sentenced to commit seppuku as Tsujigiro takes Shusui for himself, but Zoro cuts down Tsujigiro with the seppuku blade instead.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Marco a établi sa résidence dans le pays natal de Barbe Blanche et protège la population contre la menace potentielle d'Edward Weevil. Il confie un message à Nekomamushi pour Luffy.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le Levely est mentionné comme toile de fond mais aucun personnage du Levely n'est physiquement présent dans la narration principale. Edward Weevil est mentionné comme menace mais n'apparaît pas physiquement. Shanks, Marshall D. Teach, Barbe Blanche (Edward Newgate), Buckin et Shimotsuki Ryuma sont mentionnés en référence mais sans apparition directe. Kurozumi Orochi et Kaidou sont vraisemblablement évoqués comme antagonistes de Wano mais leur présence physique dans ce chapitre est incertaine selon le résumé. Zoro récupère ou perd Shusui dans ce chapitre — Tsujigiro lui prend Shusui avant d'être défait. Le retour de Marco après une longue absence depuis Dressrosa justifie character_return=true.

title: Onward to Wano Country
arc: The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Chapters
summary: As the Thousand Sunny approaches Wano Country, Luffy and his group are informed of the Levely through the newspaper, which brings back memories to the crew particularly Sanji and Chopper. They suddenly notice an unusual weather disturbance in their direction, followed by an octopus on their ship as well as a school of huge carp on their side. The crew gets separated after a bumpy ride across a river, a waterfall, and a whirlpool. Luffy wakes up on a beach with the Sunny washed up on its side and wonders where everyone went. He then encounters a komainu and a huge baboon with a katana, which leads him to confirm that this is indeed Wano Country.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Usopp, Robin, Franky et Zoro sont probablement présents sur le Sunny mais ne sont pas explicitement mentionnés dans le résumé ; ils ne sont pas comptabilisés dans straw_hats_count ni dans characters_present. Komachiyo est un komainu (chien-lion mythique) et Hihimaru est le babouin armé d'un katana — tous deux introduits pour la première fois. Le 'combat' avec ces créatures est en réalité une rencontre initiale ambiguë plutôt qu'un affrontement formel. Shirahoshi, Vivi et Kureha sont mentionnés dans le scraper mais n'apparaissent pas physiquement dans le chapitre (possiblement évoqués via journal/nouvelles). Charlotte Linlin et Kaidou sont mentionnés comme contexte de l'arc mais n'apparaissent pas physiquement. L'arc Wano Country commence officiellement ici.

title: Adventure in the Land of Samurai
summary: Luffy recalls how Sanji flew the rest of the crew to land, but he had been swept away with the Sunny due to being held back by the octopus. Two Beasts Pirates scouts arrive to take out Luffy, but Luffy dispatches them, freeing their prisoner O-Tama. Tama tames the baboon, Hihimaru, whom the komainu Komachiyo had been protecting her from, by making food from her body. Komachiyo and Hihimaru take her and Luffy to her master's house, and Tama offers Luffy her precious rice. Her master appears and is angered at Luffy eating the rice, but Tama explains what happened. However, she falls ill due to drinking contaminated river water, and her master reveals that she has stayed here in Kuri because she is waiting for Ace to return here. Meanwhile, Beasts Pirates Shinuchi Basil Hawkins hears about what happened at the beach and decides to go deal with it himself.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Tama has been waiting in Kuri for Portgas D. Ace to return, revealing Ace had previously visited Wano Country and had ties to Tama.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ace appears only through mention/reference (Tama waiting for him), not physically — counted as referenced rather than physically present. Kibi Kibi no Mi is Tama's Devil Fruit (she makes dango from her cheek to tame animals) — its use is shown but not explicitly named in this chapter, so devil_fruit_used is set to false as the fruit name is not confirmed in this chapter's text. Basil Hawkins appears at the end as a cliffhanger antagonist. Sanji, Nami, Carrot, Chopper are mentioned in flashback context (Sanji flew them to land) but do not appear in the chapter proper. Arc note: this chapter marks the beginning of the Wano Country Arc.

characters_detailed.name: Tama
characters_detailed.power_used: Kibi Kibi no Mi (dango taming ability)

title: Amigasa Village
summary: Luffy reveals to O-Tama that Ace has died, causing her to pass out. Her master Tenguyama Hitetsu reveals that Tama grew close to Ace after he arrived at Wano Country and saved their home, Amigasa Village, from a famine. However, Amigasa Village was destroyed by X Drake during the Beasts Pirates' takeover. Luffy decides to take Tama to a doctor at the nearest town, and borrows Hitetsu's cursed Famous Blade Nidai Kitetsu without Hitetsu's permission. Luffy and Tama arrive at a massive polluted wasteland when they run into Zoro saving a woman from attackers. Basil Hawkins then comes to confront Luffy and Zoro as they reunite, and the two of them prepare to fight.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Ace visited Wano Country, saved Amigasa Village from a famine, and became close to Tama before his death; Amigasa Village was later destroyed by X Drake during the Beasts Pirates' takeover
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ace appears only in flashback/mention context — his death is referenced narratively (offscreen/past event). Zoro is reunited with Luffy in this chapter, counting as a character_return. Tsuru (Wano) is listed as the woman Zoro saves. Komachiyo is the animal that accompanies Tama and Luffy. Sanji and Kin'emon are listed by the scraper but do not appear in the summary — excluded from characters_present. Beasts Pirates are mentioned but only as a faction. X Drake is referenced in flashback context regarding Amigasa Village destruction. The arc tag says 'East Blue Saga' but this chapter is clearly set in Wano (New World) — likely a scraper error; sea_region set to New World.

title: Tsuru Returns the Favor
arc: The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Chapters
summary: After a brief conversation, Luffy and Zoro battle against Hawkins and his men with Hawkins displaying the power of his Wara Wara no Mi, which enables him to redirect any damage done to him to one of his men. Komachiyo drags the two Straw Hats away from the battle and the woman that Zoro saved earlier introduces herself as Tsurujo. Upon seeing Tama in critical condition, Tsuru asked the two Straw Hats to bring Tama to her tea shop so she can help her. They later arrive at Okobore Town and on top of a mountain, Bepo, Shachi, and Penguin spotted Luffy and Zoro.

taxonomy.revelation_description: La Wara Wara no Mi de Hawkins lui permet de rediriger les dégâts qu'il subit vers l'un de ses hommes, révélant la mécanique de son pouvoir.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Urashima et Kikunojo sont mentionnés dans le contexte de l'arc (mariage) mais leur présence directe dans ce chapitre n'est pas clairement confirmée par le résumé ; ils ont été inclus dans les personnages détectés par le scraper mais leur présence active dans ce chapitre reste incertaine. Bepo, Shachi et Penguin apparaissent brièvement à la fin du chapitre en repérant Luffy et Zoro depuis une montagne. Tama est en état critique. Le combat contre Hawkins ne se conclut pas, les Straw Hats étant tirés de la bataille par Komachiyo.

title: Okobore Town
summary: Tsurujo heals Tama and feeds her. She reveals that the Kouzuki Family ruled over Wano Country over 20 years ago, but her talking causes two Gifters named Batman and Gazelleman to come and attack. Gazelleman kidnaps Tama and takes her to the Bakura District, where some Beasts Pirates and government officials reside, including the Shinuchi Basil Hawkins, Holed'em, and Speed. Luffy and Zoro head for Bakura on Komachiyo, and they are joined by Kiku, who claims to be a samurai. Meanwhile, Law hears about Luffy and Zoro's arrival and goes to stop them from causing trouble.

taxonomy.revelation_description: La Famille Kouzuki régnait sur Wano il y a plus de 20 ans, avant d'être renversée par Kurozumi Orochi.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc indiqué dans le prompt est 'East Blue Saga' mais ce chapitre appartient clairement à l'arc Wano Country (New World). Le Sandai Kitetsu mentionné dans la liste du scraper est l'épée de Zoro, sa présence est implicite. Batman et Gazelleman sont des Gifters (utilisateurs de SMILE) — leurs fruits ne sont pas nommés officiellement dans ce chapitre mais leurs transformations animales sont activées. Holed'em et Speed sont mentionnés/apparaissent dans le district de Bakura mais sans action directe détaillée. Tsurujo soigne Tama et est attaquée par les Gifters mais aucun vainqueur de combat n'est établi dans ce chapitre.

title: Bakura Town
summary: Tama is brought before Holed'em, who decides to find out about her Devil Fruit powers by forcibly acquiring food out of her body. Meanwhile, Mouseman tells Urashima to use his high status to give Kiku no choice but to become his wife, and Urashima is dominating opponents in sumo wrestling when Kiku, Luffy, and Zoro arrive at Bakura Town. Urashima tries to have Kiku brought before him, but Kiku responds by slicing his topknot.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Wano Country et non East Blue Saga — le scraper indique 'East Blue Saga' ce qui est une erreur manifeste. Tenguyama Hitetsu et Komachiyo sont probablement présents en début de chapitre (transition depuis la scène précédente) mais le résumé ne les mentionne pas explicitement à Bakura Town. Holed'em est un membre des SMILE/Beasts Pirates. Gazelleman et Mouseman sont des subordonnés SMILE de Kaido. Le Haki du Roi Conquérant est mentionné par le scraper (Supreme King Haki) mais aucune utilisation n'est décrite dans le résumé — non retenu. L'arc réel est Wano Country (New World).

title: Wano Country Grand Sumo Tournament
summary: Urashima tries to kill Kiku for rejecting him and cutting off his top knot, but Luffy steps in and challenges him to a sumo wrestling match. Luffy dodges all of Urashima's attacks and pushes him out of the ring with Gear 3, sending him crashing through several houses including Holed'em's. After finding out about the group's intention to rescue Tama, the Beasts Pirates attack Luffy, Zoro, and Kiku. Holed'em confronts Luffy as he threatens to kill Tama, and Hawkins and his men head into Bakura Town to attack as well.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Wano Country et non East Blue Saga — erreur du scraper corrigée dans le traitement. Ashura Doji, Kouzuki Family mentionnés dans le contexte de l'arc mais absents de l'action décrite. title: The Treasure Ship of Provisions
summary: The headliner Speed brings out clean food from Orochi's Paradise Farm, and runs into Holed'em's confrontation with Luffy, Zoro, and Kiku. Kiku warns Luffy that attacking Holed'em will bring about the wrath of Jack, who has recently returned to Wano Country. However, after seeing the food Speed brought, Luffy gets angry and attacks Holed'em's lion Kamijiro, freeing Tama. After seeing what Holed'em did to Tama, Luffy hits the headliner in the face with Red Hawk. Meanwhile, a disguised Law intercepts Hawkins and intends to take him out in order to prevent information from spreading further.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Jack est récemment revenu à Wano, ce qui augmente le danger pour Luffy et ses alliés ; existence de la Ferme du Paradis d'Orochi révélée.

title: Governor-General Kaidou of the Beasts Pirates
summary: Kaidou flies around Kuri looking for Luffy and Law, and his subordinates realize that he is drunk and at risk of destroying the entire region. Law takes Luffy to deal with Kaidou and prevent any of their crews and allies from being discovered, but Hawkins tells Kaidou that the two of them are at the ruins of Oden Castle, which he does not actually know is the truth. Kaidou decimates the ruins with his Boro Breath, and Luffy immediately responds by punching him in the head with Elephant Gun.

devil_fruit_names: Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu
taxonomy.revelation_description: Kaidou est révélé en forme de dragon zoan mythique volant au-dessus de Kuri, ivre, menaçant toute la région ; première confrontation directe Luffy vs Kaidou avec Elephant Gun.

In a fit of rage, Luffy confronts Kaidou and pummels him with Gear 3 and Gear 4 attacks. Kaidou transforms back into his regular form, but is otherwise unharmed, and he defeats Luffy with a single blow.

Meanwhile, Moria raids one of the Blackbeard Pirates' islands to confront Blackbeard and look for the missing Absalom. However, he discovers that Absalom has been killed and Shiryu has taken his Devil Fruit power, and Blackbeard invites Moria to join him while revealing that Sabo and his group attempted to rescue Bartholomew Kuma during the Levely. title: The Prisoner Mine
summary: People in the Flower Capital receive the Kouzuki Family's secret message and are shocked to find out about their return. Meanwhile, Nami and Shinobu spy on government officials, and they manage to acquire some important information though they have to flee after being spotted. At the Prisoner Mines and Weapons Factory in Udon, the prisoners are forced to hard labor in exchange for food. Luffy and Kid compete together and do so much work that they receive large piles of kibi dango, but this draws the ire of the gluttonous vice warden Dobon. However, when he tries punishing Luffy and Kid by eating them, he is swiftly defeated from inside.

taxonomy.revelation_description: People in the Flower Capital receive the Kouzuki Family's secret message announcing their return, causing widespread shock.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Dobon est introduit comme vice-warden de la mine de prisonniers à Udon. La note 'Kuni' dans la liste du scraper semble être une erreur ou un personnage mineur non confirmé par le résumé — non inclus. Hyougoro est présent dans la mine mais son rôle exact dans ce chapitre est limité selon le résumé. Le combat contre Dobon est résolu de façon comique (Luffy et Kid le battent depuis l'intérieur). L'arc est Wano Country, non East Blue Saga — le scraper indique incorrectement 'East Blue Saga'. Shinobu et Nami espionnent des officiels du gouvernement local (pas Gouvernement Mondial au sens strict), elles fuient après avoir été repérées. SMILE et Seastone mentionnés en contexte mais pas utilisés directement comme pouvoirs.

title: O-Toko the Kamuro
summary: Sanji reunites with Usopp, Robin, and Franky as they come to his soba stand. Some of Kyoshiro's henchmen then come and try extorting money from Sanji, but end up angering him by spilling his soba on the ground. Sanji and Franky swiftly defeat them, and the scuffle causes the long line to the stand to clear. Sanji and his crewmates then meet a girl named Toko, and she receives a bowl of soba after the henchmen destroyed her first serving. She then goes off to attend to the courtesan Komurasaki, who is heading to Orochi's banquet. Kyoshiro gets the news about Sanji's actions, and being too busy to deal with it himself, he has his subordinate Kaku contact Queen to send assassins after Sanji and Franky.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Kyoshiro (Denjiro) contacts Queen to send assassins after Sanji and Franky, revealing Queen's involvement as an enforcer in Wano's underworld
locations: Flower Capital (Wano Kuni) — soba stand district
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Kouzuki Hiyori is listed under her alias Komurasaki as she appears as a courtesan heading to Orochi's banquet; her true identity as a Kozuki may not yet be fully revealed to the reader at this point. Monkey D. Luffy is detected by the scraper but does not appear in the summary — marked absent. Kuni, Suke, Tsugaru Umi appear to be Kyoshiro family henchmen names. Queen is mentioned/contacted but does not physically appear in the scene. Arc listed as Wano Country Arc despite scraper note of 'East Blue Saga' which appears to be a scraper error.

title: Introducing Komurasaki the Oiran
summary: Luffy meets Caribou again as he works with Raizo to escape from the Udon prison, while Kid works to do the same thing on his own. In the Flower Capital, some men attempt to kill the courtesan Komurasaki after having lost everything trying to purchase her freedom, when in reality she swindled all the money they gave her. They are easily dispatched by her guard as she reaches Orochi's palace. In Amigasa Village, Momonosuke tells Tama about his sister Hiyori, saying that if she is alive, he cannot meet her until their war is won.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Komurasaki the renowned oiran is revealed to be Kouzuki Hiyori, Momonosuke's sister; Momonosuke reveals he knows she may be alive but cannot reunite with her until the war is won
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Komurasaki is formally introduced as Kouzuki Hiyori in this chapter — her identity as Momonosuke's sister is the chapter's core revelation. Denjiro is her guard (Kyoshiro in disguise) though the résumé references him only as her guard. Caribou reappears after a long absence. Kid is working on his own escape in Udon. Dobon and Hyougoro are listed by the scraper but not explicitly mentioned in the résumé summary provided, so they are not included in characters_present. Big Mom Pirates, Red Hair Pirates, Kaidou, Sanji, Usopp, Franky, Bingo, Seastone listed by scraper but not appearing per this résumé.

title: Shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi
summary: Franky discovers that Minatomo pawned off the design blueprints for Kaidou's lair on Onigashima. He tracks down the path of the blueprints and finds that they ended up with someone in Kuri. Meanwhile, a man named Tonoyasu tags along with Zoro, and takes him to his hometown near the Flower Capital. In the Flower Capital, Kurozumi Orochi meets with CP0, who wish to create a new trade deal after the downfall of their intermediary Doflamingo. With the World Government helpless to go against Wano, Orochi demands that they send Vegapunk to him, and afterwards he heads off to his banquet. Outside, the headliners X Drake and Page One arrive, having been called by Queen to take out Sanji.

title: Shogun and Oiran
summary: Robin escapes from the Orochi Oniwabanshu using a body double and reports her experience to Nami, Brook, and Shinobu. She returns to Orochi's banquet, where Komurasaki is attracting much of the attention. Orochi then talks about his paranoia over the return of Oden's Nine Red Scabbards, and the guests' discreet mocking of him results in Toko laughing. Orochi attacks Toko, but is slapped by Komurasaki, who has no qualms about standing up to him, and the banquet quickly devolves into chaos.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Komurasaki (Kouzuki Hiyori) reveals her fearless character by slapping Orochi in front of his court after he attacks Toko, causing chaos at the banquet.

Orochi's paranoia about the Nine Red Scabbards is referenced verbally but no flashback shown. title: The Grand Sumo Inferno
summary: Queen puts Luffy and Hyougoro into a sumo death match against him and his subordinates, and the two of them will be instantly killed by special collars if they get knocked out of the ring. Meanwhile, Drake and Hawkins' platoon raids the Flower Capital bathhouse to arrest anyone with a crescent moon symbol on their ankle. Sanji inadvertently reveals his presence in his Raid Suit, and escapes with Nami, Robin, and Shinobu. He reveals to them that the Heart Pirates were captured, and that they need to tell Law before he is lured to his crewmates. Meanwhile, Zoro chases the man who stole Shusui to Ringo, and the man reveals that he returned it to Ryuma's grave as the two prepare to fight for the weapons in each other's possession.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Les Heart Pirates ont été capturés ; Onimaru révèle avoir rendu le Shusui à la tombe de Ryuma à Ringo
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Wano Country (Wano Kuni Arc), pas East Blue Saga — le scraper a probablement mal classé. Kaidou est mentionné comme présence de fond (Yonko régnant sur Wano) mais n'apparaît pas physiquement dans ce chapitre ; yonko_present mis à true par contexte de l'arc. Supreme King Haki (Conqueror's Haki) est évoqué dans le contexte de Luffy dans le résumé. Onimaru est le mystérieux voleur du Shusui. Kawamatsu est mentionné implicitement via la mention de Ringo et de Ryuma. Law n'apparaît pas physiquement dans ce chapitre, seulement mentionné. Heart Pirates capturés = révélation majeure. Raid Suit de Sanji utilisé = transformation confirmée.

title: Gyukimaru on Oihagi Bridge
summary: In the Prisoner Mine, Luffy keeps wiping out Queen's fighters in the sumo ring, but Queen is content to continue eating and watching. Meanwhile, Zoro battles the thief Gyukimaru in order to reclaim Shusui. However, Kamazo then arrives chasing a woman and Toko in order to kill the latter for Orochi, and Zoro decides to help the two targets. He spars with Kamazo, and he manages to acquire one of the assassin's scythes and strike him down.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Gyukimaru est le nom de combat du voleur sur le pont Oihagi, qui est en réalité Onimaru selon le lore ultérieur — tagué ici sous son nom d'apparence dans ce chapitre. Kamazo est un assassin d'Orochi, première apparition dans ce chapitre. Hiyori n'est pas encore identifiée explicitement comme telle dans ce chapitre (elle est 'la femme' chassée), mais son identité est établie dans les chapitres suivants ; elle est incluse avec son nom canonique. Queen est présent mais passif (mange et observe). Charlotte Linlin est mentionnée dans le contexte de l'arc mais pas physiquement présente dans ce chapitre — retirée des characters_present. L'arc est Wano Country, non East Blue Saga — le scraper a probablement mal classifié l'arc.

title: A Woman's Secret
summary: Kamazo falls, but Zoro soon loses consciousness due to his wound. The woman and Toko take him to the Northern Cemetery and treat his wounds, explaining that they were forced out of the Flower Capital after angering Orochi. The woman then reveals herself to be Kouzuki Hiyori, and is looking for her brother Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Kin'emon reports to the minks that the shogunate and Beasts Pirates have discovered the Kouzuki Family's secret message. In Ebisu Town, Shinobu believes that the Heart Pirates revealed the significance of the message and wants to leave them to die, causing Kanjuro to argue with her. Tonoyasu then arrives with a copy of the message, wondering if it is time for the final battle.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Kouzuki Hiyori reveals herself to Zoro; the shogunate and Beasts Pirates have discovered the Kouzuki Family's secret message; Heart Pirates are suspected of leaking it.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Kamazo is Killer in disguise (confirmed in the Wano arc). Tonoyasu is Shimotsuki Yasuie. The arc tag 'East Blue Saga' in the prompt appears to be a scraper error — this chapter belongs to the Wano Country Arc (Whole Cake Island/Wano arc sequence). Law and the Heart Pirates are mentioned/implied but may not appear physically. Momonosuke and Kaidou are mentioned indirectly. Denjiro and Shusui references may be background mentions. Tags reflect physical/narrative presence as described in the summary.

title: The Old Leopard Never Forgets the Way
summary: Hiyori tells Zoro how she escaped from Oden Castle's destruction 20 years ago with the help of the retainer Kawamatsu. In the Flower Capital, the people with the Kouzuki Family's mark on their ankle are all corralled in a prison in the Rasetsu District for everyone to see. In the Prisoner Mine, Luffy and Hyougoro fight Alpacaman and Madilloman. Luffy tries unsuccessfully to unleash a ranged Armament Haki attack, but after realizing what Haki is, Hyo performs the exact desired attack and offers to help Luffy in learning it.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Hiyori révèle comment elle a survécu à la destruction du château d'Oden il y a 20 ans grâce au vassal Kawamatsu ; Hyougoro démontre la maîtrise du Haki d'Armement à distance, offrant de l'enseigner à Luffy.

Kawamatsu est présent dans le flashback d'Hiyori. L'attaque de Haki à distance de Hyo est introduite comme concept/démonstration mais n'est pas encore une technique nommée officielle pour Luffy.

title: Daimyo of Hakumai, Shimotsuki Yasuie
summary: As he is crucified, Yasuie reveals that he lied about being Ushimitsu Kozo, and had posed as him in order to be given this public platform. He then lies that he created the Kouzuki Family's secret message as a prank out of frustration after being defeated by Orochi and Kaidou 20 years ago, and that the crescent moon symbol was an unrelated fashion design. This creates significant doubt among the forces guarding those imprisoned for having the crescent symbol, and Yasu takes pride in his efforts to aid the rise of the Kouzuki Family as he is shot and killed by Orochi and his forces. Upon arriving at the scene, Zoro is baffled to see the residents of Ebisu Town laughing hysterically. Hiyori then reveals to him that they have been stripped of the ability to do anything else thanks to Kaidou bringing SMILE to this country.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Yasuie révèle publiquement (en mentant) que le message secret des Kouzuki et le symbole de la lune croissante n'avaient aucun sens, semant le doute parmi les forces d'Orochi. Hiyori révèle à Zoro que les SMILE privaient les habitants d'Ebisu Town de toute émotion autre que le rire.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' dans le prompt est erroné — le chapitre 942 appartient à l'arc Wano Country (New World). Kaidou et Orochi sont mentionnés dans la narration mais n'apparaissent pas physiquement de manière centrale ; Orochi donne néanmoins l'ordre de tirer sur Yasuie (il est considéré présent). Kaidou est seulement mentionné. Hiyori est présente aux côtés de Zoro. Toko assiste à l'exécution de son père. Le 'fight_occurs' est mis à false car l'exécution est unilatérale (Yasuie est crucifié et fusillé sans combat).
