title: Queen vs. O-Lin
summary: Big Mom defeats Queen by throwing him into a wall and this knocks Kid and Killer out of the water and damages Kawamatsu's cell door. Big Mom then finds the o-shiruko container, only to see that it is empty. Luffy inadvertently reveals that he ate it, causing her to attack him and Hyougoro in a fit of rage. Big Mom forces the two of them out of the ring, but in the heat of the moment, Luffy successfully manages to rip off their collars. Hyougoro then decides to have Luffy train to progress his Haki by forcing Luffy to protect him from Big Mom. Meanwhile, the Beasts Pirates are unable to contact Kaidou or anyone outside Udon, as Caribou had gotten the idea to smother the Boss Tanishi that carried all their signals.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc indiqué par le scraper est 'East Blue Saga' mais ce chapitre appartient clairement à l'arc Wano (Pays de Wano). Big Mom est en état d'amnésie dans ce chapitre, comportement inhabituel. Caribou sabote les communications des Beasts Pirates avec le Boss Tanishi, action stratégiquement importante mais discrète. Luffy retire les collars explosifs de lui-même et de Hyougoro, acte majeur. Raizo est mentionné dans la liste du scraper mais n'est pas explicitement évoqué dans le résumé fourni — inclus avec présence incertaine.

title: Queen's Gamble
summary: Luffy is unable to defend himself and Hyougoro from Big Mom, and she rampages around the Prisoner Mines. Queen develops a plan to attack her when she reaches him, and when she does, he slams into her from above in his brachiosaurus form. This causes Big Mom to regain her memories, but she immediately falls asleep afterward, and Queen has her chained up before taking her to Onigashima. Babanuki is left in charge, but Luffy decides to battle the remaining Beasts Pirates and take control of Udon.

title: Introducing Kawamatsu the Kappa
summary: The Beasts Pirates in the Prisoner Mine use special bullets to keep the prisoners under control, and Luffy's fellow prisoners attack him as they have given up hope of standing against Kaidou and Orochi. However, Raizo gives Kawamatsu his sword and the key to his handcuffs, allowing Kawamatsu to free himself and join Luffy and his allies. Hyougoro tells Raizo and Kiku that they need to reveal their true identities to get the prisoners on their side, and Kiku reveals that she is a trans woman named Kikunojo as she intends to prevent the Beasts Pirates from reporting to Kaidou about this.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Kikunojo reveals she is a trans woman; Kawamatsu is freed from his imprisonment and joins the alliance; Hyougoro urges Raizo and Kiku to reveal their true identities to rally prisoners against Kaidou and Orochi

title: Mummy
summary: Luffy, Chopper, Hyougoro, Raizo, Kikunojo, and Kawamatsu overwhelm the Beasts Pirates, but Daifugo shoots the prisoners with special bullets, which inflict a debilitating virus known as Mummy onto them that is spread through touch. As the prisoners move to subdue Luffy's group, Luffy unexpectedly grabs them and becomes infected. He tells them that their conditions will only worsen the longer Kaidou stays in power, and if they want to get out of this, they should not stand in his way. Babanuki prepares to fire an Excite Shell into the crowd, but Luffy ties up his elephant's trunk, causing the shell to explode inside Babanuki. The prisoners then decide to join Luffy and rebel, and they defeat Daifugo as Luffy's alliance conquers Udon.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc indiqué par le scraper est 'East Blue Saga' ce qui est manifestement erroné — le chapitre 949 se déroule dans l'arc Wano Country (New World). Queen et Tama sont mentionnés dans le contexte narratif (Queen en tant que commanditaire du virus, Tama implicitement liée aux prisonniers) mais leur présence physique dans ce chapitre n'est pas confirmée par le résumé ; ils sont inclus avec précaution. Kaidou et Kouzuki Oden ne sont pas présents physiquement mais mentionnés/référencés. Le virus Mummy n'est pas un personnage mais un élément de l'arc. L'alliance des prisonniers avec Luffy constitue bien une nouvelle alliance formée.

title: The Warriors' Dreams
summary: Raizo and Hyougoro try to convince the prisoners of Udon to join their alliance against Kaidou. Kid and Killer leave Udon to find their crewmates. In Kuri, Ashura Doji shows Kin'emon and Inuarashi a graveyard and tells them a story of the Kouzuki Family's supporters attacking Onigashima ten years ago. He then decides to rejoin Kin'emon. Zoro and Hiyori fled to a forest outside the Flower Capital. Meanwhile, Hawkins and Drake have captured and plan to interrogate Law about the alliance's operations in Wano Country.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Ashura Doji reveals that Kouzuki supporters staged an attack on Onigashima ten years ago, hinting at the failed rebellion and its casualties.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Luffy is not explicitly present in the résumé despite being listed by the scraper; omitted from characters_present. Kid and Killer depart Udon but do not engage in combat. Hawkins and Drake capturing Law constitutes a threat/interrogation setup rather than a full fight. The flashback concerns Ashura Doji recounting the failed Onigashima assault ten years prior. Ashura Doji rejoining Kin'emon counts as a new alliance formed (re-joining the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance). Tama, Momonosuke, Kawamatsu, Onimaru, Toko, Yasuie and other scraper-listed names are not confirmed present in the résumé and are thus excluded.

title: Once a Fox
summary: Kawamatsu reveals that after Hiyori left him, he went to Ringo, where he encountered Onimaru, a komagitsune who was the companion of Ringo's late daimyo Shimotsuki Ushimaru. Until Kawamatsu was caught and arrested, he had worked with Onimaru to collect the weapons left on the graves in the cemetery in order to use them in the final battle against Kaidou. In the present, Gyukimaru leads Zoro, Kawamatsu, and Hiyori to an underground chamber where all these weapons have been stored, and Kawamatsu contacts Kin'emon to reveal that they can easily arm their allies come the final battle. Outside, Gyukimaru transforms into Onimaru. Hiyori then tells Zoro to return Shusui, and in exchange she will give him the Famous Blade Enma, a blade wielded by her father that was able to wound Kaidou.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Kawamatsu révèle qu'il a collecté les armes des tombes de Ringo avec Onimaru (alias Gyukimaru) pour armer les alliés lors de la bataille finale contre Kaidou. Hiyori propose d'échanger Shusui contre Enma, la lame de Kouzuki Oden capable de blesser Kaidou.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Gyukimaru est la forme voleur/brigand d'Onimaru (komagitsune transformé), non un personnage distinct — traité comme Onimaru dans les personnages détaillés. Shimotsuki Ushimaru et Kaidou ne sont présents que par mention/flashback. L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' par le scraper est erroné — il s'agit clairement de l'arc Wano (New World). Le retour de Kawamatsu et la révélation d'Enma constituent les éléments narratifs majeurs du chapitre. Kin'emon est contacté par Den Den Mushi mais sa présence physique directe est ambiguë ; inclus comme personnage présent via communication.

characters_detailed.name: Onimaru
characters_detailed.power_used: Transformation komagitsune (révélation de sa vraie identité sous forme de Gyukimaru)

characters_detailed.name: Kouzuki Oden
characters_detailed.affiliation: Kouzuki Clan / Whitebeard Pirates / Roger Pirates

title: The Promised Port
summary: 25 years ago, Kouzuki Oden parted ways with the Roger Pirates after their voyage to Laugh Tale, seeking to open Wano Country's borders. In the present, Orochi heads to Onigashima from Port Habu to partake in the Fire Festival, and as twilight draws near, the Nine Red Scabbards reach Port Tokage. However, none of their allies are there, and they cannot get in contact with anyone, including the Straw Hats.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre repose sur une montée de tension dramatique : les Neuf Fourreau Rouges arrivent à Port Tokage mais aucun de leurs alliés n'est présent, créant un mystère/cliffhanger. Le flashback de 25 ans en arrière montre Oden se séparant des Pirates de Roger après Laugh Tale. Momonosuke est mentionné comme faisant partie des Scabbards mais son rôle individuel est minimal. Le scraper a incorrectement identifié 'Laugh Tale', 'Roger Pirates', 'Wano Country', 'Fire Festival', 'Nine Red Scabbards', 'Onigashima', 'Flower Capital' et 'Wano Country Arc' comme des personnages — ce sont des lieux, organisations ou événements. Le tagger a rectifié cette liste.

title: Introducing Kouzuki Oden
summary: 41 years ago, Kouzuki Sukiyaki prepared to disown his 18-year-old son and heir Oden due to Oden committing outrageous actions his entire life. As he did this, Oden put the Flower Capital citizens on edge as he returned from a failed attempt to sail away and cooked a pot for Oden over a man's cremated remains. Meanwhile, gang member Kin'emon stole a very valuable white boar and took it to the Capital. However, Denjiro told him that possessing it would draw the wrath of its parent, which was the size of a mountain and known as a Mountain God. As the Mountain God started attacking the Capital, Oden overheard Kin'emon and Denjiro talking and told them to give the white boar to him.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Le flashback révèle la jeunesse tumultueuse d'Oden, son déshéritage imminent par Sukiyaki, et l'origine de sa relation avec Kin'emon et Denjiro, ainsi que l'existence de la Bête du Dieu de la Montagne (Mountain God) à Wano.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ce chapitre marque le début du flashback consacré à Oden, il y a 41 ans. La liste du scraper contient 'Wano Country', 'Kouzuki Family' et 'Flower Capital' qui sont des lieux/organisations, pas des personnages — ils ont été exclus de characters_present. Hyougoro, Kurokoma, Banzaburo et Katsuzo sont présents dans le contexte de la capitale des fleurs mais peu développés. Le combat contre le Mountain God est amorcé mais non conclu dans ce chapitre. L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' semble incorrect pour un flashback sur Wano — il s'agit vraisemblablement de l'arc Wano Country.

title: Becoming Samurai
summary: 33 years ago, Inuarashi and Nekomamushi left Zou to find Wano Country. After washing up on Wano and encountering Kawamatsu, the three of them were tied up and bullied by some Kuri citizens. However, Oden came and stopped them, and the three of them started following him. Oden started running out of money, and his followers went to steal some from Yasuie. They were caught, but to their surprise he gave them the money with the order to improve their social standing to increase Oden's respectability. They did this, and after three years they were able to create a formal procession during Oden's visit to Sukiyaki in the Flower Capital. Later that year, Oden discovered that the Whitebeard Pirates had washed ashore on Wano. He raced toward them and clashed with Whitebeard, saying he wanted to join his crew.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Oden first encounters the Whitebeard Pirates washing ashore on Wano and clashes with Whitebeard seeking to join his crew, marking the beginning of Oden's path off Wano.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The entire chapter is a flashback set 33 years ago. Denjiro and Orochi are listed as detected by the scraper; Denjiro appears as one of Oden's followers (implied by context of the group following Oden), and Orochi is mentioned briefly as a presence in the Kuri/Flower Capital region. The fight between Oden and Whitebeard is a cliffhanger — no resolution shown. The arc label 'East Blue Saga' in the prompt appears erroneous; this chapter belongs to the Wano Country arc (Oden's flashback sub-arc). Haki is not explicitly described in the résumé despite the likely use during the Oden-Whitebeard clash; tagged false due to lack of explicit confirmation.

title: Oden's Adventure
summary: 30 years ago, Whitebeard refused to let Kouzuki Oden join his crew because of concern about Oden's character. However, as he tried to covertly set sail, Oden and Izou stowed away by riding on a chain. Whitebeard decided to allow Oden to join if he could ride the chain for three days, but Oden, when there were only ten minutes left, ended up drifting away. He washed ashore on an island, scaring away a band of human traffickers who had tried to kidnap a woman named Amatsuki Toki by promising to take her to Wano. After Toki treated his wounds, Oden defended her when the traffickers came back with their leader Karma. However, Whitebeard then came and took out Karma as he offered for Oden to join him, being impressed with his willingness to protect Toki. Oden, Toki, Izou, and the stowaways Inuarashi and Nekomamushi then sailed and adventured with the Whitebeard Pirates, and one day Toki revealed that she was a time traveler who was born 800 years ago. Meanwhile, Gol D. Roger read the news of Oden joining Whitebeard and expressed a desire to meet him.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Kouzuki Toki révèle qu'elle est une voyageuse temporelle née il y a 800 ans. Roger exprime le désir de rencontrer Oden après avoir lu la nouvelle de son intégration à l'équipage de Barbe Blanche.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre est entièrement un flashback se déroulant 30 ans avant le présent narratif. Shanks et Buggy sont probablement visibles sur le Moby Dick ou mentionnés de façon incidente (ils étaient apprentis sur le vaisseau de Roger à cette époque, leur présence exacte dans ce chapitre n'est pas garantie par le résumé). La révélation de Toki comme voyageuse temporelle née il y a 800 ans est une révélation de lore majeure. Karma est un personnage antagoniste mineur introduit et rapidement défait. L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' semble incorrect pour ce contenu — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Wano/flashback Oden, mais le tag a été conservé tel quel.

characters_detailed.name: Kouzuki Toki
characters_detailed.power_used: Toki Toki no Mi (voyager dans le temps)

title: Roger and Whitebeard
summary: The Whitebeard Pirates and the Roger Pirates clash for three days and three nights. On the fourth day, their fight has stopped, and they split the loot equally between the two crews. Roger discusses with Whitebeard his dreams to fully travel the world, with Roger asking the latter that he'll need to borrow Oden for a year and gave away all his treasure to him. They later reach Skypiea in which Oden writes Roger's message beside the Shandora Poneglyph.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Roger emprunte Oden aux Whitebeard Pirates pour naviguer avec lui, et Oden grave le message de Roger sur le Poneglyph de Shandora à Skypiea, révélant le rôle d'Oden comme lecteur/inscripteur de Poneglyphes dans la quête de Roger vers Laugh Tale.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre se déroule entièrement en flashback dans le passé de Oden. Le combat entre les équipages de Roger et Whitebeard dure trois jours avant de s'arrêter sans vainqueur désigné — fight_winner est null car match nul/partagé. Roger révèle à Whitebeard son intention de voyager jusqu'au bout du monde, ce qui implique la quête de Laugh Tale. Oden grave le message de Roger sur le Poneglyph de Shandora, révélant sa capacité à lire et écrire les Poneglyphes. Shanks et Buggy sont présents en tant que membres juniors de l'équipage de Roger (cabine boys/apprentis). Marshall D. Teach (Barbe Noire) est probablement visible en arrière-plan comme membre des Whitebeard Pirates mais sa présence dans ce chapitre précis n'est pas formellement confirmée par le résumé. Kouzuki Momonosuke et Hiyori ne semblent pas présents dans ce chapitre (trop jeunes ou non nés à cette époque). Crocus est potentiellement présent sur le Oro Jackson.

title: Sentenced to Boil
summary: Oden made a deal with Kaidou to allow those who survived an hour in the boiling pot go free. He then stepped into the boiling pot of oil and used a large piece of wood to hold all of his retainers over him. As the citizens looked unfavorably upon Oden, Shinobu then came and revealed to them that Oden danced naked in the street every week in order to stop Orochi from kidnapping 100 citizens and sending them to Kaidou, with Orochi and Kaidou having falsely promised to leave Wano once they finished constructing ships.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Shinobu révèle aux citoyens qu'Oden dansait nu dans les rues chaque semaine pour empêcher Orochi d'enlever 100 citoyens de Wano afin de les envoyer à Kaidou, et qu'Orochi et Kaidou avaient faussement promis de quitter Wano une fois la construction des navires terminée.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre se déroule entièrement dans le cadre du grand flashback de Wano sur le passé d'Oden. 'Banzaburo' semble être un personnage ou surnom mineur non identifiable avec certitude depuis le résumé — non inclus dans characters_detailed faute d'information. Kurozumi Semimaru est l'utilisateur du Bari Bari no Mi, mais son rôle dans ce chapitre précis n'est pas explicitement décrit dans le résumé. L'arc est incorrectement labellisé 'East Blue Saga' par le scraper — il s'agit du Wano Country Arc (New World). La mort d'Oden n'est pas encore confirmée dans ce chapitre bien qu'il soit dans la cuve bouillante.

title: Onward to Onigashima!!
summary: In the present day, the Nine Red Scabbards set sail to Onigashima. Kin'emon seriously considers the possibility that there is a traitor among them, and Kanjuro promptly reveals that he is. Born Kurozumi Kanjuro, he had lost his parents during his family's persecution. He was then recruited by Orochi to become a part of the Kouzuki Family, and as he served Oden, he gave Orochi information about everything the family did, including their plans in the present day. Three Beasts Pirates ships then arrive and confront the Scabbards, and Kin'emon decapitates Kanjuro, only to find out that it was a perfectly drawn clone and that the real Kanjuro was on the coast, having kidnapped Momonosuke to bring him to Onigashima. However, the Straw Hat Pirates, Heart Pirates, and Kid Pirates then arrive on their ships to attack the Beasts Pirates.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Kanjuro révèle être le traître parmi les Neuf Fourreaux Rouges : né Kurozumi Kanjuro, il a infiltré la famille Kouzuki sur ordre d'Orochi, transmettant toutes leurs informations secrètes, y compris les plans actuels de l'assaut sur Onigashima.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc indiqué par le scraper (East Blue Saga) est incorrect — ce chapitre appartient à l'arc Wano (New World). Kaidou est mentionné implicitement (les navires des Bêtes Pirates arrivent) mais n'apparaît pas physiquement. Orochi est mentionné dans le flashback de Kanjuro mais sa présence physique n'est pas confirmée. Le clone dessiné de Kanjuro décapité par Kin'emon ne constitue pas une mort réelle. Luffy est présent via l'arrivée du Thousand Sunny, mais le résumé ne détaille pas l'équipage présent individuellement — straw_hats_count estimé à 1 (Luffy minimum confirmé). Denjiro est listé parmi les Scabbards. Le Fruit du Démon de Kanjuro (pouvoir de dessin) est utilisé pour créer un clone parfait.

characters_detailed.name: Kurozumi Kanjuro
characters_detailed.power_used: Clone dessiné parfait (Fruit du Démon — pouvoir artistique)

title: Kin'emon's Clever Trick
summary: Although the arrival of the Straw Hat Pirates, Heart Pirates, and Kid Pirates was unexpected, the Beasts Pirates are still confident as they reveal how they prevented the rest of the Kouzuki Family's allies from getting to Port Tokage as well as that they had formed an alliance with the Big Mom Pirates. However, Luffy, Law, and Kid simultaneously attack and destroy one of their ships, and Kyoshiro arrives on his ship. He attacks another enemy ship, revealing his true identity as Denjiro, and he then reveals that Yasuie's altered message actually instructed the Kouzuki allies to meet at the wharf by Port Habu. Thus, their allies had been able to reach the wharf before Orochi destroyed the bridges, and Denjiro had freed the Rasetsu Town prisoners after Orochi had left him in charge of the Flower Capital. As he reveals this, the alliance, now numbering 5400, arrives at Port Tokage on a massive fleet. Denjiro commends Kin'emon for cleverly misinforming the other Scabbards to mislead the spy Kanjuro, unaware that Kin'emon had actually misunderstood the message himself.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Denjiro révèle sa véritable identité sous le déguisement de Kyoshiro ; le message altéré de Yasuie avait en réalité dirigé les alliés vers le quai de Port Habu, permettant à 5400 combattants d'atteindre Port Tokage ; Kin'emon avait en réalité mal compris le message lui-même plutôt que d'avoir intentionnellement trompé Kanjuro.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Kyoshiro révélé comme étant Denjiro est le point central du chapitre. Le résumé mentionne Luffy, Law et Kid attaquant simultanément un navire ennemi — Devil Fruit de Luffy très probablement utilisé mais non explicitement nommé. Yasuie est présent via la mention de son message altéré (flashback contextuel plutôt que scène de flashback visuelle directe). Orochi est mentionné dans le contexte narratif mais sa présence physique dans le chapitre n'est pas confirmée — inclus dans les personnages détaillés comme référencé. L'arc est Wano (incorrectement étiqueté 'East Blue Saga' par le prompt — corrigé en New World). Le nombre de Straw Hats physiquement montrés est incertain au-delà de Luffy.

title: Begging Your Pardon!!!
summary: Kawamatsu and Sanji try to save Momonosuke from Kanjuro, but Kanjuro keeps them away with his art creations as he flies with Momonosuke away on a bird. Despite his fear and lack of strength, Momonosuke assures the alliance that he will find a way to escape on his own. The remaining Beasts Pirates ship retreats, only to resume attacking from a distance with long-range cannons. However, Jinbe then attacks the ship and reveals himself, having come from Totto Land alive as promised.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Jinbe révèle être en vie et avoir survécu à Totto Land, rejoignant l'alliance pour l'assaut d'Onigashima comme promis.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Jinbe est le personnage clé du chapitre avec son retour dramatique. Kanjuro utilise son Fruit Fude Fude no Mi pour s'échapper avec Momonosuke. L'arc Wano est en cours (assaut d'Onigashima), mais le scraper indique incorrectement 'East Blue Saga' — c'est l'arc Wano dans la saga New World. Kouzuki Oden, Kouzuki Toki, Kouzuki Hiyori, Nine Red Scabbards, Thousand Sunny, Polar Tang, Eustass Kid, Seven Warlords of the Sea sont mentionnés ou présents en contexte mais non actifs dans ce chapitre selon le résumé ; seuls les personnages actifs sont inclus dans characters_detailed.

title: Fighting Music
summary: Luffy attacks several of the Beasts Pirates for wasting the red bean soup, and Zoro quickly finds and joins him. Scratchmen Apoo then uses his "Fighting Music" to attack and injure the duo with his sounds, forcing them to run away. Meanwhile, Eustass Kid decides to shed his disguise as well and attacks Apoo out of revenge for betraying him and his crew.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Apoo's Devil Fruit is the Oto Oto no Mi (Sound-Sound Fruit), which is how he performs his 'Fighting Music' sound attacks. Luffy uses Gear 3 per the scraper tag but the résumé only mentions being injured and retreating — Gear 3 use is inferred from scraper data. Kid drops his disguise and attacks Apoo out of revenge, consistent with his established betrayal subplot. Tama, Babanuki, Udon, and Kaidou are listed by the scraper but do not appear to be physically present in this chapter's scene based on the résumé — they are excluded from characters_present. Arc is Wano (not East Blue Saga — the scraper metadata appears erroneous). Killer is present alongside Kid as part of Kid Pirates.

title: Joining the Fight
summary: Queen gives the Beasts Pirates permission to kill Luffy, Zoro, Kid, and Killer, and they are forced to run away from their onslaught, which even Hatcha of the Numbers joins in. Meanwhile, part of Kin'emon's group splits off to infiltrate Kaidou's fortress in order to help surround Kaidou as well as rescue Momonosuke. Elsewhere, the Big Mom Pirates attempt to scale the waterfall around Wano again, looking to find out why Big Mom and Kaidou are in an alliance. However, they are knocked down by Marco, who is approaching Wano with Nekomamushi and Izou.

Marco fait son retour remarqué avec Nekomamushi et Izou, ce qui constitue le cliffhanger principal. Kaidou est mentionné dans le contexte de l'alliance mais n'apparaît pas physiquement selon le résumé. Le fruit de Marco (Phénix) est implicitement utilisé pour repousser les Big Mom Pirates de la cascade. title: My Bible
summary: As Ulti and Page One quickly recover from Luffy and Yamato's attacks, Kaidou and the All-Stars join Orochi and the crucified Momonosuke onstage for Kaidou to announce his "New Onigashima Project" to the audience. Meanwhile, Luffy fights Yamato due to not wanting to meet with him, but after they escape from the Beasts Pirates, he allows Yamato five minutes. Yamato reveals that he idolizes and styles himself after Kouzuki Oden, and he wants to work with Luffy to achieve Oden's dream of opening Wano Country's borders.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Yamato révèle qu'il idolâtre Kouzuki Oden et veut réaliser son rêve d'ouvrir les frontières de Wano ; Kaidou annonce officiellement le 'New Onigashima Project'
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est Wano Country et non East Blue Saga — le scraper a mal tagué l'arc. Kouzuki Oden est mentionné mais en référence uniquement (pas de flashback explicite). L'affiliation de Yamato est ambiguë : fils de Kaidou mais en opposition à lui.

title: Sorry for the Wait
summary: As the minks activate their Sulong forms, Jack leads a large platoon of Beasts Pirates to aid Kaidou in taking them on. Inside the Skull Dome, King spots Shinobu trying to free Momonosuke and hurls her away, but an invisible Sanji manages to break Momonosuke's chains and fly away with him. King then clashes with Sanji and manages to drive him into a nearby tower with his pteranodon form. Meanwhile, Big Mom attacks Luffy before taking Zeus back from Nami and using the homie to attack her. However, Franky and Brook come riding in on the Kurosai FR-U IV, and Franky runs over Big Mom's face with it as Brook bisects Zeus with Soul Solid.

title: The Sake I Brewed to Drink With You
summary: Around four years ago, Ace came to Onigashima with his crew to fight Kaidou, and dueled Yamato as Kaidou was away on an expedition. During the course of their fight, Ace grew to learn of Yamato's desire to leave Wano, and together the two of them damaged Kaidou's great dragon statue. Back in the present, Marco takes Zoro up to the Dome's roof, confronting King and Queen. While doing this, he remembers how Whitebeard refused to go back to Wano and take on Kaidou, and would not let Ace do so alone, with the crew's reasoning being that the damage and casualties would be too great even for the sake of avenging Kouzuki Oden. On the Dome's roof, the recently arrived Big Mom tells Kaidou to kill all the Straw Hats he pleases except for Robin, whom she needs to read the Poneglyphs. Kaidou tells her about his intention of placing Onigashima at the site of the Kouzuki Family's castle in the Flower Capital, and she inquires about the location of his Road Poneglyph, wanting him to repay the favor she did by giving him his Devil Fruit on God Valley 38 years ago.

title: Color of the Supreme King
summary: Kaidou attacks Zoro to stop him from attacking Prometheus, and Law teleports Zoro away from the Emperor's attack. This allows Prometheus to fly down and rescue Big Mom right before she lands in the ocean, and Kid and Killer head to confront Big Mom while the others keep fighting Kaidou. Zoro, having sustained grievous wounds from blocking the Emperors' Hakai attack, puts all his remaining energy into a final Nine Sword Style strike that manages to give Kaidou a notable scar on his chest, shocking Kaidou, suspected that the swordsman is using Supreme King Haki. Kaidou immobilizes Zoro and Law with Raimei Hakke, but Luffy then regains consciousness and confronts the Emperor. Noting that the advanced Armament Haki applications he learned had not succeeded in inflicting real harm against Kaidou, Luffy realizes that one can also infuse objects with Supreme King Haki, a technique Kaidou is capable of. With this revelation, Luffy starts putting his own Supreme King Haki to use and successfully hits Kaidou from afar with immense power, saying Law and Zoro can go back down below while he takes on the Emperor alone.

title: The Order
summary: Tama speaks out from the Live Stage to the tamed Gifters throughout the castle, ordering them to aid in taking down Kaidou. This causes chaos to erupt throughout the building as many Gifters turn on their crewmates, and the Tobiroppo are left without assistance from their subordinates against their opponents due to this. Queen tries shooting a laser at Tama, but is stopped by Sanji, and the All-Star transforms into his human-beast form to take on the Straw Hat cook. Meanwhile Chopper, who is now extremely small as a side effect of his enhanced Monster Point, attends to Zoro with Miyagi and Tristan, and Miyagi offers Zoro a special medicine from Zou that will regenerate him very quickly at the cost of more suffering later. On the fourth floor, Who's-Who uses Six Powers attacks against Jinbe, and the fish-man recognizes the Tobiroppo as a former CP9 agent who was later imprisoned. Who's-Who confirms this and reveals that he possesses a grudge against Luffy, as he had lost his position in the agency due to allowing what is now Luffy's Devil Fruit, the Gomu Gomu no Mi, to be stolen from a government ship 12 years ago.

title: Brachiojaurus
summary: The CP0 agents in Kaidou's fortress receive a call from Rob Lucci, who reveals that battleships are positioned to initiate a World Government takeover of Wano Country should Kaidou fall. Additionally, Lucci orders his comrades to capture Robin. Meanwhile, Yamato leaves Momonosuke to generate Flame Clouds on his own while he goes to the armory to try to minimize any worst case explosion. Meanwhile, Sanji and Queen fight fiercely, but the cook struggles to find a way to inflict damage on the All-Star as he resists Queen's goads to use his Raid Suit. Queen fully transforms into his brachiosaurus form and reveals that his head, neck and tail are a single serpentine construct that can exit the rest of his body. Queen uses his snake form to crush Sanji, but ends up releasing him after explosive launchers on his main body misfire and strike him. The attack leaves Sanji with all his bones broken, but to his shock, his body starts to fix itself in an instant. Queen then swings a giant sword at Sanji, only for it to shatter upon striking him; Sanji comes to realize to his displeasure that the modifications his father gave him might finally be starting to take effect.

title: The Tower
summary: Worried that the modifications Judge put on his brothers may be taking effect on him and thus strip him of his humanity, Sanji tries running away from Queen to buy time to figure out what is going on, as attacks continue to hit his body to no effect. Meanwhile, Hawkins deliberately inflicts harm on himself to transfer the damage to Kid, rendering the latter vulnerable against Big Mom and putting Killer in a bind. However, Killer then realizes the nature of Hawkins' Wara Wara no Mi power and cuts off the Supernova's left arm; this attack does not transfer to Kid as he does not have a left arm. Killer is then able to remove the straw doll from the severed arm that ties Hawkins to Kid, which is the last doll Hawkins possessed. With that ability nullified, Hawkins sends his Straw Man to attack, but Killer is able to overwhelm it and strike him down.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Sanji découvre que les modifications génétiques de Judge pourraient s'activer en lui, le rendant insensible aux dégâts physiques comme ses frères Vinsmoke. Killer comprend que Kid n'a plus de bras gauche, ce qui lui permet de couper le bras de Hawkins sans transférer les dégâts à Kid, neutralisant ainsi le dernier lien de la Wara Wara no Mi.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' dans le prompt est manifestement erroné — ce chapitre se déroule clairement durant l'arc Wano (Onigashima), pendant la bataille du Festivité des Bêtes. Vinsmoke Judge est mentionné dans le contexte des préoccupations de Sanji mais n'apparaît pas physiquement (probablement en flashback ou simple référence mentale) ; il est exclu de characters_present. Chopper est listé dans les personnages détectés par le scraper mais n'est pas mentionné dans le résumé — inclus à titre marginal. Le combat Hawkins vs Killer se conclut dans ce chapitre avec la victoire de Killer. La 'révélation' sur Sanji est en cours (il fuit pour réfléchir) et ne se conclut pas ici.

title: Echoing the Impermanence of All Things
summary: Drake and Apoo have ceased fighting as they talk in a chamber, with Apoo proposing an alliance between them to finish off the remainder of the winning side and take the spoils for themselves. Meanwhile, Usopp and Nami's group comes across Kin'emon's severed legs which are running around and talking with farts; apparently, Law had not fully reattached the samurai's body on Punk Hazard. After they identify themselves to Kin'emon as allies, he guides them to the first-floor crawlspace so they can give Kikunojo urgent medical attention. However, in the crawlspace, Kin'emon's top half then hears a still-living Kanjuro speaking with a still-living Orochi over Smart Tanishi. On Orochi's orders, Kanjuro draws a flaming specter called Kazenbo to set the fortress ablaze and detonate the large amounts of explosives in Onigashima's armory. Meanwhile, Law and Kid decide to use their awakened Devil Fruit abilities against Big Mom out of necessity. As Big Mom slams Kid toward the Live Floor, Law puts a field called K-ROOM around his sword and penetrates Big Mom's body with it, which allows him to release a shockwave that harms the Emperor to the point of making her bleed. Kid then uses his awakened ability to turn Big Mom into a magnet, causing a significant portion of the fortress' structure to be pulled toward her and crush her from every angle.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Law et Kid utilisent leurs Fruits du Démon éveillés pour la première fois contre Big Mom ; Kanjuro révèle être encore vivant et invoque Kazenbo pour déclencher une explosion dans l'armurerie d'Onigashima ; Kin'emon découvre que Law n'avait jamais pleinement rattaché son corps à Punk Hazard.

title: Warrior of Science
summary: After emerging from Kid's awakened attack, Big Mom uses a year of her lifespan to make herself bigger and stronger. Meanwhile, Yamato interrupts Apoo and Drake's meeting, elsewhere on the inside of Onigashima, the CP0 agents begin making their move, commencing a pursuit of Robin and several of the minks rise up to try and stop them. Meanwhile, as Sanji is confronted by Queen again, the cook speculates that he had lost his humanity for a brief moment due to his father's modifications taking effect as a result of him using the Raid Suit, causing him to strike a woman who was in his way. Disgusted by what he was becoming, Sanji destroys the contraption. He then calls Zoro over Den Den Mushi and asks his crewmate to strike him down should he come out of this war no longer a human, and Zoro agrees. Sanji then ignites Hell Memories and strikes Queen with a powerful blow.

Il détruit le Raid Suit et demande à Zoro de le tuer s'il n'est plus humain à la fin de la guerre.

summary: With their attacks now inflicting significant harm on Big Mom, but their bodies on the verge of unconsciousness, Law and Kid mount a final tag-team assault against the Emperor. He then unleashes another shockwave which harms Big Mom and opens a hole below her. Before Big Mom can unleash a counterattack, Kid comes in with a gun made out of magnetized scrap metal and fires a laser at her, blasting her into the hole with nothing between her and the mainland.

title: The New Era
summary: Momonosuke insists that he will face Ryokugyu alone to prove he is capable of defending Wano, and wounds him, only for the latter to back off after sensing Shanks' Haki. Meanwhile Law joins Robin and Sukiyaki and as they travel underground the latter reveals the underwater city is where Wano once existed and that the Pluton rests here along with the Road Poneglyph. As Ryokugyu backs off, Luffy can sense the familiarity in that mysterious Haki.

devil_fruit_names: Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu
taxonomy.revelation_description: Sukiyaki reveals that the ancient underwater city beneath Wano is where Wano once stood, and that the ancient weapon Pluton as well as a Road Poneglyph are located there.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Arc classification as 'East Blue Saga' in the prompt appears erroneous — this chapter is clearly part of the Wano Country Arc (New World). Shanks appears indirectly via his Haki being sensed rather than a physical appearance; tagged as present due to his Haki being the decisive narrative element. Ryokugyu backs off after sensing Shanks' Conqueror's Haki, not after being defeated in combat per se, but Momonosuke is credited as the fight winner contextually since he wounded Ryokugyu and the latter retreated. The straw hats counted are Luffy, Robin, and Zoro/Sanji/Jinbe ambiguity — only Luffy and Robin are confirmed present in the summary; count set to 3 conservatively. The arc_ends tag is set to true as this chapter marks the conclusion of the Wano arc narrative.

title: The End
summary: As the teacher at the Flower Capital begins narrating the story to an audience, Yamato reveals to Kin'emon and Momonosuke that he decided not to join the Straw Hats for the moment until he learned more about the world by traveling throughout Wano first. The three arrive to see the Straw Hats off and Luffy gives Momonosuke his flag along with a promise to return if Wano is in danger again. He also states he is willing to accept the three of them as crewmembers if they ever decide to be pirates. As Luffy against the wishes of the crew decides to go down the waterfall instead of the port on their way out of Wano, the teacher finishes his story with the statement of Orochi's final moments as well as the return of the Kouzuki Clan regaining their glory.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Yamato décide de ne pas rejoindre les Chapeaux de Paille et choisit d'explorer Wano d'abord. Luffy confie son pavillon à Momonosuke et promet de revenir si Wano est en danger. Orochi est mentionné comme mort, le Clan Kouzuki retrouve sa gloire.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre est une scène d'adieu de clôture de l'arc Wano. Le résumé ne mentionne pas explicitement tous les membres de l'équipage des Chapeaux de Paille présents (seuls Luffy, Usopp, Nami, Chopper, Brook sont nommés dans la liste du scraper parmi les SH). Zoro, Sanji, Robin, Franky et Jinbe sont vraisemblablement présents mais non confirmés dans le résumé. L'arc_classification indique 'East Blue Saga' mais Wano appartient à la 'Four Emperors Saga' — possible erreur de métadonnées. Kurozumi Orochi est mentionné dans la narration de sa mort finale mais n'apparaît pas physiquement. Kaidou et Big Mom également mentionnés dans le contexte de la Raid on Onigashima mais absents du présent narratif.

title: My Only Family
summary: After finishing their meal, Atlas leaves Luffy's group, and Luffy finds a machine allowing his group to change their clothes. However, when a Pacifista resembling Bartholomew Kuma shows up, Bonney prevents Luffy from attacking, confirming to the others that Kuma is her father due to him being her only family. Meanwhile, the Blackbeard Pirates attack the Heart Pirates to obtain the Road Poneglyph etchings the Heart Pirates have. During the attack, the officers that Blackbeard brought with him are revealed to now have Devil Fruit powers. After landing on a nearby island, Law prepares to face Blackbeard with the etchings as the prize.
characters_mentioned: Uma Uma no Mi, Model: Pegasus

taxonomy.revelation_description: Bonney confirms that Bartholomew Kuma is her father and her only family. The Blackbeard Pirates officers have acquired Devil Fruit powers (Shiku Shiku no Mi for Doc Q, Wapu Wapu no Mi for Van Augur, Riki Riki no Mi for Jesus Burgess).
taxonomy.tagger_notes: The arc label 'East Blue Saga' in the prompt appears to be a scraper error — this chapter clearly takes place in the Egghead/Final Saga arc. Arc tagging follows actual content. Luffy eating is implied from 'after finishing their meal' at chapter opening. Haki is not explicitly used in the described events. The Pacifista resembling Kuma may be a Seraphim or a standard Kuma-model Pacifista; tagged as Bartholomew Kuma (Pacifista) per scraper context. Law's Heart Pirates are referenced collectively; individual members not named beyond Law himself.

title: The Emperor's Crew, The Red Hair Pirates
summary: The nature of York's plan was revealed in a flashback when she realized the World Government would try to eliminate her too. In the present, as a Blackbeard Pirates ship is approaching Egghead, at Elbaph a duel is set up between Kid and Shanks, where the latter is easily victorious, and Dorry and Brogy destroy Kid's ship, leaving the Kid Pirates completely annihilated.

taxonomy.revelation_description: York réalise que le Gouvernement Mondial cherchera à l'éliminer également, révélant la nature de son plan ; un vaisseau des Blackbeard Pirates approche Egghead.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le résumé est succinct. Le Haki du Conquérant de Shanks est fortement sous-entendu par sa victoire 'facile' mais n'est pas explicitement nommé. La mort des membres de l'équipage de Kid n'est pas confirmée explicitement — 'annihilated' suggère une défaite totale mais pas nécessairement des morts confirmées. York est présente en flashback uniquement. Le vaisseau des Blackbeard Pirates approchant Egghead constitue le cliffhanger principal. Le Road Poneglyph de Kid est potentiellement en jeu mais non explicitement mentionné dans ce chapitre.

title: Let's Go and Take It!!
summary: At Marine Headquarters, Sengoku and Tsuru talk about the threat the Cross Guild poses to their forces while it remains active. At the Cross Guild's location, Buggy angers Crocodile and Mihawk after their subordinates design the figurehead of their flagship after Buggy. During their meeting it gets worse when Buggy foolishly announces his plans for their group to go after the One Piece. Meanwhile, Sabo is revealed to be alive with several residents from the Lulusia Kingdom, and he decides to privately tell Dragon and Ivankov what really happened at Mary Geoise.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Sabo est révélé vivant après la destruction de Lulusia, accompagné de survivants du royaume. Il décide de confier en privé à Dragon et Ivankov ce qui s'est réellement passé à Marie-Joie. Par ailleurs, Buggy déclare ouvertement que la Cross Guild va partir à la conquête du One Piece.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Sabo est confirmé vivant après la destruction de Lulusia (révélation majeure). Le chapitre couvre trois lieux distincts. Buggy est listé comme Yonko car il en détient le titre au moment de cet arc. Crocodile et Mihawk sont d'anciens Shichibukai. Le contenu exact des révélations de Sabo à Dragon/Ivankov n'est pas détaillé dans le résumé. Karasu, Morley, Belo Betty, Lindbergh et Koala sont vraisemblablement présents au QG révolutionnaire mais leur apparition individuelle n'est pas confirmée explicitement — marqués comme présents par association contextuelle.

title: The Death of Nefertari Cobra
summary: As Cobra is stunned by Imu's appearance as Imu reveals about the significance of the Will of D. and the spreading of the Poneglyphs across the world and the actions that have occurred since then due to Lili's actions. Knowing they will not let him live, Cobra reveals Lili's full name as "Nefertari D. Lili". Sabo attempts to intervene to save Cobra from Imu and the Five Elders, but due to being overpowered he is forced to flee alone, but not before Cobra tells him his final request.  However, Wapol had witnessed this knowing his life is in danger and runs away. As the Levely is coming to an end, Vivi is being held captive by CP0. That is when Wapol bursts through wall allowing Vivi to escape by jumping into Wapol's mouth.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Imu révèle la signification de la Volonté de D. et le rôle de Nefertari D. Lili dans la dispersion des Poneglyphs à travers le monde. Cobra révèle le nom complet de Lili : 'Nefertari D. Lili', liant la famille Nefertari au mystérieux 'D.'
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le titre indique la mort de Cobra mais le résumé reste ambigu sur l'instant exact de sa mort dans le chapitre (il parle à Sabo avant de mourir). La mort est traitée comme confirmée dans le présent narratif. Nefertari D. Lili est un personnage historique mentionné/révélé mais non présent physiquement — non incluse dans characters_detailed. Le scraper liste plusieurs entités non-personnages (Poneglyph, Will of D., Baku Baku no Mi, First Twenty, Ohara, Void Century) qui ont été correctement filtrés. Luffy, CP0 (Kalifa, Jabra), Charlos, Leo, Sai, Issho, Aramaki, Kinderella sont mentionnés dans le contexte du Levely mais n'apparaissent pas dans ce chapitre selon le résumé fourni.

title: Final Lesson
summary: As flashbacks occur which shows Koby's training with Garp and how he was captured by the Blackbeard Pirates, Garp gives the order for Koby, Helmeppo and Grus as he attacks the giant hand created by Avalo Pizarro, allowing the three to protect the ship, thanks to the skills Koby developed under Garp's tutelage. However, Garp decides to remain behind to protect his comrades. As the narration details these events, elsewhere a fleet of Marines has surrounded Egghead.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: Luffy est mentionné/présent de manière marginale via la scène finale à Egghead (flotte marine l'encerclant). Le scraper l'inclut dans les personnages détectés, mais sa présence physique dans ce chapitre est très limitée. Garp reste derrière pour protéger ses camarades — décision majeure laissant présager un possible sacrifice. Kuzan est associé à Hie Hie no Mi dans les tags du scraper mais son rôle actif dans ce résumé n'est pas explicitement décrit. L'arc est catalogué 'East Blue Saga' par le scraper, ce qui semble erroné — ce chapitre se déroule clairement dans le New World (Hachinosu). Le tag de l'arc a été ignoré pour la localisation.

title: Sentomaru
summary: As the Sea Beast Weapons and Pacifista Mark III attacks the Marines, Kizaru defeats Sentomaru to regain control of the Mark III's to deal with the Sea Beast Weapons and uses his powers to head inside Labophase. Lucci makes his move to kill Vegapunk, but Stussy takes the hit and Zoro faces him, while Sanji puts Kaku out of action. As Kizaru arrives where the Thousand Sunny and Vegaforce-01 is, Luffy confronts him.

taxonomy.tagger_notes: L'arc est indiqué comme 'East Blue Saga' par le scraper mais le chapitre 1091 appartient clairement à l'arc Egghead (New World). Cette incohérence est ignorée au profit du contenu réel. Sanji met Kaku hors combat mais la victoire exacte n'est pas détaillée — fight_ends=true pour le combat Kizaru/Sentomaru qui est clairement conclu. Stussy intercepte l'attaque de Lucci destinée à Vegapunk, ce qui constitue un acte de sacrifice/protection. Zoro affronte Lucci mais le résumé ne précise pas d'issue claire pour ce combat dans ce chapitre. La confrontation Luffy/Kizaru en fin de chapitre sert de cliffhanger.

title: Five Elders, Warrior God of Science and Defense, Saint Jaygarcia Saturn
summary: The Pacifistas Mk III begin attacking the Marines, on Atlas' orders, while Sanji locates Bonney and goes to her aid. Kizaru leaves to eliminate Vegapunk, with Luffy in pursuit. St. Saturn takes action and orders the Pacifistas to stand down. Kizaru stops Vegapunk's group from escaping, but Luffy arrives and knocks him out just as Luffy reaches his own limit. Just as Saturn confronts Vegapunk's group, an angry Bonney stabs him.

devil_fruit_names: Hito Hito no Mi Model Nika
taxonomy.revelation_description: Saint Jaygarcia Saturn, l'un des Cinq Doyens, intervient personnellement sur le champ de bataille à Egghead, révélant sa capacité à donner des ordres directs aux Pacifistas et sa présence physique en tant que 'Dieu Guerrier de la Science et de la Défense'.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le chapitre titre 'Five Elders, Warrior God of Science and Defense, Saint Jaygarcia Saturn' confirme l'apparition physique de Saturn sur Egghead. Luffy met hors combat Kizaru mais atteint sa propre limite, suggérant un état affaibli. Bonney poignarde Saturn à la fin — cliffhanger majeur. Zoro, Jinbe et Lucci sont listés comme présents mais leur rôle précis dans ce chapitre est mineur d'après le résumé. L'arc est Egghead, pas East Blue Saga — le scraper semble avoir mal catégorisé l'arc.

title: Better Off Dead in This World
summary: St. Saturn easily heals from the sword wound inflicted by Bonney and captures her while incapacitating Sanji. He tries to eliminate Luffy, but Franky saves him. As Bonney displays disgust for what they did to her father, a flashback of Kuma's past occurs. Kuma was a member of the Buccaneers, raised as a slave of the World Nobles, and was placed in a hunting tournament which was where he first met Ivankov and Ginny.

devil_fruit_names: Nika no Mi (Gomu Gomu no Mi)
taxonomy.revelation_description: Kuma était un membre des Buccaniers, esclave des Nobles Mondiaux, et a participé à un tournoi de chasse (Native Hunting Competition) à God Valley où il a rencontré Ivankov et Ginny pour la première fois. Figarland Garling est lié à cet événement.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Le flashback de Kuma constitue la partie centrale du chapitre. Ginny est présentée comme un nouveau personnage dans le passé de Kuma à God Valley. Figarland Garling est mentionné en lien avec le Native Hunting Competition. L'arc indiqué 'East Blue Saga' par le scraper semble erroné — il s'agit clairement de l'arc Egghead (New World). Saturn régénère d'une blessure d'épée (pouvoir de son Fruit du Démon de type Yokai). Le Fruit du Démon Nika est mentionné dans le contexte du lore Buccanier mais pas nécessairement activé dans ce chapitre — tagué avec incertitude.

characters_detailed.name: Jaygarcia Saturn
characters_detailed.power_used: Régénération / Fruit du Démon Yokai (Ushi Ushi no Mi, modèle Itsumade supposé)

title: Ginny
summary: Kuma and Ginny lived in Sorbet Kingdom with Kuma working as a pastor until the king changed the laws by pay the Heavenly Tribute to the World Nobles. They were freed by the Freedom Fighters and joined them which later became the Revolutionary Army. Eight years later, Ginny was kidnapped by an unknown assailant.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Kuma's past in Sorbet Kingdom is revealed: he worked as a pastor alongside Ginny, they were enslaved, freed by the Freedom Fighters, joined the group that became the Revolutionary Army. Ginny was later kidnapped by an unknown assailant, tying into Kuma's tragic backstory.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: This chapter is a flashback chapter focusing on Kuma and Ginny's past. Ginny is introduced as a major new character central to Kuma's backstory. The scraper listed 'Sorbet Kingdom', 'Religion', 'God Valley Incident', 'Buccaneers', etc. as character names — these are concepts/locations, not characters. Dragon and Ivankov appear as part of the Freedom Fighters. The arc label 'East Blue Saga' in the prompt appears incorrect for chapter 1097, which belongs to the Egghead Island arc / Kuma flashback. The fight_occurs tag is set to true as the Freedom Fighters presumably fought to free the slaves, though combat detail is limited in the summary. Ginny's kidnapping at the end serves as the cliffhanger mystery.

title: Bonney's Birth
summary: Kuma learned that Ginny was captured and forced into a marriage by a World Noble. After two years, Ginny was freed due to contracting a disease, and contacts the Revolutionary Army to say her goodbyes and died before Kuma could reach her. Kuma decided to raise her daughter Bonney, but when Bonney became five years old, she too contracted the disease, and Kuma learned there was no cure, but chose not to worry her. A year later, Bekori attempted to cause trouble for the Sorbet Kingdom again.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Ginny fut capturée et forcée au mariage par un Noble Mondial, contracta une maladie (Sapphire Scales), fut libérée puis mourut. Bonney, sa fille, a été élevée par Kuma et a contracté la même maladie incurable à l'âge de cinq ans.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: Ce chapitre est entièrement en flashback couvrant la vie de Kuma après la capture de Ginny. La mort de Ginny se produit hors-champ (elle contacte l'Armée Révolutionnaire puis meurt avant que Kuma ne la rejoigne). La maladie 'Sapphire Scales' est la maladie mentionnée. Bekori réapparaît en fin de chapitre, signalant un retour narratif au Sorbet Kingdom. L'arc indiqué comme 'East Blue Saga' semble erroné dans le scraper — ce chapitre appartient au flashback de Kuma dans l'arc Egghead/Post-Wano. Confidence réduite légèrement en raison de cette ambiguïté d'arc.

title: Pacifist
summary: Kuma is able to drive Bekori away. Shortly afterwards Bonney had unexpectedly aged due to unknowingly eating a Devil Fruit. Bekori is able to get the support of the World Government, and by fighting them off Kuma officially became a wanted criminal. Kuma then travels around looking to cure Bonney of the Sapphire Scales, and Dragon directs him to Vegapunk at his new laboratory. Vegapunk agrees to cure her, in exchange for Kuma donating his blood to create clone soldiers based off him.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Vegapunk agrees to cure Bonney of Sapphire Scales in exchange for Kuma donating his blood to create Pacifista clone soldiers, explaining the origin of the Pacifista project.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: This chapter is part of Kuma's flashback arc. Bonney accidentally ate the Toshi Toshi no Mi. The deal with Vegapunk establishes the origin of the Pacifista program. Dragon's presence is as a connector/director rather than active participant. The 'fight' against World Government forces results in Kuma becoming an official wanted criminal. Sea region listed as East Blue based on chapter arc label, though Sorbet Kingdom placement is sometimes debated.

title: Thank You, Bonney
summary: After Kizaru arrives at the lab, St. Saturn contacts them and blackmails Vegapunk and Kuma with a list of demands to approve of Bonney being cured of Sapphire Scales including that Kuma become a cyborg with no memories, and a member of the Seven Warlords or Bonney will become a slave which Kuma gladly accepts. With a year and a half of treatment, Bonney spends six months with them, and then is sent back to Sorbet Kingdom for the remaining year with a member of CP8 keeping her under observation. Meanwhile, Kuma begins his life as a warlord and is sent an undisclosed mission to Foosha Village.

taxonomy.revelation_description: Saint Saturn blackmails Vegapunk and Kuma: Kuma must become a full cyborg with no memories and join the Seven Warlords, or Bonney becomes a slave. Kuma accepts. Bonney is cured of Sapphire Scales. Kuma's first mission as Warlord is sent to Foosha Village.
taxonomy.tagger_notes: This chapter is part of Kuma's extended flashback arc (not literally 'East Blue Saga' — the scraper's arc label appears incorrect; this is likely part of the Egghead Arc flashback). No physical combat occurs; the conflict is entirely political/coercive. Foosha Village mention is intriguing as it connects to Luffy's hometown. CP8 member mentioned but unnamed. Portgas D. Ace listed by scraper but not confirmed present in the summary — excluded from characters_present. Revolutionary Army not directly present in this chapter. Alpha, Conney, Bulldog are minor named characters from the Kuma flashback arc included as potentially present.
